izzyondroid:com.astoev.cave.survey.name: CaveSurvey
izzyondroid:com.astoev.cave.survey.description: CaveSurvey tries to make creating speleo maps easier by aiding the data collection. It allows you to take the measurements table with you underground and leverages all the sensors available to facilitate the surveying process. Measurements can be typed manually, read via Bluetooth (check the supported laser distance measurer devices) or with the built-in compass/clinometer. izzyondroid:com.github.nicorac.bcrgui.description:
BCR-GUI is a companion app for the great BCR (Basic Call Recorder) Android application.
 To manage BCR call recordings, you actually need to use a file manager... and thats not so user-friendly 😉. It's hard to "extract" call informations from audio filename, and its even harder to search them when the list grows. Such a feature was already requested, but chenxiaolong (the author of BCR) wants to keep BCR Basic; and I do agree with him! Call recording on Android is a hard work, and I'd like (and hope) him to stay focused on it... recordings management is a job made for BCR-GUI 😂.

izzyondroid:com.kaajjo.libresudoku.name: LibreSudoku
izzyondroid:com.kaajjo.libresudoku.description:
Libre-Sudoku is a Sudoku app for Android, built with Jetpack Compose and Material3.
 Features: 
 Basic things such as pencil marks (notes), undo, game pause, board reset and give up (show solution)

izzyondroid:com.smartpack.kernelmanager.name: SmartPack-Kernel Manager
izzyondroid:com.smartpack.kernelmanager.summary: The Ultimate Tool to Manage your Kernel!
izzyondroid:com.smartpack.kernelmanager.description:
SmartPack-Kernel Manager is a heavily modified version of Kernel Adiutor developed by Willi Ye. All the credits go to the original developer, not only for his hard work on Kernel Adiutor, but also for being open to open-source community.
 Your device must be ROOTED to use this app. Otherwise, please don't bother installing this app.
 Features 
 Almost all the features available in Kernel Adiutor.

 CPU Input Boost & Devfreq Boost (Sultanxda).
 Simple MSM Thermal (Sultanxda).
 Advanced Control for Fast Charge (yank555.lu) & Boeffla Charge Level Interface (Lord Boeffla).
 K-Lapse Support (tanish2k09)
 Boeffla Sound (Lord Boeffla) with Per-channel Control
 Per-channel control for Flar's sound.
 Significantly different Faux Sound implementation.
 In-built Spectrum Support (frap129).
 Wake and sleep gestures (flar2).
 Adreno Boost (flar2).
 Dynamic Stune Boost (joshuous)
 MSM Sleeper (flar2).
 Boeffla Wakelock Blocker (Lord Boeffla).
 Display Backlight Control (Min & Max).
 Switches to tweak SELinux, Android Doze mode and PrintK logging.
 WireGuard version information.
 Real-time Charging Status.
 RAM & Swap Status.
 LED Blink/Fade support.
 Dedicated Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) section.
 Also compatible with any devices and kernels.
 And much more…
 Translations

izzyondroid:com.tymwitko.toreplace.name: ToReplace
izzyondroid:com.tymwitko.toreplace.summary: A to-do list for recurring tasks.
izzyondroid:com.tymwitko.toreplace.description:
ToReplace
 ToReplace is an offline tasklist for chores you need to do in intervals. Did you know that you should clean your dishwasher every 3 months - and your washing machine every 6 months? Oh, and you should also replace your water filters every 30 days. And that toothbrush of yours? Replace it every 3 months!
 There are so many things to maintain on a schedule - but how do you remember when you last did them? That's where ToReplace comes in!
 Tasks Every task you add requires you to enter an interval (e.g. 6 months) and the date of the last time you did it (don't worry, we won't judge, it's all offline anyway). On the main screen you'll see how much time you've got left (if any) until you should perform your duties again. Once you complete your task, you may click the "DONE" button to reset the countdown. You can also reset the countdown before it's due, in case you're that diligent.

izzyondroid:space.linuxct.phoneaccountde.summary: PhoneAccount Abuse Detector for Android 9.0+ devices
izzyondroid:space.linuxct.phoneaccountde.description:
PhoneAccount Abuse Detector is a simple application to enumerate and detect any application that (ab)uses adding an indefinite amount of PhoneAccount(s) to Android's TelecomManager.

If you are in such a situation, this app helps you to find the culprit – which you then can uninstall (of disable).

fdroid:com.app.equran.name: eQuran

fdroid:com.berkersen.practicesuite.name: Practice Suite
fdroid:com.berkersen.practicesuite.summary: The Swiss army knife of musicians
fdroid:com.berkersen.practicesuite.description:
Practice Suite is the ultimate music practice tool for musicians of all levels.
With its comprehensive features, you can stay on beat, in tune, and track your progress in one convenient app.
The Metronome feature allows you to set your desired tempo and time signature, ensuring that you stay on beat and in time while practicing.
The Tuner feature uses your device's microphone to accurately tune your instrument, helping you to play in perfect pitch.
The Recorder feature allows you to record your practice sessions and play them back, so you can listen to your progress and identify areas for improvement.
With the built-in Log feature, you can keep track of your practice sessions, set goals, and monitor your progress over time.
Practice reminders nudge you daily, weekly or on any interval you choose, at a time that suits you.
The app also provides detailed statistics, so you can see how much time you've spent practicing and how you've improved over time.
The app is designed to be user-friendly and easy to navigate, so you can focus on your practice and not on figuring out the app.
It's available for both iOS and Android devices.
Whether you're just starting to learn an instrument or you're a seasoned professional looking to fine-tune your skills,
Practice Suite is the perfect tool to help you achieve your goals. Download now and see your progress soar!

fdroid:com.cocode.calendar.name: Jalali Persian Calendar
fdroid:com.cocode.calendar.summary: Gregorian and Persian (Jalali) calendar with a two-way date converter
fdroid:com.cocode.calendar.description:
Jalali Persian Calendar is a local calendar app for Android that displays both the Gregorian and the Persian (Jalali) calendar. It requires no network connection, no account and no tracking.
Switch between the two calendar systems to see the current month with weekdays and weekends marked. Navigate to the previous or next month, or jump back to today with one tap.
Tap a day to add an event to it, or to see the events it already has. Events are saved on your phone; the app has no internet access and never sends them anywhere.
A built-in converter turns a Gregorian date into its Jalali equivalent and back, updating as you type.
The app also shows the current time in Iran, updated in real time, alongside the calendar.

fdroid:com.ominous.quickweather.name: QuickWeather
fdroid:com.ominous.quickweather.summary: Weather at a glance for anywhere in the world!
fdroid:com.ominous.quickweather.description:
QuickWeather is really fast. Just open the app and see the weather right now. There's no loading screen and no wait time. The weather is delivered to you with no extra junk, just clean and clear information.
You can add as many locations to the side drawer as you want to have their weather a single tap away. QuickWeather can even determine your current location if you allow it (location information is not collected).
QuickWeather is Always Free (No IAPs or Ads) and Always Open Source
Here's what you get
 Fullscreen Radar
 Current Weather, Temperature, "Feels Like" Temperature, Precipitation, Wind Speed, Humidity, Pressure, Dew Point, Visbility
 Current and Forecast Temperature and Precipitation Graph
 Current Weather Notification
 Weather Alert Notifications
 Hourly Temperature and Precipitation (48 hours)
 3-Hour Temperature and Precipitation (5 days)
 Daily Forecast Weather and High and Low Temperature (7 days)
 Daily UV Index
QuickWeather is powered by OpenWeatherMap.org or Open-Meteo . 
 If using OpenWeatherMap, QuickWeather requires an active API key with the "One Call by Call" subscription to the "One Call 3.0" API to function. If you do not have one, you can sign up for a free API key here .
 If using Open-Meteo, QuickWeather does not require an API key.
Required Permissions
 Internet - Required to connect to the internet and retrieve weather information
Optional Permissions
 Location - Required to retrieve the user's current location, if requested
 Background Location - Required to retrieve the user's current location for weather notification and alerts, if requested
 Receive Boot Completed - Required to reschedule the notification service each boot

fdroid:com.openrecorder.app.name: Open Recorder
fdroid:com.openrecorder.app.summary: Open-source screen recorder with internal audio and no internet access
fdroid:com.openrecorder.app.description:
Open Recorder is a simple, open-source screen recorder for Android with internal audio and a modern interface.
No ads, no trackers, and no internet permission. Your recordings stay on your device unless you choose to share them.
 Recording 
• Record your screen to MP4 files saved in Movies/Open Recorder
• Audio: none, internal audio, microphone, or both
• Internal audio and microphone are saved as independent AAC tracks when both are enabled
• Audio sample rate: 44.1 kHz or 48 kHz
• Audio bitrate: 64, 128, 192, or 256 kbps
• Video codec: H.264 or H.265
• Resolution: native, 2160p, 1440p, 1080p, 720p, or 480p
• Frame rate: automatic, 120, 90, 60, or 30 fps
• Video bitrate: automatic, 4, 8, 16, or 24 Mbps
• Orientation: automatic, portrait, or landscape
• Optional 16:9 letterboxing that fits the full capture without cropping
• Option to stop recording when the screen locks
• Countdown before recording: off, 3, 5, or 10 seconds
• Customizable file naming pattern
 Controls 
• Pause, resume, and stop from the notification
• Quick Settings tile to start and stop recording
• Keeps recording if you close the app
• After saving, watch, share, or delete the video from the notification
 Recordings tab 
• Browse the videos recorded by Open Recorder
• Sort by date, size, or duration
• Select one, several, or all recordings to share or delete
 Appearance 
• Light, dark, or follow-system themes
• Dynamic color (Monet) variants of each theme
• Adjustable page scale from 90% to 110%
• Optional predictive back gesture animations
• Optional floating bottom navigation bar
 Privacy 
• No internet permission
• No ads, no analytics, no crash reporting, no tracking
• Backups are disabled
• Other apps are not allowed to capture Open Recorder's audio
 Limitations 
• Android asks for your confirmation every time you start a recording
• Apps that block capture, such as DRM video or apps using FLAG_SECURE, can appear black or silent
• Internal audio only includes apps that allow playback capture
• Playback of independent audio tracks depends on the video player
Requires Android 10 or later.

fdroid:dev.danjackson.noisecancel.name: Noise Cancelling
fdroid:dev.danjackson.noisecancel.summary: Turn off noise cancellation on Bose headphones
fdroid:dev.danjackson.noisecancel.description:
This app allows you to quickly turn off noise cancellation on Bose Noise Cancelling Headphones 700 (NC 700) and Bose QC 35 (QC35) headphones. It also allows a (less-useful) change of mode on Bose QC Earbuds and Bose QC 45 headphones (but not able to fully disable active noise cancellation on these devices).
For example, the Bose Noise Cancelling Headphones 700 can cycle through noise cancellation presets, but these are on a scale from actively passing external sound through, to cancelling out external sound. In a very quiet room, any setting on this scale can result in an audible hiss, and you may not want any active pass-through/cancelling at all, but just the source sound. 
This app allows you to turn off noise cancellation, either in the app, or by adding a quick settings tile, or adding a single touch shortcut you can pin to your launcher.
Noise cancelling will turn back on if you alter the noise control settings on the headphones, or when you next turn the headphones on.

apple-macos:6777539170.name: Musing Notes
apple-macos:6777539170.summary: Download Musing Notes by RIPUL JAIN on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like Musing Notes.
apple-macos:6777539170.description:
Some ideas arrive half-formed — at a café in the rain, on a walk, the moment before sleep. Musing is built to catch them, and to give them back to you exactly when you need them.
You don't file. You don't sort. You don't tag. You just write — or speak — and move on. Later, you find any note the way you'd ask a friend: "What was that wine I liked?" "The café idea when it was raining."
FREE · PRIVATE · ON YOUR DEVICE
Musing is free — no ads, no account, no subscription, no credits. Capture, context, photos, and text search work on every supported device. Ask answers and semantic recall use Apple Intelligence on devices that support it — otherwise search stays useful without them. No server ever reads a note by default, nothing trains a model, and notes sync only through your own private iCloud — across iPhone, Apple Watch, and Mac.
SEARCH BY THE MOMENT
Every note quietly keeps its moment — neighborhood, weather, time of day, the kind of place. So you can ask by it: "coffee shop notes," "rainy day ideas," "notes from Traverse City," "late night notes" — or combined, "receipts from Oak Park last month." Instant, even offline.
JUST ASK
Search isn't a keyword box. Type what you're looking for in plain language and Musing surfaces the notes that match — even when you don't remember the exact words. Questions get answers grounded in your own notes, citing the notes they came from.
CATCH IT HOWEVER IT ARRIVES
Type a quick thought. On iPhone, speak a voice note — transcribed on-device; on Mac, dictate straight into the composer. Attach a photo and Musing reads what's there on your device — a receipt gets its total, a grocery list becomes a checklist. Check in to save a place. On iPhone: Home Screen widget, Siri, Shortcuts, Apple Watch, and the share sheet. On Mac: a menu-bar capture that never needs the main window, plus a Reading Room for asking and browsing.
YOUR PLACES
A quiet map of everywhere you've paused — most-visited spots and neighborhoods, on iPhone and in a dedicated Places window on Mac.
WHEN YOU RETURN
Walk back into a café you've written in and that note can meet you on Home — a quiet lock-screen banner too, if you ask. A year on, an echo: Time Recall brings the note back with the weather and the street still on it. Place Recall and Time Recall (Echoes) stay off until you turn them on. Hospitals, clinics, and places of worship stay unnamed, and never trigger.
FIVE ROOMS TO WRITE IN
Choose how Musing feels. Foolscap, Inkwell, Verdant, Dusk, or Harbor. Light and dark work in every theme.
BRING YOUR OWN AI SERVICE
Optional Pro Mode lets you paste your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key so Ask and web lookup can use GPT or Claude. You choose the provider, use your own account, and keep usage and costs under your control. Off by default — not a paid upgrade inside Musing. Capture, search, and tags stay on this device. Nothing trains a model.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sensitive places — clinics, hospitals, places of worship — are never named. Every context signal has an off switch.
NO FOLDERS. NO FEED. NO BUSYWORK.
Capture a half-formed idea. Find it later.
Free. Private. Yours.

ARX is able to handle large datasets on commodity hardware and it features an intuitive cross-platform graphical user interface.

fedora-packages:e00compr/e00compr.description: E00compr is an ANSI C library that reads and writes Arc/Info compressed E00 files. Both “PARTIAL” and “FULL” compression levels are supported. This package can be divided in three parts: • The ‘e00conv’ command-line program. This program takes a E00 file as input (compressed or not) and copies it to a new file with the requested compression level (NONE, PARTIAL or FULL). • A set of library functions to read compressed E00 files. These functions read a E00 file (compressed or not) and return a stream of uncompressed lines, making the E00 file appear as if it was not compressed. • A set of library functions to write compressed E00 files. These functions take one line after another from what should be a uncompressed E00 file, and write them to a file with the requested compression level, either NONE, PARTIAL or FULL. This is a metapackage that installs both the command-line tools (e00compr-tools) and the libraries (e00compr-libs).

firefox-addons:2730683.name: Android developer Cordova online for Android APK
firefox-addons:2730683.summary: Editor to create Android Cordova app that are run with the ApkOnline android emulator platform
firefox-addons:2730683.description:
This extension is an Android Cordova online editor that allows you to create Android applications online to be run on the android emulator ApkOnline, which is also an APK downloader to compare Android apps with yours. The extension provides an HTML text area, a CSS text area, and a JavaSCript text area to build your Android Cordova application. These text areas can be edited and any change appear automatically in a preview area that shows the final composition of the application that will be created using HTML, JS and CSS.
You must take into account that Cordova Android is an Android application library that allows you to create Cordova-based projects for the Android platform. Cordova-based applications are essentially applications written with web technology: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Note that Apache Cordova allows software developers to create hybrid web applications for mobile devices using CSS3, HTML5, and JavaScript, rather than relying on platform-specific APIs such as Android. In fact, it allows you to complete the CSS, HTML and JavaScript code. It extends the functionality of HTML and JavaScript to work with the device. The resulting applications are hybrid, which means that they are neither truly native mobile applications nor purely web-based. They are not native because all design rendering is done through web views rather than the platform's native UI framework. They are not web applications because they are packaged as applications for distribution and have access to native device APIs.
Moreover, the APK developed can be compared to others APK using the ApkOnline apk downloader, which provides millions of APK from Google Play Store.
With this extension, you do not need to install Android Studio to work due to the fact that Apache Cordova (formerly PhoneGap) is a mobile app development framework that can be used with any Android IDE.
Visit our website in https://www.uptoplay.net for further information.

Der Mistral Übersetzer ist ein praktisches Firefox-Add-on, das Ihnen ermöglicht, Text schnell und einfach mit der fortschrittlichen Mistral AI API zu übersetzen.
Hauptfunktionen:
Übersetzung in der Seitenleiste: Öffnen Sie die Seitenleiste, fügen Sie Ihren Text ein oder geben Sie ihn direkt ein und erhalten Sie die Übersetzung in der gewünschten Zielsprache.
Kontextmenü-Übersetzung: Markieren Sie einfach Text auf einer Webseite, klicken Sie mit der rechten Maustaste und wählen Sie "Mit Mistral übersetzen". Die Übersetzung wird dann automatisch in der Seitenleiste angezeigt.
Sprachauswahl: Wählen Sie die Quell- und Zielsprache aus einer vordefinierten Liste oder lassen Sie die Quellsprache automatisch erkennen. Ihre zuletzt gewählten Sprachen werden gespeichert.
Sprachen tauschen: Wechseln Sie schnell die Quell- und Zielsprache per Knopfdruck.
Übersetzung kopieren: Kopieren Sie die übersetzte Text mit einem Klick in die Zwischenablage.
Dark Mode: Wechseln Sie zwischen hellem und dunklem Design für eine angenehmere Nutzung, besonders bei schlechten Lichtverhältnissen.
Wichtiger Hinweis zur Nutzung:
Dieses Add-on verwendet die Mistral AI API für die Übersetzungsfunktion. Um das Add-on nutzen zu können, benötigen Sie einen eigenen API-Schlüssel von Mistral AI.
Bitte beachten Sie, dass die Nutzung der Mistral AI API Kosten verursachen kann, abhängig von Ihrem Nutzungsvertrag mit Mistral AI und dem Umfang Ihrer Übersetzungen. Dieses Add-on selbst ist kostenlos, aber die zugrunde liegende Übersetzungsdienstleistung von Mistral AI ist es nicht.
Sie können Ihren API-Schlüssel in den Optionen des Add-ons eingeben und speichern.
Berechtigungen:
Dieses Add-on benötigt die folgenden Berechtigungen:
activeTab: Ermöglicht den Zugriff auf die aktuell geöffnete Registerkarte, um z.B. markierten Text zu erhalten, wenn Sie das Kontextmenü verwenden.
contextMenus: Ermöglicht das Hinzufügen des "Mit Mistral übersetzen" Eintrags zum Kontextmenü (Rechtsklick-Menü).
storage: Ermöglicht das Speichern Ihres Mistral API-Schlüssels, der Sprachauswahl und der Dark Mode-Einstellung lokal in Ihrem Browser.
notifications: Ermöglicht das Anzeigen von Benachrichtigungen, z.B. wenn die Seitenleiste geöffnet werden muss, um eine Übersetzung anzuzeigen.

firefox-addons:2958599.name: Roblox Asset Downloader
firefox-addons:2958599.summary: A Firefox extension to download Roblox assets (images, decals, models, etc) by ID.
firefox-addons:2958599.description:
Download Roblox images, decals, audio, video, textures, meshes, animations or other assets directly using their IDs, with preview support.
As a developer and supporter of various Roblox projects, I often receive requests from my colleagues to retrieve old images or animations that are only available in Studio. This tool was born from my own need to easily access and download these assets. Now, I'm sharing it with the community to help other developers who face similar challenges.
Roblox Asset Downloader is a simple, fast, and efficient tool for downloading Roblox images. Perfect for developers, designers, and content creators who need quick access to Roblox image assets.
Features:
Multiple Asset Type Support:
 Images : PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP formats
 Audio : MP3, WAV, OGG formats
 Video : MP4, WebM, HLS (M3U8) playlists
 Roblox Models : Binary (.rbxm) and XML (.rbxl) place files
 Roblox Meshes : 3D mesh files (.mesh)
 Text files : TXT, JSON formats
Multiple ID Format Support:
 Plain numbers (e.g., 131316599669454)
 rbxassetid:// format (e.g., rbxassetid://3570695787)
 Full Roblox URLs (e.g., http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=6355578555 )
Smart Asset Detection:
 Magic number file signature detection
 Automatic correct file extension assignment
 Content-Type header fallback
 No more unusable .rbxm files for non-models
Rich Preview System:
 Image previews with full resolution
 Audio player with controls
 Video player with controls
 HLS playlist information
 Model file asset reference previews
 Official Roblox thumbnail integration
Enhanced History Management:
 View your recent successful downloads
 Quick access to previously downloaded assets
 Preview thumbnails for all asset types
 One-click download from history
 Smart text truncation for long file types
 Easy history cleanup
Model File Intelligence:
 Extracts asset references from binary models
 Shows previews of referenced textures/assets
 Displays asset information from XML place files
 Thumbnail previews for all referenced assets
User Experience:
 Wider interface (400px) for better readability
 Clean, modern design
 Hover tooltips for full information
 Responsive layout that prevents button overflow
 Support request and coffee donation buttons
Developer Friendly:
 Free and unlimited usage
 No ads or tracking
 Open source
 Powered by specialty coffee ☕
How to Install
 Click "Add to Firefox" on this page
 Confirm the installation in the popup
 Click the extension icon in your toolbar to start using it
How to Use
 Click the extension icon
 Paste a Roblox asset ID, URL (e.g., http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=123456789 ), or rbxassetid:// link
 Click "Check Asset" to preview
 Click "Download" to save the file
Supported Asset Types:
 🖼️ Images : PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP
 🎵 Audio : MP3, WAV, OGG
 🎬 Video : MP4, WebM, M3U8 (HLS)
 🏗️ Models : Binary (.rbxm) and XML (.rbxl)
 🔺 Meshes : 3D mesh files (.mesh)
 📄 Text : TXT, JSON files
Perfect for:
• Game developers
• Graphic designers
• Content creators
• Asset designers
• Producers
This extension respects your privacy and doesn't collect any personal data. Please use responsibly and respect copyright.

Classic Cars magazine is Britain’s longest-established classic car magazine and defined the world of classic motoring when it launched back in 1973. 
It’s packed full of great cars from the past, with inspirational human stories of pursuing, owning, driving, restoring and living with them, plus the latest and sharpest coverage of market trends, buying advice, events and news to help you enjoy your passion for classics to the full.

- Unlimited access to our archive 
- Access to rewards, discounts and prizes 
Features of the app we love: 
- Read or listen to articles (choice of four voices) 
- Browse current and back issues 
- Free articles available to non-subscribers 
- Search content that interests you 
- Save articles from the content feed to enjoy later 
- Switch between Digital View and Magazine View for the best experience

- Epic Restorations: talented craftspeople reveal how they transformed a neglected or bodged up classic into a stunning object of desire

bluejetty:00068939:ios.description:
Jump into a fun frog arcade adventure! Tap to hop across lily pads, catch bugs, avoid dangerous frogs and see how long you can survive in this simple, fast and addictive action game.
A simple frog jumping game
Guide your tiny frog from lily pad to lily pad with easy tap controls. Time each jump carefully, stay on the path and keep moving before danger catches up.
Catch bugs and keep hopping
Bugs help your frog stay energized, but the pond is full of surprises. Jump at the right moment, collect what you can and avoid falling into the water.
Easy to play, hard to master
Tiny Jumping Frog is made for quick casual fun. The controls are simple, but every level tests your timing, reflexes and focus as the challenge grows.
Game features
• Simple tap-to-jump gameplay
• Fun frog arcade action
• Catch bugs and avoid enemies
• Jump across lily pads
• Fast reflex challenges
• Increasing difficulty
• Great for quick play sessions
• Fun for kids and casual players
• Game Center
Perfect for short breaks
Play anytime you want a quick arcade challenge: on a break, while waiting, or whenever you want simple frog jumping fun. Compete for your best score and compare your results with other players using Game Center.
Download Tiny Jumping Frog and help the little frog hop, survive and catch bugs!

bluejetty:00152811:ios.name: One More Click: Love Money
bluejetty:00152811:ios.summary:
How much is enough?
Welcome to a strange little booth where every tap earns you more — but every click also changes something.
Meet Lumi, a mysterious host who reacts to your progress, your upgrades, and the choices you make along the way.
bluejetty:00152811:ios.description:
How much is enough?
Welcome to a strange little booth where every tap earns you more — but every click also changes something.
Meet Lumi, a mysterious host who reacts to your progress, your upgrades, and the choices you make along the way. What begins as a simple clicking game slowly turns into something much stranger.
Tap to earn. Unlock unusual upgrades. Watch Lumi transform through multiple faces. Listen carefully to the dialogue. And when the moment comes, decide whether to stop… or keep going.
FEATURES
• Simple and satisfying clicker gameplay • A mysterious story that changes as you progress • 14 different character transformations • Unique upgrades including Lucky Bell, Strange Button, Static Glove, Noise Box, Memory Dial and Black Switch • Story dialogue triggered by your progress • Choices that affect the direction of the game • 5 different endings to discover • An Endings Gallery that tracks what you have unlocked • Atmospheric purple-and-gold visual style • Replayable runs with different outcomes
EVERY CLICK CHANGES HIM
The further you go, the more Lumi changes.
His expressions, reactions and conversations evolve as your total grows. What looks cheerful at first may not stay that way.
UNLOCK STRANGE UPGRADES
Spend your earnings to improve your taps and unlock new interactions.
Each upgrade pushes you faster toward the goal — but some choices may have consequences beyond simply earning more.
MAKE YOUR CHOICE
Eventually, earning more is no longer the only question.
Will you leave when you have enough?
Will you make a deal?
Will you keep pushing?
Or will you discover something hidden?
DISCOVER 5 ENDINGS
Your decisions can lead to:
• Mercy • Friend • Deal • Greed • Secret
Replay the game, make different choices, and try to uncover them all.
One more click probably won’t hurt.
…right?

Find branches and ATMs near you

bluejetty:00174591:ios.description:
AI Chord is an innovative AI tool that generates guitar chords in real-time, corresponding to any YouTube song. With a continuously expanding library of chords across various genres and artists from YouTubers, AI Chord offers an extensive range of AI Chord, AI Simply Chord, Standard Chord, and Standard Simply Chord for any song you want to play. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced player, AI Chord has something to offer everyone.
Jamming with amazing experience:
1.Find your songs
2.Learn the chords with our smart chord score
3.Remix any tracks as your personal accompaniment
4.Happy Jamming!
Our cutting-edge artificial intelligence technology generates guitar chords that are accurate and in real-time. Furthermore, we go the extra mile by separating each song's tracks into vocal, bass, drums, guitar, piano, other instruments and metronome. With our user-friendly app, you can easily learn, play, and perfect your favorite songs. 
Our app Is the ideal app for guitar enthusiasts of all levels, providing the ability to master a new song in just 3 minutes, and leaving your friends and family impressed in no time.
Features:
- All YouTube songs available across different genres and artists
- Intuitive user interface with step-by-step instructions
- Adjustable playback speed for easy learning
- Advanced features like tempo and pitch adjustment
- Built-in tuner for tuning your guitar
- Customizable chord diagrams for easy reference
- Favorites and history for quick access to your favorite songs
With AI Chord, you'll have access to an extensive library of guitar chords that's constantly growing. Our app is perfect for those looking to learn guitar, those looking to improve their skills, or those looking to have fun playing their favorite songs.

PDF it All is an advanced yet user-friendly tool designed for seamless PDF file editing and conversion. With this application, you can effortlessly compress large PDF files, making file sharing more convenient. Convert a variety of formats, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, web pages, and photos into PDF with ease.
Whether you need to edit a PDF by removing or rotating pages, PDF it All has you covered. Merge multiple PDFs into a single file or split a PDF into multiple files effortlessly. The best part? Our app operates solely on your device, ensuring that all your PDF tasks are performed securely without relying on external servers. Your files remain 100% secure throughout the process.
Experience the convenience of multiple apps neatly bundled into one with PDF it All:
 + PDF Compress 
Reduce PDF file sizes by up to 90%, perfect for streamlined file sharing and storage efficiency.
 + Office to PDF 
Transform Word, Excel, or PowerPoint documents into PDF format within seconds. Simply select the office file, and let our app handle the rest.
 + Web to PDF 
Capture your favorite web pages offline by converting them into PDFs using our built-in browser – a seamless process in just three steps.
 + Photos to PDF 
Digitize your photos from your camera roll or snap a picture on the spot. Create PDFs from your photos in a matter of seconds.
 + Notes to PDF 
Craft your own PDFs with our rich text editor, enabling you to create complete PDF documents directly from your device.
 + PDF Editing 
Unlock powerful PDF editing capabilities with our app, allowing you to:
• PDF Page Removal
Easily remove one or more pages from your PDF by importing the file and selecting the pages for removal. 
• PDF Page Rotation
Correct rotated PDFs swiftly by rotating the entire document or specific pages with ease. 
• Merge PDF
Combine multiple PDFs into a unified document effortlessly. 
• Split PDF
Divide a PDF into multiple files by importing, selecting the split points, and letting our app handle the rest. 
• Sign PDF
Sign documents quickly by opening your PDF, selecting "Sign," adding your signature, and you're done. 
• Protect PDF
Enhance security by encrypting your PDFs with password protection, ideal for safeguarding private documents. 
• Unlock PDFs 
Remove known passwords from PDFs effortlessly, enabling you to share password-free files. 
• PDF Share 
Seamlessly share your PDFs via email or any other installed app on your device. Export to Dropbox, Evernote, Google Drive, Box, SkyDrive, and more. 
• PDF Print 
Print your PDF files directly within the application, ensuring compatibility with Air Print printers. 
Security is our paramount concern. Rest assured, none of our tools rely on external servers, making PDF it All one of the most secure PDF tools/creators available. 
PDF it All is free to use and you have 2 free daily conversions/tasks per day. If you choose to purchase PDF it All Pro+ to enjoy unlimited conversions and PDF editing, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Prices may vary from country to country.

bluejetty:00013690:ios.summary: The definitive comic viewer, loved by users since its release in 2010. Effortlessly enjoy your scanned books and personal files at home or on the go. Experience the rich features and seamless performance built on over 15 years of continuous
bluejetty:00013690:ios.description:
The definitive comic viewer, loved by users since its release in 2010. Effortlessly enjoy your scanned books and personal files at home or on the go. Experience the rich features and seamless performance built on over 15 years of continuous development.
■ Why Choose ComicGlass?
User-Centric Design: Packed with "must-have" features and granular settings for the ultimate daily reading experience.
Access Anywhere: View files from your PC/Mac, NAS, or cloud storage instantly, no matter where you are.
Broad Format Support: From standard ZIP and PDF to the latest WebP, AVIF, and 7-Zip, we’ve got you covered.
Buy Once, Enjoy Everywhere: A universal app for both iPhone and iPad. Get the best experience on all your devices with a single purchase.
■ Powerful Features
【Versatile File Management】
Easy Transfer: Use our dedicated Windows/Mac tool for effortless syncing, or simply use OS-standard file sharing and cloud storage.
Sync Your Progress: "Bookmarks" stay synced across devices via iCloud. Start reading on your iPhone outside and pick up right where you left off on your iPad at home.

bluejetty:00091021:ios.name: RecoverySky AA NA CMA Meetings
bluejetty:00091021:ios.summary:
Find a meeting. Online, in person, happening right now, or any day this week. Then prove you were there, with verified attendance reports.
RecoverySky is a meeting finder for AA, NA, CMA, and Recovery Dharma. It tracks live online meetings
bluejetty:00091021:ios.description:
Find a meeting. Online, in person, happening right now, or any day this week. Then prove you were there, with verified attendance reports.
RecoverySky is a meeting finder for AA, NA, CMA, and Recovery Dharma. It tracks live online meetings you can join in one tap, and more than 55,000 in-person meetings you can walk into — searchable by name, fellowship, day, time of day, and distance from you.
FIND A MEETING ONLINE
• See AA, NA, CMA, and Recovery Dharma meetings that are live right now
• One tap from the listing into the meeting (opens in Zoom Workplace — free, just have it installed)
• Every meeting's full weekly schedule, so you always know when it's on
• Filter by fellowship, day, and time — or just type a meeting name, city, or keyword
We keep the listings honest: meeting details are kept current, and every live listing is verified. When you tap Join, you get a room with others — not a broken link or a wrong password.
FIND A MEETING NEAR YOU
• 55,000+ in-person meetings across AA, NA, CMA, and Recovery Dharma
• Sorted nearest first or by start time, with the distance on every row — pick your own search radius
• Browse one day or the whole week at once, and narrow to morning, afternoon, evening, or overnight
• Every venue has a detail page: address, one-tap directions in your maps app, published contacts, and the full weekly schedule
• Your location is read only while you're searching or logging in-person attendance — never at app start — and browsing coordinates are never stored or logged
ATTENDANCE YOU CAN PROVE
If someone needs proof that you're showing up — drug court, DFS, probation, parole, a sponsor, or a treatment team — RecoverySky documents both kinds of meetings:
• Online attendance records the real time you spent in the meeting
• In-person attendance is GPS-verified: tap "I'm Here" at the venue, the app confirms you're actually there, then times your visit
• Your attendance becomes a clean, digitally-verifiable PDF, emailed straight to whoever's asking or yourself
Unlimited reports come with RecoverySky Premium ($6.99/mo), which also unlocks meeting reminders, encrypted cloud backup, and sync across your devices — and keeps RecoverySky alive and growing.
YOUR RECOVERY, IN ONE PLACE
• Favorite and star-rate your meetings — they float to the top of every list, on every day they meet
• Clean-time tracker and milestones
• Money-saved tracker
• The 90-in-90 challenge, with a certificate when you finish
• Meeting history and a simple picture of your progress
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your recovery data is stored encrypted on your device. We don't track you and we don't sell your data — the only thing we'll ever sell is the subscription that keeps the app running. That will never change. RecoverySky is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, and our platform is built and operated on HIPAA-compliant AWS infrastructure.
There's a meeting on right now, and another around the corner this week. Open the app and find it — we'll be here.
Learn more at recoverysky.app
RecoverySky Premium is $6.99/month. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.recoverysky.app/content/RecoverySky_Content/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.recoverysky.app/content/RecoverySky_Content/privacy

Whether you're writing an essay, preparing for exams (GRE, TOEFL, IELTS), crafting a speech, or simply searching for the perfect word, Pocket Thesaurus puts a comprehensive, lightning-fast dictionary and study suite right in your pocket — 100% offline.
_________________________________________________________________
FIND THE RIGHT WORD, EVERY TIME
_________________________________________________________________
• Extensive Offline Database: Explore over 90,000 common words, synonyms, antonyms, and definitions without needing an internet connection.
• Lightning-Fast Search: Instant results with typo-tolerant suggestions and wildcard search (* and ?) for words you aren't sure how to spell.
• Synonym & Antonym Powerhouse: Explore related terms sorted by relevance and part of speech. Tap any word to dive deeper into its linguistic web.
• American & British Variations: Automatically matches spelling variations (e.g., colour / color, analyse / analyze).

• Word of the Day & Week: Curated vocabulary drawn from top academic word lists to level up your language day by day.
• Daily Streaks: Build consistent study habits and track your learning streak.
• Worldwide Word Map: Watch live vocabulary trends and see what words language enthusiasts are exploring around the globe.
_________________________________________________________________
SMART & MODERN COMPANION
_________________________________________________________________
• AI Lexical Assistant: Ask our AI assistant for deep nuances, historical etymology, sentence examples, or tailored grammar breakdowns.
• Bookmarks & History: Save favorite terms into custom bookmarks and quickly review your recent searches.
• Home Screen Quick Actions: Jump directly to Search, Random Word, Flashcards, or the Word Map right from your iPhone home screen.
• Beautiful Dark & Light Theme: Designed for comfort with customizable font sizes, audio pronunciations, and native iOS Dark Mode support.
• Distraction-Free: Lightweight and responsive, with zero full-screen popup ads interrupting your flow.
Download Pocket Thesaurus today and discover the joy of finding the exact right word, every single time.

bluejetty:00089068:ios.summary:

Lonely Boy’s just your everyday kid, but he’s a
bluejetty:00089068:ios.description:
“Find a partner and work in pairs!” Do these words send chills down your spine?
Whether you said yes or not, Lonely Boy is full of relatable “lonely” situations you’re sure to identify with!
Lonely Boy’s just your everyday kid, but he’s a little bit lonely. Solve puzzles to help him find a friend in this heartwarming little game!
●How to play
・Tap all around the screen and see what happens!
・Get and use items
・Drag and drop items to where you want to use them
Want more puzzles? Come help the other fun characters in our Casual Escape Game Series, such as Shy Boy and Tall Boy! 
●Features
・Completely free and easy to play. Family-friendly fun for all ages! 
・Play with your friends and family - you’ll find plenty to talk about!
・Enjoy the many relatable everyday situations both inside school and out!
・The perfect mix of challenging and fun!
・Discover many delightful animals and other creatures!
・Not good at puzzle games? No problem! This game is for everyone!
・Solve simple puzzles and relive the nostalgia of childhood right on your phone!
・Enjoy collecting items? Over 100 unique stamps to collect!!
●Stage List
Lonely at Recess: Lonely Boy is all alone at recess. Help him join in the fun!
Lonely at Lunch: Lonely Boy wants to play with his friends…but he needs to eat his tomatoes, first!!
Lonely Field Trip: Everyone found a group to eat with…except Lonely Boy.
Lonely Theme Park: There’s no rule against riding the teacups alone, but...
Lonely in Art Class: Time to pair up and draw each other’s portrait!...But can Lonely Boy find a partner?
Lonely Weekend: “It’s a sunny Sunday morning! Won’t someone invite me to play outside…?”
Lonely Haircut: Lonely Boy doesn’t want a haircut that’ll make him stand out too much…
Hide and Be Lonely: Hide and Seek can feel pretty lonely when they never find you…
Lonely Theme Park 2: “This ride is SO much more fun with a friend.”
Lonely at Recess 2: “If only I could grab that beetle and show my friends…!”
Lonely Graveyard: Lonely Boy is left behind in the graveyard! But wait…is that girl over there lonely, too?
Lonely Dodgeball: Lonely Boy is the last man standing…can he find a way to turn this game of dodgeball around?!
Lonely Fireworks: “I was invited to go and see fireworks, but no one else showed up…”
Life Giving Water: “All alone in the desert...and to make things worse, I’m getting thirsty!”
Lonely Rice Ball: Everyone looks so colorful and yummy…except plain old Lonely Boy.
Lonely Musician: No one’s stopping to listen to poor Lonely Boy’s songs of solitude…
But I Hate Tomatoes!: Lonely Boy wants to enjoy eating out with everyone…but all they have here are yucky tomatoes!
Lonely Karaoke: Lonely Boy’s a terrible singer, but he wants to join in somehow...
Resident Lonely: It’s the year 20?? and Lonely Boy’s the last man alive on Earth…
A Lonely Fall: Lonely Boy fell down in public…how embarrassing! Won’t anyone come to help him up?
Lonely Patient: Lonely Boy’s all alone in the hospital...it’s not like anyone would come to visit him, would they?
A Lonely Play: Lonely Boy really wanted to be a tree with everyone else…
Lonely Christmas: A solo party for one is about to begin…
Lonely Desert Island: Lonely and in danger! Lonely Boy can’t just sit around and wait to be rescued..!
Lonely Thief: A four-man robbery! Only Lonely Boy was left behind…but can he manage to make his Great Escape?
Lonely Fish: “My only friend is my reflection in the glass…what I really want is to explore the open seas!”
Lonely Hero: Three heroes and three legendary swords! Alright, Lonely Boy, it’s your turn!
Scavenger Hunt Race: It’s time for the Scavenger Hunt Race, and Lonely Boy must search for…a “friend”!
Lonely at the Gym: Lonely Boy wants to gain muscle AND confidence…but first he needs to find someone to work out with!
Lonely at the Bar: Another lonely night…can Lonely Boy find someone to toast with? (With juice, of course!!)

bluejetty:00124298:ios.description:
Dive into a deep story of corruption, crime and intrigue. Take the role of gritty Police Chief Jack Boyd, and come face to face with the ugly underbelly of Freeburg, a city spiraling the drain. Will Jack reach his retirement with a nice stack of bills, or will he end up broken ... or worse? 
Manage your staff, respond to emergencies, and investigate crimes in a city on the brink of chaos. The mafia underworld maneuvers behind the scenes, sinking their claws ever deeper into the city, even as the mayor is ready to exploit every situation to his political advantage. 
Choose your approach to each situation as it unfolds. Sometimes you’ll be responding to a developing crisis at a crime scene, or negotiating with Freeburg’s crime bosses. Sometimes you’ll find yourself dodging questions in the press room, or even the occasional cross-examination in the witness box. Can you keep this pressure cooker from exploding, at least for long enough to stash away a nice retirement nest egg?
- Your mission is clear: make $500,000 in 180 days before Jack Boyd reaches retirement. How? That’s up to you!
- Decisions, decisions! This Is the Police is all about a dark story and how you react to it. Whatever you decide, your choices will influence the game – and the fate of Jack Boyd.
- The Good, the Bad, and... the Ugly? The Chief of Freeburg's Police Department deals with all kind of people. It is up to you to find the bad guys and decide how to deal with them.
- Carry out your duties. As head of Freeburg PD, Jack deals with all sorts of challenges every day: responding to emergencies, managing his officers, defending the department against City Hall and a corrupt mayor, and much more.
- Solve Investigations and gather evidence against the criminal gangs of Freeburg.
- Deal with the competing powers of the city. Everyone offers you favors, and each one comes at a price.
Rich and fully voiced story: Jack Boyd is portrayed by Jon St. John, the voice of Duke Nukem.

bluejetty:00180229:ios.name: SmartRecord -Track Body Weight
bluejetty:00180229:ios.summary:
It’s completely free! SmartRecord is a number one simple weight management App. With this App, everyone can manage their weigh easier than ever.
-----------------------
Features
-----------------------
- Rich selection of the items to reco
bluejetty:00180229:ios.description:
It’s completely free! SmartRecord is a number one simple weight management App. With this App, everyone can manage their weigh easier than ever.
-----------------------
Features
-----------------------
- Rich selection of the items to record
- Applicable for morning and night entry 
- Smart design for quick entry 
- All data can be analyzed in charts
- Security passcode
- Data backup in CSV file
- Pick and choose color schemes for your pages
- All functions are free
-----------------------
Items to record
-----------------------
The following items can be selected to keep your record.
You can turn off undesirable items as well.
Body weight
Body fat (% or lb.)
BMI (calculated automatically from entered height)
Muscle mass (% or lb.)
Basal metabolism rate
Calorie intake
Bust measurement
Waist measurement
Hip measurement
Thigh measurement
Muscle mass on right arm
Muscle mass on left arm
Muscle mass on right leg
Muscle mass on left leg
Memo (up to 10,000 characters per day)
Stickers
-----------------------
Functions
-----------------------
■Rich selection of the items to records and it can be customized
SmartRecord is available with many more items to records than other similar Apps. You can also turn off undesirable items, or change the units to fit your needs.
Depending on what type of body scale you use, body fat is shown in % or kg, but SmartRecord is compatible with both units.
■Useful stickers and memo
Stickers can easily be used to record something “GOOD”, or “BAD”, as well as to keep a journal of your activities like “ATE or DRINK TOO MUCH”, “REGULAR BOWEL MOVEMENT”, and “WORKOUT”. 
Addition to the stickers, memo function is perfect for freely keeping detailed information or records such as workout menus, dieting, or even daily journals. 
■Smart and easy-to-use charts tool
Line chart view can be selected from various period of time, from a week, a month, three months, a year, to three years,
The chart can be displayed horizontally or zoomed in and out with your fingers.
To see detailed data and information of each day, simply tap on the corresponding dot. You can edit or delete those data and information as well.
■Goals for each items
Numerical goals can be set for your body weight as well as for your muscle mass, waist measurements, and others.
The goals can be shown in charts as well to visualize how far or how close you are from the goals every day.
■Applicable for morning and night record entry
You can record your data twice a day, in a morning and at night, when you turn the function on.
The reminder system can be set up to go off twice a day, so you won’t be missing daily entries.
■Security passcode
Strong security system to protect your personal information and data.
It is compatible with the latest Touch ID and Face ID!
■Data backup
Your data can be exported to Excel’s CSV file.
To transfer you data to new iPhones, simply install the data from the CVS file, so you don’t have to be worried about losing your data.
Unlike the other similar App, this function is available for all users with no additional charge.
■ Link the Apple Health app
 Weight, body fat percentage, and BMI recorded with this app can be registered to the the Health app. Just by recording with this app, data will be automatically written to the the Health app.
 * How to set: Please set from "Write data to the Health app" on the setting screen.
-----------------------
Contact us
-----------------------
For any questions or concerns, please tap on “App Support” in the below to contact our customer service, or please go to “Contact us” section in the set up menu of the App.
SmartRecord is an App to support everyone out there who workouts hard to fit, to get in a shape, and to lose weight. We won’t stop improving it in order to become the best weight management and recording App.
Thank you very much for all your continuous support.

bluejetty:00142698:ios.description:
Indian Railway Live Train Status : Where is my Train
Now get your all Indian railway related enquiry with single app. Get train Current position with our app by train name or train number.

Live train Running Status - Search you train location or running status so you can plan your trip accordingly
Railway Seat Availability - Check seat availability for each train based on class
Indian Railway Time table - Search train timetable and route with train number or name.

Express Railway Ticket Booking - Book train ticket with the app and much more

The question bank covers these knowledge domains:

* Rules of the road
* Motorcycle terminology
* Safety best practices
* State laws

Privacy policy: https://driving.mapola.org/policy

Premium access
**************
You need to buy lifetime access (paid once) or subscribe to get access to all features (such as a random exam, timed quiz, incorrect questions review, bookmarks, etc.), courses and questions. listings.name: SyncFlow Health
listings.description:
Bring your Fitbit and Google Health history into Apple Health.

SyncFlow Health brings the health data you choose from your Google Health account, including data from Fitbit devices, into Apple Health on your iPhone. You decide what to sync, you can see what each sync did, and your existing records stay intact.

WHAT YOU CAN SYNC
- Activity: Steps, Walking + Running Distance, Flights Climbed, Active Energy, Resting Energy
- Sleep: Sleep stages (Awake, REM, Core, Deep)
- Body: Weight, Body Fat Percentage
- Heart and breathing: Resting Heart Rate, Heart Rate Variability, Blood Oxygen, Respiratory Rate
- Nutrition: Dietary Energy, Water
Turn each category on or off, and choose Daily total or By record where available.

SEE WHAT EACH SYNC DID
- Sync History shows when each sync ran, which categories it covered, and how many records it wrote.
- Get a notification when Auto Sync writes new data.
- Check recent syncs at a glance with the Home Screen widget.

YOUR RECORDS STAY INTACT
- SyncFlow handles health data such as steps, sleep, and weight on your iPhone and saves it to Apple Health. It is not sent to SyncFlow’s servers.
- SyncFlow sends sync results and counts to SyncFlow’s servers. It also sends the times of events such as the first sync, and whether Auto Sync saved new records. These are used to run and improve SyncFlow.
- Re-syncing is designed to avoid duplicate entries.
- SyncFlow Health never deletes data written by other apps.

SLEEP, STAGE BY STAGE
Your sleep arrives in Apple Health as Awake, REM, Core, and Deep, so you can review your nights alongside the rest of your health data.

LESS MANUAL WORK
Auto Sync keeps syncing in the background, so you don't have to open the app every day. iOS decides when background syncs run. You can always sync manually or re-sync a period when you need to.

GETTING STARTED
1. Connect your Google Health account.
2. Allow access to Apple Health.
3. Choose your categories and sync.

FREE AND PREMIUM
- Free: Steps, Sleep, and Weight from the last 30 days, with ads.
- Premium: your full history, all 14 data types, Auto Sync, and no ads.

SyncFlow Health is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google or Fitbit. Fitbit and Google Health are trademarks of Google LLC. Apple Health is a trademark of Apple Inc.

bluejetty:00027118:ios.description:
This is the original TAS Fires app and is designed to provide up to date information about bush fire data in Tasmania, Australia for iPhone, iPad and iPod users. 
The information is provided to you in both a searchable/sortable list and on a map to help the user understand which fires are of importance to them. The information can also be shared via social media/email and text.
It utilises data from the Tasmanian Fire Service RSS feeds on fires, wind data from the Bureau of Meteorology with your current location provided by the iPhone GPS. 
Using this information the application is able to provide a list of fires showing the nearest ones first, helping you to understand your current situation. 
The information is reliant on both the accuracy of the iPhone GPS and the data recorded on the TFS's website. 
This application does not cache any data, so Internet access (either Wireless. 3G or LTE) is required to access the data. 
Be aware that while P4G has utilised "best efforts" to provide this information to you, it is not intended to replace other sources of information on the fire situation near you. Also remember that fire and weather can change quickly. 
All data is provided Copyright from the Tasmanian Fire Service and the Bureau of Meteorology. 
Follow P4G on twitter at P4G_Apps

bluejetty:00041815:ios.description:
Superchill is your personal meditation audio guide that creates unique progressive muscle relaxation (PMR) sessions just for you.
Feeling stressed, tense, or having trouble unwinding? Superchill uses cutting-edge AI to create personalized progressive muscle relaxation (PMR) sessions that help you release physical tension and find your chill – literally.
What makes Superchill special?
++Personalized Sessions++
Every meditation is uniquely generated based on what you need right now. Choose your focus areas (shoulders feeling tight? legs tired? need help sleeping?) and Superchill creates a custom audio session targeting exactly those spots.
++Fits Your Schedule++
Pick your perfect session length:
Short (5-7 minutes) - quick reset
Medium (10-12 minutes) - lunch break de-stress
Long (15-20 minutes) - deep relaxation
++Smart AI Content++
Our AI creates fresh, personalized audio sessions by learning from your choices and journey. It gives extra attention to your selected focus areas, celebrates your meditation streak, and personalizes greetings based on your progress. Whether it's your first session or your 50th, each meditation feels crafted specifically for where you are right now.
++How it works++
1. Pick your focus - Select what needs attention (general relaxation, sleep prep, or specific body areas)
2. Choose your time - 5 minutes or 20 minutes, whatever fits
3. Get your custom session - AI crafts a unique experience with personalized audio guidance
4. Listen to the guide and follow along - Systematically tense and release muscle groups, melting away stress
++Perfect for++
Busy professionals needing quick stress relief
Anyone with physical tension from work or exercise
People who want better sleep
Those tired of repetitive meditation apps
Anyone wanting truly personalized relaxation
--

bluejetty:00063248:ios.summary:

Whether you’ve just started dating or have been together for years, Desire brings fresh inspiratio
bluejetty:00063248:ios.description:
Desire is the couples app that strengthens connection, sparks romance, and helps you create meaningful moments together — now powered by AI.
Whether you’ve just started dating or have been together for years, Desire brings fresh inspiration to your relationship with playful challenges, romantic ideas, and personalized AI-generated activities designed just for the two of you.
Designed to bring couples closer
Desire encourages communication, connection, and creativity. No matter your relationship stage, the app helps you keep the spark alive while having fun together — always in a respectful, intimate, and safe way.
Designed for real connection
Desire helps couples rediscover closeness, spark curiosity, and surprise each other again.
Powered by AI, the experience learns from how you play together, allowing recommendations and challenges to become increasingly relevant and personalized over time.
Features
• AI-powered personalized dares
Our new AI engine creates unique, tailored dares and prompts based on your preferences, mood, and relationship style. The more you play, the better the suggestions become.
• Thousands of curated couple challenges
Choose from a large catalog of categories that cover romance, connection, playfulness, communication and more. New content is added regularly.
• Earn points and level up
Complete dares to earn points, unlock new categories, and celebrate milestones in your relationship.
• Send eLoves anytime
Shake your phone to discover thoughtful messages you can send instantly to brighten your partner’s day.
• Couple’s private chat
Enjoy a safe and private place to share messages, photos (with optional pixelation), and stickers — only between the two of you.
• Private couple’s journal
Capture your best moments in a shared diary where you can save memories, photos, and everyday highlights.
• Badges & achievements
Have fun collecting badges together as you complete dares and milestones.
Platinum Account (Optional Subscription)
Unlock the full Desire experience:
• Unlimited access to all dare categories
• Unlimited AI-generated dares
• Chili level
• No ads
Subscription details:
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings after purchase.
• No cancellation of the current subscription period is allowed.
Privacy Policy: https://www.desire.games/terms.html
Terms of Use: https://www.desire.games/terms

bluejetty:00087452:ios.description:
Buy Bitcoin with cash and debit card - no bank account, no complicated exchange. With Coinme you can turn cash into crypto at stores you already visit, or buy from home with your debit card. Getting started takes minutes.
Coinme has been a licensed, regulated crypto exchange since 2014. Here's what you can do:
BUY CRYPTO WITH CASH
Walk in, pay with cash, and get crypto in your Coinme wallet - no bank account required. Fund your wallet at 20,000 trusted locations nationwide, including Coinstar machines and Coinme Cash locations.
BUY CRYPTO WITH YOUR DEBIT CARD
Connect your debit card and purchase crypto right in the app. Your crypto lands in your wallet instantly after payment clears.
SELL CRYPTO FOR CASH
Cash out when you need to. Sell Bitcoin, Solana, or Dogecoin from your Coinme wallet and pick up cash at 20,000 ATMs nationwide.
SWAP ONE CRYPTO FOR ANOTHER
Want to move from one coin to another? Swap crypto right in your Coinme wallet - no need to sell to cash first. Convert between supported assets in a few taps.
SEND, RECEIVE & STORE - SAFELY
Transfer crypto easily! Receive digital assets to your Coinme wallet or send them to other wallets. Enable 2FA for enhanced protection. Anti-fraud tools monitor for suspicious activity
TRACK PRICES & MANAGE YOUR PORTFOLIO
Follow real-time prices for Bitcoin, Solana, Dogecoin, and more.
SUPPORTED CRYPTO
Bitcoin (BTC), USDC, Solana (SOL), Dogecoin (DOGE), Ethereum (ETH), Litecoin (LTC), Polygon (MATIC), Chainlink (LINK), Stellar Lumens (XLM), XRP, and more. Availability varies by location and how you pay.
WHY TRUST COINME
Coinme was the first licensed Bitcoin ATM operator in the U.S. and has been regulated as a Money Services Business and state-licensed money transmitter since 2014. Today we power thousands of cash-to-crypto locations across the country.
FEES, UP FRONT
No guesswork. See a full breakdown of fees per product anytime at coinme.com/fees.
NEED HELP?
Visit support.coinme.com to chat with Coinme Support.
Mailing address only: Coinme, Inc. 600 1st Ave, Ste 330 PMB 77544, Seattle, Washington 98104
Coinme is registered as a Money Services Business (NMLS# 1185542) with the U.S. Treasury Department's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (""FinCEN""). See coinme.com/licenses for more info.

bluejetty:00185148:ios.description:
Welcome to the official mobile app of the Minnesota Vikings!
Featuring all the best content from the Vikings Entertainment Network, including the latest articles, videos, photos, and podcasts about the Minnesota Vikings. Download and view your tickets to a game, see gameday offers, get directions and parking to the stadium and more. Turn on push notifications to be the first to get breaking news about the team and choose what topics you would like to be alerted about when the next segment drops.
Features include:
• Personalize your home screen icons by selecting which ones you want to feature and have direct access to.
• News: Real-time breaking news from the Vikings, previews of upcoming matchups, postgame recaps and in-depth player features
• Videos: Live shows, press conferences, mic’d up and all access segments
• Photos: View game action, practice, travel photos and more captured by team photographers
• Audio: Listen to the latest episodes from the Minnesota Vikings Podcast Network
• Push notifications: From breaking news to important gameday information, manage your push notification preference to be alerted about topics that interest you
• Stats: Real-time stats and scores from the official NFL stats engine, head-to- head stats of the matchup, player stats, drive-by-drive stats and box score
• Standings: Division and conference standings
• Depth chart: Player rankings of offense, defense and special teams
• Schedule: See who the Vikings battle next and purchase tickets to an upcoming game at U.S. Bank Stadium
In-Stadium Features:
• Download and manage your Vikings tickets
• Push notifications: Turn on alerts and receive helpful information and
 exclusive offers as a ticket holder
• Get directions to the stadium, find parking and metro transit details
• See helpful stadium information or report an issue
• Ask Vik: Get all your gameday questions answered with the help of the
• Vikings Bot

bluejetty:00187864:ios.description:
I Di-appen får du nyheter inom ekonomi och näringsliv som ett kontinuerligt nyhetsflöde med de senaste händelserna i topp.
Välkommen till Dagens industri – Nordens största affärstidning. Av oss får du aktuella börskurser, valutor och räntor. Du får tips, råd och analyser av egna och inbjudna experter. Vi träffar entreprenörer från norr till söder och låter dem inspirera med deras personliga berättelser. Vi granskar bolag, affärer och makthavare och vi ger dig också vägledning i din privatekonomi och dina privata affärer. 
Genom Di:s avdelningar belyser vi olika delar av näringslivet, inte minst i vårt uppskattade helgmagasin Di Weekend och vår avdelning PS som håller koll på intressanta företag och heta trender inom mode, design, mat och kultur.
Varje dag ger vi också utrymme till våra uppskattade krönikörer, till exempel styrelseproffset Michael Storåkers, CSR- och hållbarhetsexperten Gunhild Stordalen, tidigare finansminister Per Nuder, digitaliseringsexperten Sara Öhrvall och klimatforskaren Johan Rockström m.fl.
För att läsa de senaste affärsnyheterna från Di som en digital version av papperstidningen hänvisar vi till vår app "Di e-tidning" som du också hittar i AppStore. Där kan du välja att läsa nyheterna antingen som tidningssidor eller i artikelläge.

bluejetty:00067936:ios.description:
Are you a big fan of Zombie Defense and Merge Plants Idle game? If yes, please get ready to grow the badass plants as a swam of Zombies is about to destroy this lovely garden. Warning! Monster are addicted to brains. Your mission is to defend and fight against these hilarious Zombie-zombi.
- Merge your crops.
Facing the greedy monsters, you can build a squad with various plants and flowers by merging them to unlock new crops. Don’t forget to power up attacks, speed up planting time before the enemies knock your door.
- Defend your Garden.
Be careful how you plan a strategy to combat the massive array of monsters. They will never give up until getting into your house! You need to grow seeds as fast as you can!
- Fun to play, simple to control.
Don’t need to pay anything except time. Yes, this is an idle merge game, everyone can get rich results even while sleeping.
- How to play:
• Unlock soil plots to grow crops
• Merge plants at the same level to create a new powerful plant
• Tactically move plants to attack zombies
• Use Super Boost to increase the power and attack speed of plants
• Shoot the monsters all down before they reach the finish line.

【用户好评】
第一次使用是朋友推荐，说平台上的医生很负责。于是自己也去尝试了下，当时问了自己的痔疮问题，医生给了我很多治疗建议，并且还开了处方药，使用后痔疮确实得到了改善，而且医生还建议我之后如何做些保养。现在身体上有小毛病第一时间想到在丁香医生平台上找医生咨询，不用再去医院挂号排队，方便快捷多了。

bluejetty:00182470:ios.summary:

There are millions of clever c
bluejetty:00182470:ios.description:
Join the world’s largest treasure-hunting community with the official app for geocaching. Whether you are off to find your first geocache or your ten-thousandth, this app is your ultimate geocaching toolbox. 
There are millions of clever containers called geocaches hidden in almost every country on Earth, just waiting to be found—there are probably even some near you right now.   Just getting started? This app walks you through the adventure of finding your first few geocaches. There are tips, hints, and instructions for geocaching as well as using the app. 
Core Features: 
● See details with description, recent activity, attributes, and hints for each geocache
● Navigate to the cache using map, compass, or driving directions
● Live Search continuously updates nearby geocaches as you move
● Find all easy Traditional geocaches and geocaching events
● Message other players for tips, hints, and more
● Learn about trackables: geocaching game pieces that travel from geocache to geocache
● Adjust your navigation and distance settings to your personal preference 
● Access to GeoTour caches of all cache types and D/T ratings 
Search and Sorting:
● Search for GC codes, locations, landmarks, and neighborhoods
● Search for GeoTours by GT code or see a directory of all GeoTours worldwide
● Sort by distance 
Trackables:
● Search for trackables
● Log trackables - grab, retrieve, drop, dip, or discover
● View your trackable inventory
Logging:
● Log a geocache now or save as a draft for later
● Add photos to share your adventure
● Improve cache quality by reporting geocaches that need maintenance 
Map Options:
● Street
● Satellite
● Hybrid
Unlock even more adventure with Geocaching Premium:
● Find any geocache in the world, including Premium Member Only caches
● Filter geocaches by size, type, difficulty, terrain, and found/owned
● Sort lists of geocaches by distance, Favorite points, or geocache name
● Geocache anywhere, anytime with offline maps
● Take the road less traveled with Trails map
● Plan, add, or edit your next adventure with Lists
● Award Favorite points to geocaches you enjoy most
● Auto-sync Lists and Pocket Queries created on the Geocaching website
● Gain access to all Premium features on the Geocaching website
We are committed to building the best tools for geocachers to create, share, and play this game. By joining and maintaining your Premium membership, you are helping to shape the future of Geocaching. In addition to your support of the game, Premium members also get access to more features, more geocaches, and more adventure.
You can buy a Premium membership subscription through your iTunes account. Premium membership is available with a monthly or annual subscription. You can subscribe and pay through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
Terms of use: https://www.geocaching.com/about/termsofuse.aspx

bluejetty:00040335:ios.description:
Every criminal has his or her judgment day!
and it’s your day to show your skills as the town judge. Send suspects to “heaven or hell” and serve as the angel of justice.
Now is your chance to be the judge and inflict your justice on a wide variety of cases.
Who’s guilty and who’s not...it’s up to you to drive to the truth!
You will face rubbery, fraud and murder cases which will require you to run your own courtroom, question witnesses, analyze and detect clues and evidence, read reports, and pass sentences and verdicts!
The town’s justice system is in your hands…
As the judge you will face moral dilemmas in every turn, guilty criminal masters will try to bribe you and acquaintances will turn to you for benefits and shortcuts in the tangled world of justice enforcement...the choices and decisions will be yours, what’s right and what’s wrong?
Again...you will be the judge. 
So don't wait another day because it is judgment day today! The guilty and innocent await your gavel!

bluejetty:00185173:ios.description:
Improve and train your memory while having fun!
Test your memory and concentration across 25 difficulty levels and compare your scores with friends and players around the world thanks to integration with Game Center.

The clock starts at 30 seconds and every pair adds a few more. Clear the board to earn 5 extra seconds before a bigger board is dealt, while your score keeps adding up. The run ends when time runs out.

Take turns on the same device. Find a pair and you play again; miss and the turn passes. Points count as usual — the highest total wins.

 - Sports
 - Food

 - Emojis
 - Numbers
 - Capital letters
 - Lowercase letters
 - Common words

bluejetty:00022258:ios.summary:
VioEdu - Học vui và chất lượng hơn với lộ trình học tập được thiết kế riêng cho mỗi học sinh. 
VioEdu là hệ thống giáo dục trực tuyến ứng dụng công nghệ trí tuệ nhân tạo AI và phương pháp học tập thích ứng (Adaptive learning) giúp cá nhân
bluejetty:00022258:ios.description:
VioEdu - Học vui và chất lượng hơn với lộ trình học tập được thiết kế riêng cho mỗi học sinh. 
VioEdu là hệ thống giáo dục trực tuyến ứng dụng công nghệ trí tuệ nhân tạo AI và phương pháp học tập thích ứng (Adaptive learning) giúp cá nhân hoá việc được phát triển bởi Tập đoàn FPT. 
VioEdu kết hợp giữa học online và offline. Chương trình học của VioEdu có hàng nghìn bài giảng được biên soạn bởi những chuyên gia giáo dục hàng đầu Việt Nam, bám sát sách giáo khoa của Bộ giáo dục. Hệ thống có nhiều tính năng ưu việt dành cho học sinh:
- Phương thức học tập thông minh giúp học ít – hiểu nhiều.
- Kho học liệu đa dạng được thiết kế độc quyền, gồm bài giảng lý thuyết – bài thực hành – nhiệm vụ - bài kiểm tra là công cụ luyện tập đắc lực giúp học sinh nắm vững kiến thức và tự tin trong học tập.
- Hệ thống video học tập thú vị, mô phỏng trực quan giúp tăng khả năng tiếp thu.
- Đánh giá chính xác điểm mạnh, điểm yếu của học sinh và đưa ra gợi ý học tập phù hợp dựa trên nền tảng các công nghệ hiện đại nhất từ trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) và học tập thích ứng.
- Theo dõi chi tiết lộ trình học tập và các bước tiến bộ của học sinh với báo cáo chi tiết và gợi ý học tập phù hợp trong mỗi giai đoạn khác nhau.
- Học online mọi lúc, mọi nơi, bám sát chương trình học trên lớp và nâng cao theo đúng trình độ của mỗi học sinh.
Còn chần chờ gì nữa, Tải ứng dụng ngay để tham gia cộng đồng học tập trực tuyến của VioEdu.

bluejetty:00178417:ios.description:
My OA Toolkit (OAT) is a recovery companion built for members of Overeaters Anonymous (OA). Work the 12 steps, track your recovery milestones, and strengthen your program from compulsive eating, all from your phone.
Built by Nathan, in recovery via the 12 steps since 1996. This app was created to support the kind of daily stepwork that keeps us grounded in the program.
Permission to use the OA name granted by Overeaters Anonymous, Inc. This permission in no way implies endorsement of this product or affiliation with its designer.
FOOD JOURNAL & PLAN OF EATING TOOL
Use the Food Journal to log everything you eat throughout the day, your personal plan of eating tracker. At the end of the day, email your food log directly to your OA sponsor from within the app. Review past entries to identify patterns in your eating habits and recognize what may have triggered compulsive overeating on a certain day.
GRATITUDE LIST
Build a daily or weekly gratitude practice to support your recovery from compulsive eating. Research by psychologists Robert Emmons and Michael McCullough shows that regular gratitude journaling increases happiness, energy, and optimism, all essential for recovery.
NIGHTLY INVENTORY
Complete your nightly review of the day as part of your ongoing Step 10 work. Consistent nightly inventories help you stay spiritually fit and maintain emotional balance in your recovery from compulsive food behaviors.
SPOT CHECK INVENTORY
When resentment, anger, or emotional discomfort hits during the day, do a quick spot check inventory right from your phone. Process difficult emotions before they build up and threaten your recovery.
RECOVERY MILESTONE TRACKER
Track how long you have been free from compulsive overeating, by hours, days, months, and years. A meaningful milestone tracker for your OA recovery journey.
ON AWAKENING READINGS & PRAYERS
Start each morning with Step 11 readings and prayers to set a spiritual foundation for your day. Enlarge your conscious contact with your Higher Power before the day begins.
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
* PIN Lock - Keep your recovery work private and secure on your device
* Anonymous App Icon - The icon does not reference OA, protecting your anonymity
* Cloud Backup - Your entries are encrypted and securely backed up so your recovery work is never lost
* No Ads - Ever. Your recovery space should be free from distractions
* Hardship Discounts - 100% hardship discounts are available, no questions asked. Just email nathan@myspiritualtoolkit.com
Spiritual, emotional, and physical recovery is achieved through working and living the Overeaters Anonymous Twelve Step program. There are no specific requirements for a plan of eating; OA does not endorse or recommend any specific plan of eating, nor does it exclude the personal use of one. For specific dietary or nutritional guidance, OA suggests consulting a qualified health care professional. Each of us develops a personal plan of eating based on an honest appraisal of past experience and current individual needs.

bluejetty:00092437:ios.summary:
