Put the power of self-care back into your own hands. Monitor you
bluejetty:00092437:ios.description:
If you were directed here for a research study, welcome! When you create an account on the app from the QR code supplied to you, all your study tools will be waiting for you.
Put the power of self-care back into your own hands. Monitor your health using Health Storylines in real-time and make the most of our 60+ customizable tools to manage multiple diseases and conditions in one place.
Healthcare is complicated but we are on a mission to make it easy and organised for you. We know how hard it can be to keep track of your countless appointments or the importance of having the right pill at the right time and we don’t want anyone to feel overwhelmed with their own health care regime. Our all-in-one tool allows you to track your vitals, medications, appointments, symptoms and moods in an extremely organised and simple manner. No more downloading multiple apps for each medical condition because Health Storylines does all your work for you.
We understand that “self-care” isn’t just one, pre-defined way to get better. It’s a complex road where YOU have the power to record, create and share your own health stories. We help you on this path with the following features:
Track everything: We have multiple screens and options that allow users to track everything from their appointments, medicines and its frequency, symptoms, moods and daily vitals etc. If you’re feeling unwell post a certain food you consumed, want to document how a procedure made you feel or want to keep a tab on your daily pulse, we’ve got your back!
Join a supportive community: You are never alone! We have a super supportive and engaging healthcare community who have similar conditions as you. If you want to share your experience, have any doubts or just feel low, reach out to people in this community and they’ll be sure to remind you that you’ve got all the support you need. You can also create your own circle of support made up of your peers, caregivers and loved ones and share your regular progress in these groups.
Health Progress: Not only can you track your data in one place, you can also easily access all past data and use that to draw comparisons and to understand how you’re currently doing. You can also download your personalized data in a CSV or PDF file to share with your doctor, caregiver, or to simply keep for your own personal records. Connect with Apple HealthKit to house all of your important health data in one place and visualize your steps, sleep, and heart rate along with your other health metrics.
Medical Treatment Adherence: In order to recover faster, we recommend you add personal reminders for everything. These can be set to any desired time interval and they’ll ensure that you follow your healthcare regime as precisely as possible.
Self Reflection: This app is not only for tracking your health and symptoms, we also encourage you to document how you feel on a daily basis via the journal tool. The expression of your thoughts is equally important on a road to recovery and by jotting down your thoughts daily, you will be able to better understand your progress.
Create Your Own Circles of Support: You are never alone! If you want to share your experiences, have any doubts or just feel low, reach out to people who love and care about you. Health Storylines allows you to create your own circles of support made up of your peers, caregivers and loved ones and share your regular progress with them.
Disclaimer: App only contains medication database for US and Canada at this time. Other countries are coming soon.
Learn more about Health Storylines at https://www.healthstorylines.com.
We love hearing your feedback and what you think of our app. Send your feedback, questions and concerns to support@healthstorylines.com

bluejetty:00085235:ios.description:
The Heathrow Airport App – Your Ultimate Travel Partner
Transform your journey through Heathrow into a seamless and enjoyable experience with the official Heathrow app. From tracking flights to exploring dining and shopping options, this app is designed to make every step of your travel stress-free and rewarding.
Create or log in to your account to unlock a personalized experience. Sync your journey across our website and mobile app, ensuring you never lose track of a flight, easily manage all your bookings, and earn Heathrow Rewards points every time you scan your digital Rewards card or make a purchase through the app. Redeem exclusive offers and vouchers with just one tap to make your time at Heathrow even more rewarding.
Features at Your Fingertips:
● Heathrow Rewards: Collect points when you spend, order Heathrow shopping vouchers with your points, and enjoy exclusive benefits effortlessly.
● Exclusive Offers: Unlock special deals for Heathrow’s shops and restaurants.
● Real-Time Flight Updates: Stay informed with instant notifications. View trip details directly on your Lock Screen with Live Activities or on your wrist with our Apple Watch extension.
● Plan Connections: Seamlessly manage your connecting flights.
● Skip the Queues: Pre-book a Fast Track pass to breeze through security, and pre-order food and beverages for ultimate convenience.
● Parking Made Easy: Compare options and reserve your parking space in advance.
● Terminal Drop-Off Payments: Pay or pre-pay the drop-off charge quickly and easily.
● Interactive Maps: Navigate the airport with ease using detailed wayfinding tools.
Whether you’re visiting Heathrow for the first time or are a frequent traveler, the Heathrow app ensures every journey is smooth, efficient, and enjoyable.
Download now and make the most of your Heathrow experience!
Permissions:
To provide the best experience, we require:
Location and Bluetooth Services: For wayfinding and navigation features.
Location and Online Identifiers: To send personalized push notifications and tailored content based on your location.
We will only use these features with your permission.
Disclaimer:
Heathrow Airport Limited and Heathrow Airport Holdings Limited do not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of flight information and disclaim any implied warranties regarding it. Heathrow Airport Limited and Heathrow Airport Holdings Limited are not liable for any loss or damage resulting from reliance on inaccurate flight information provided by this app.

bluejetty:00128283:ios.description:
Play drums and compose beats using high-quality, professionally sampled drum kits with Rhythm Pad. Create drum recordings by tapping on the pads or using the sequencer and export them as audio files. Play drums along with the songs from your Media Library and Apple Music. Rhythm Pad is the smartest way to play drums on your mobile device.
Introducing the Sequencer
Quickly put together drum patterns of up to 8 bars using the sequencer. You can also record your live performance directly on to the sequencer and edit your sequence to your liking. Save your sequences and export them as audio files.
Top features of Rhythm Pad
• High-quality stereo sampled sounds with maximum polyphony.
• Realistic Open and Closed Hi-Hats function.
• Recording feature - Record by playing on the pads or create new patterns using the sequencer.
• Quantization - Fix imprecisions during recording by enabling the quantization feature.
• Export your recordings as audio files (AAC or WAVE) and use it in other audio applications. 
• Apply built-in reverb and compression effects to process the drum sounds.
• Custom drum kits - Create new drum kits with sounds from other factory drum kits.
• Smart Levels - Pads sound louder at the center and softer at the edges.
• Optimized layout for maximum playability on iOS devices.
• Precise metronome powered by the Metronome M1 engine.
• Configure the volume level of individual pads.
• Rearrange pad positions to your preference.

Welcome to Magisterium AI, the world's #1 answer engine for the Catholic Church. Get instant, cited answers to your most complex questions, wherever you are.

INSTANT, FAITHFUL ANSWERS:

FIND INSPIRATION: 
Search for a specific prayer or ask for saintly wisdom. Get reflections and guidance from the breadth of Church tradition delivered directly to your phone.

Turn your commute or waiting time into a moment for learning. Explore theology, Church history, the Church Fathers, or the Catechism effortlessly.

bluejetty:00038126:ios.description:
Environment and Climate Change Canada has a mobile weather app!
It’s cool (pun intended), it’s fun, and it’s easy to use.
Get all your latest forecast information directly from Canada’s official weather source. Receive weather alerts notifications in your area, as well as in your saved locations, wherever you are in Canada. 
Key features:
• Current conditions, 24-hour forecast and 7-day forecasts for over 10,000 locations in Canada
• Never worry about missing alerts! Push notifications for all weather alerts issued by Environment and Climate Change Canada
• Weather information for your location (following you as you travel) as well as for saved locations anywhere in Canada.
• High resolution radar animation on a zoomable map background
• Today and short-range forecast widget for quick, at-a-glance weather information
• Accessible in English and French, and an in-app ability to switch between languages
• Message centre – interesting messages from friendly, human meteorologists
• Custom Air Quality Health Index notifications tailored to your unique risk level, depending on your sensitivity to pollution.
For more information: www.canada.ca/weathercan
By clicking "Install" you consent to the installation of this app and updates in the future. This app can be uninstalled at any time.

bluejetty:00161704:ios.summary: Have you ever had any experience of grand truck driving? If no then here is your chance to start an exciting journey with a heavy military truck. Its a dream of almost everyone to join Army, and save the country. You are an army soldier, be
bluejetty:00161704:ios.description:
Have you ever had any experience of grand truck driving? If no then here is your chance to start an exciting journey with a heavy military truck. Its a dream of almost everyone to join Army, and save the country. You are an army soldier, be like a perfect army brat and let the journey begin. You are experiencing to drive a heavy duty cargo truck, that belongs to army. And it is your passion to serve army.
Army Truck Driver Cargo Game is the game in which you transport cargo filled with things that are necessary for the war areas , and military use. Its your duty to relieve your brothers fighting for your country and provide them with things that they need.
You will see how Army Truck Driver Cargo game duty will let cargo truck transport goods and luggage to places where there is a severe condition, like drought, flood or earthquake. People rely on army and you, as an efficient soldier have to fulfill people's expectations.
Playing Army Truck Driver Cargo Game you could be assigned to transport army guns, tanks, heavy machinery, and army vehicles to the army base or their checkpoints. There are different landscapes like hilly areas, mountains and places that need more attention while driving, so be aware while you are operating the steering wheel, because, you are driving a heavy truck and any mistake could lead damage to your things, and you surely don't want that. You have to complete the mission assigned to you, stay attentive, because the areas you will travel to are very sensitive, there can be dangerous curves in high mountains, or complex roads leading to places you have never seen. After each level of game, the track will be long, more complex and difficult.
There can be other games like trucker game, army truck games, Cargo Truck, controlled speed games, realistic trucker, monster truck, tank war, tank racing and car jumping games, but the real fun is here, you are offered to play this game to compete with your friends.
Revitalize your army transport games, related to cargo, load the soldiers in your truck and take them to their destination. They have got their training and now they are ready to enter the battle ground and serve their country.
The major features of this game are:
 Truck drive simulation with easy to difficult levels and multiple scenarios.
 Truck driving in real war situation where truck driver is to drive at fast speed to timely drop soldiers in battle ground.
 Realistic army mountain hilly camp with check post, road hurdles, flying helicopters and pack of attentive army forces.
 Great environment. Particularly ice covered mountains, live snow fall and driving in rain are super beautiful scenes.
 Upcoming levels are difficult. The military driver is to deliver army commandos at check post in emergency and have to show truck speed driving skills on mountains pulpy roads.
 The game calculates driver performance and gives score at the end of each level. So you can monitor your truck driving skills and enhance by playing once and again.
 Dynamic HD graphics, with high quality sound.
 Free Simulation game.
Army Truck Driver Cargo Game is a very addictive game, with realistic scenario. Download and start to explore your inner army man. enrich your passion.

bluejetty:00169758:ios.description:
DS Cloud is an all-in-one NAS management tool that integrates video, music, and file management.
Now supporting Synology and Emby.
Features of DS Cloud include:
1. Video Functionality:
- Wide-ranging video format support: DS Cloud can play various video formats, including .mkv, .avi, .mp4, .mov, .rmvb, .wmv, and more, providing a diverse viewing experience within one player.
- High-quality video playback: Supports HD, 4K, HDR, and other video formats for optimal viewing.
- Subtitle support: DS Cloud supports embedded and multiple external subtitle formats such as SRT, SSA, SUB, with subtitle adjustment options for the best viewing experience.
- Picture-in-picture support: Allows users to browse other apps while watching videos with DS Cloud.
2. Audio Functionality:
- Supports mainstream and lossless audio formats, including FLAC, MP3, WMA, APE, OGG, AAC, DTS, PCM, WAV, etc.
- Displays music lyrics and cover art for a visually pleasing music library.
- Manages playlists and individual songs.
- Supports transcoding playback and playback of original audio formats.
3. File Management Functionality:
- Quickly browse and view file contents.
- Easily manage files with clear identification of various file formats, serving as a bridge between NAS and mobile devices.

bluejetty:00177154:ios.description:
A very realistic Spearfishing game with a challenging gameplay.
Start as a rookie spearo and learn spearfishing. Hunt fishes, earn money and experience.
Buy new items to increase your hunting skills and diving performance.
- Upgrade your speargun, wetsuit, fins, mask and other items.
- Earn XP while playing and increase your diving performance.
- Realistic fish behaviour.
- Every item your equip, effects your diving and hunting performance.
- Realistic underwater sounds.
- Various diving locations
- Target fish option. Hunt suggested target fish to earn x2 XP.
Game tips:
-Your oxygen level will be increased while you gain experience(XP)
-Since default gear is for snorkelling, it reduces your diving performance. Replace it when you earn money.
-Behave like you spearfishing in real life. Swimming towards the fish and chasing the fish won't work most of the time.
Game modes:
- Realistic: This is for real spearfishers. Fishes are very sensitive to your movements. Try to stay calm and still while waiting the fish. Oxygen level and consumption is realistic.
- Simulation: Close to real life spearfishing. Oxygen level and consumption is realistic, fishes can be spooked easily.
- Arcade: Easy mode. Oxygen consumption is much more slower. Fishes are much more braver.

bluejetty:00068044:ios.description:
Practice the art of cursive handwriting and letter tracing with Flourish - a unique calligraphy app for writing flourishing letters on your iPhone and iPad. 
Get started with our 34 free alphabet tracing letters, plus a sample of our original hand drawn 'Calligrams' and practice your lettering style. Become a calligrapher in no time!
Add flourishing cursive loops at the start and end of your words to give your letters an artful appearance. Then hide your tracing lines, choose a background paper texture and download your design! 
Use the traditional ink pens to experience the soothing activity of writing curly, swirly letter flourishes. Or if you prefer italic style letters, our flat head marker pens are great for drawing graffiti tag style art. 
Save your letterforms and calligraphy masterpieces to the gallery and return to them again. Buy the full app upgrade to write with a full set of coloured inks, unlock all the backgrounds, ornament borders, all tracing words and save unlimited designs!
THE LETTERING DESIGN PROCESS
- Tap the grid button and choose a grid size
- Tap the letters button and choose a tracing letter or calligram
- Move and scale your letter over the grid
- Choose a pen and color (Pro users)
- When you're happy, tap the shortcut buttons to hide the grid and tracing letter
- Save your work! 
PRO UPGRADE APP FEATURES
- 16 ink colors
- 20 paper textures
- 11 ornamental border frames
- 52 alphabet tracing letters (lower and upper case)
- 36 special tracing calligrams
- Save unlimited designs to your gallery
- Removes Watermark
EXPORT YOUR ART
Download an HD JPG image to upload to your Social Media, Photoshop or send to a friend. 
iPad Jpg size - 2048x1536
iPhone Jpg size - 3280x1536 (super wide image)
OUR OTHER APPS
Prefer Asian style calligraphy? Try our popular app Calligraphy Calm and get into the Zen vibe. Featuring different ornament borders and Chinese style stamps. 
Need to design a great logo? Get our apps Logo 7 and Logo King for iPhone and iPad.

bluejetty:00030263:ios.description:
A Pill Identifier & Med Scanner app is designed to help users identify and gather information about various medications quickly and accurately. The primary features of such an app may include:
Pill Identification: Utilizes the device's camera to scan and identify pills based on visual characteristics such as shape, color, and imprint codes. Users can take a photo of the pill, and the app will attempt to match it with an extensive database.
Label Information Retrieval: Allows users to search for drug labels by entering the medication's name or other relevant details. The app retrieves comprehensive information from official drug labels and package inserts.
Medication Information: Provides detailed information about medications commonly prescribed for various conditions, including dosage instructions, potential side effects, and interactions.
Drug Interactions Checker: Features a tool that checks for potential interactions between the scanned medication and other drugs. Users receive alerts about possible contraindications to ensure safety.
Dosage and Usage Guidelines: Provides users with accurate dosage information, usage guidelines, potential side effects, and any relevant warnings associated with the identified medication.
Condition Search and Information: Allows users to search for specific medical conditions, providing detailed information about symptoms, causes, risk factors, and prevalence.
User-Friendly Interface: Features an intuitive and user-friendly interface that allows easy navigation and quick access to relevant information.
App Support:
If you face any problems when using the app, please visit https://friendsapplisting.com
Sources of the information:
 * Drug Information (Source FDA) - https://www.fda.gov/drugs/development-approval-process-drugs/drug-approvals-and-databases
 * Drug Interaction (Sources National Library of Medicine) - https://lhncbc.nlm.nih.gov/RxNav/APIs/InteractionAPIs.html
 * Symptoms Checker & Diseases Search - https://apimedic.com/
 * Pill Images (Sources National Library of Medicine) - https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/pill_image.html

By using this application, you must read these terms. The contents of this app are meant for educational purposes only, and not for treatment or diagnosis of any health condition. Always consult your doctor or specialist before using any drugs or medications. bluejetty:00166770:ios.name: Valence 3D
bluejetty:00166770:ios.summary: Valence 3D is a powerful, beautiful, minimal, and easy-to-use 3D Polygon & SubD modeling app for iPad & iPhone. No matter whether you're learning 3D modeling for the first time or a professional working in design, construction, gaming, web
bluejetty:00166770:ios.description:
Valence 3D is a powerful, beautiful, minimal, and easy-to-use 3D Polygon & SubD modeling app for iPad & iPhone. No matter whether you're learning 3D modeling for the first time or a professional working in design, construction, gaming, web dev, digital fabrication, architecture, or spatial computing, Valence 3D has what you need to get started!
CREATE, IMPORT, EDIT & EXPORT 3D MODELS
• 25 primitive shapes are built-in & ready to help you start modeling: plane, box, sphere, squircle, rounded box, arc, circle, cylinder, tube, cone, capsule, torus, icosphere, pipe, revolve, helix, voronoi, text, super shape, noise surfaces, torus knot, faceted gem & tube. 
• Import existing models, reference images, lidar scans and room plans
• Imports: OBJ, STL, USD, USDZ
• Exports: PNG, SVG, OBJ, STL, USD, USDZ, GLTF, GLB
• Knife tool to create complex and detailed geometry
• Move, Rotate, & Scale gizmos make it easy to transform nodes, faces, edges & vertices
• Powerful modeling gizmos for extruding, insetting, beveling, poking, creasing & cutting
• Multiple selection & automatic loop selection help accelerate your modeling
• Tap on one of the gizmo handles to bring up an input field for precise transformations & mesh operations
• Robust snapping & alignment commands
• Selection operations: grow, shrink, select shell & deselect
• Mesh operations: duplicate, instance, set / center pivot, trim by plane, boolean, apply transform & subdivide
• Face operations: separate, combine, bridge, extract, poke, collapse, delete, dissolve, harden & soften
• Edge operations: extrude, insert vertex, collapse, dissolve, bridge, harden & soften
• Vertex operations: insert edge, dissolve, delete & merge
• Non-destructive & configurable mesh modifiers: mirror & subdivision
• Apply complex transformations using different gizmo pivot points & orientations
EASILY NAVIGATE & STAY IN FLOW WHILE DESIGNING
• Carefully crafted & fully optimized for iPhone & iPad
• Designed to minimize cognitive overload by only showing tools & commands that are contextually relevant
• Easily navigate to any part of your model by dragging and pinching: two finger pinch to zoom and roll, and one finger drag to rotate
• Pop into the standard orthographic views by tapping one of the handles of the orientation gizmo
• Use two & three finger tap gestures to undo & redo 
• Select components by dragging or using the rectangular selection mode
• Your work is saved automatically every two minutes and every time you go back to the gallery
• Get an overview of your scene’s structure from the Outliner 
• Long press on a node in the Outliner to easily rename, duplicate, instance, delete, parent & reorder any object in your scene
• Precisely adjust any node’s position, rotation & scale with the Inspector
• Adjust material properties, display & modifier options with the Inspector
STAY ORGANIZED ACROSS ALL YOUR DEVICES
• Preview, share, duplicate, delete & rename your models from the gallery
• iCloud syncing keeps all your models up to date, private & accessible across all your devices
PREVIEW, MEASURE, & RENDER YOUR CREATIONS
• 6 powerful rendering modes: Matcap, Modeling, Wireframe, Physically Based, X-Ray & Path Traced
• Export renders in any aspect ratio & scale
• Preview your model in AR in two taps
• Export your scene as a USDZ & be confident it’ll look consistent on all Apple devices
• Tweak your model’s material & see changes in real-time
• Tweak-able scene settings: camera field of view, background type, blurriness, intensity & rotation
• Get model measurements in one click
• Add persistent dimensions between any two surfaces in your scene 
PURCHASE & COMPATIBILITY
• One time purchase unlocks both iPhone & iPad versions
• Apple Pencil supported on select iPads
• 120 FPS supported on devices with ProMotion displays
• Path Tracing is supported on iPads with M series chips & iPhones with A15 Bionic & later
• Lidar Scan & Room Plan is supported on devices with a lidar sensor

Você não fará apenas o download de um aplicativo. Você fará parte da história do primeiro aplicativo de mobilidade brasileiro pensado para movimentar pessoas e cidades do jeito que você quer, com várias vantagens:
Serviços diferenciados
Além do Garupa Clássico, oferecemos mobilidade em carros de alto padrão com o nosso serviço Executivo, além de opções para transporte seguro de crianças, pets e entrega de objetos. Passageiras mulheres podem solicitar motoristas mulheres, e oferecemos, também, contratos exclusivos que garantem economia e flexibilidade para pacotes de empresas.
Mobilidade econômica e segura
Garantimos uma taxa justa para seu deslocamento, com motoristas capacitados e profissionais. Você também pode favoritar os melhores motoristas, para que eles sejam priorizados nas suas corridas e tornem sua experiência ainda mais satisfatória.
Suporte humanizado
Oferecemos suporte humanizado 24h para nossos passageiros. Qualquer dúvida ou problema que tenha, estamos prontos para te ajudar.
Tudo que precisa você encontra no Garupa. Vem com a gente!
Política de privacidade
https://www.garupa.me/api/politica-de-privacidade
Termos de uso
https://www.garupa.me/api/termosDeUso
〰 Garupa Clássico
Sua mobilidade de forma mais econômica e acessível, por meio de carros populares. 
〰 Garupa Executivo
Sua mobilidade muito mais confortável, com carros de luxo e com banco de couro. 
〰 Garupa Kids
A mobilidade da sua família com muito mais segurança, com motoristas qualificados para o transporte das crianças. 
〰 Garupa Pets
Serviço especializado na mobilidade de animais domésticos com toda segurança necessária. 
〰 Garupa Mulher
Corridas feitas por mulheres para mulheres. Você pode priorizar motoristas mulheres ou chamar somente mulheres, basta configurar uma única vez o Garupa Mulher pela foto do perfil. 
〰 Garupa Seguro
Serviço preventivo do app para que os passageiros e motoristas fiquem protegidos. 
〰 Garupa Objeto e Moto Delivery
Serviço especializado na entrega de objetos ao destino que você precisa via motoboy ou carro. 
〰 Garupa Empresa
Mais economia e flexibilidade para sua empresa, por meio de contratos exclusivos. 
〰 Favorite os motoristas
Por meio desta funcionalidade é possível favoritar os melhores motoristas para que eles sejam priorizados nas suas corridas.
Você não faz apenas o download de um aplicativo, você faz parte de algo muito maior, você faz parte da história do primeiro aplicativo móvel de mobilidade brasileiro que oferece a mobilidade urbana do jeito que você quer.
Viva a experiência de usar um aplicativo totalmente brasileiro, que está cada vez mais próximo de você, afinal te levamos a todos os lugares.
Tudo que precisa você encontra no Garupa.

bluejetty:00135055:ios.description:
O app Chá Rifa de Fraldas foi desenvolvido pensando em facilitar a vida das futuras mamães e papais que desejam realizar um chá de fraldas, trazendo comodidade e praticidade para esse momento tão especial.
Com uma interface amigável e de fácil navegação, o nosso app oferece recursos exclusivos que vão tornar o seu chá de fraldas inesquecível.
A personalização é um dos nossos principais diferenciais. No app, você pode criar a sua rifa com o tema que preferir, escolhendo entre diversos modelos disponíveis. A cartela é totalmente personalizável, permitindo que você troque as cores, fontes e muito mais.
O processo de marcar os números também é muito simples e prático. Basta selecionar os números desejados e marcar. Isso vai facilitar muito na hora de realizar o sorteio, que também pode ser feito diretamente pelo app. 
Você pode sortear apenas números marcados ou todos os números.
Após criar e personalizar a sua rifa, você pode compartilhá-la facilmente com seus amigos e familiares através das redes sociais ou por mensagem.
Além de todas essas facilidades, o nosso app ainda oferece diversos modelos de rifas para você escolher. Temos opções para todos os gostos e estilos, desde os mais clássicos até os mais modernos. E o melhor de tudo é que você pode visualizar o resultado final antes de compartilhar, garantindo que tudo esteja perfeito.
O Chá Rifa de Fraldas é o app ideal para você que deseja realizar um chá de fraldas prático, divertido e inesquecível. Baixe agora e descubra todas as possibilidades que o nosso app tem a oferecer!

bluejetty:00128018:ios.developer: ARA BEE EDUCATION & TRAINING COMPUTER SOFTWARE L.L.C
bluejetty:00128018:ios.summary:
Award-winning, affordable, educational language programme that nourishes your child with an enjoyable and innovative

bluejetty:00128018:ios.description:
Award-winning, affordable, educational language programme that nourishes your child with an enjoyable and innovative
approach to learn the Arabic language, in just 15 minutes a day! Watch your child's Arabic language proficiency rapidly improve
over a few weeks.
Exclusive features not found in other online language programmes:
*Structured programme
*Clever, modern teaching tools to maximize retention
*Ad free experience
*No previous Arabic language skills required
*Easy-to-navigate icons
Diverse Learning
arabee is an enjoyable and interactive way of learning the Arabic language. We have many activities children can explore to
keep their attention. As they progress through the stages, games become more challenging, stimulating their minds to absorb
the language with ease.
Created by Experts
arabee is created by educators and language experts using modern methodologies to ensure children retain their knowledge
and apply Arabic in real-life situations. We use Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) method when creating our language content.
Step by Step Journey
arabee starts the learning journey with short, animated videos that teach language structures, key Arabic words, and sounds.
Once your child has watched the interactive video or song, they play an online interactive game to reinforce what they have
learned.
Easy to Use
arabee is an Ad free child and parent-friendly app. Our navigation and icons easily guide you through the levels and activities,
giving detailed explanations along the way on how to manage tasks.
Songs
Sing along with arabee – our Arabic songs will keep children singing and learning with their friends in the playground and park
for hours. Songs are designed for children using carefully selected voices making it easy to sing along.
Games
Interactive & enjoyable learning educational games to occupy children making Arabic fun and easy to remember.
Interactive Books
Children can enjoy an interactive read-aloud storybook with a picture dictionary. Reading books is always a great way to spend
quality time with your child and encourage traditional learning.
Activities
Colourful worksheets and activity books keep young hands busy, developing their physical motor skills and helping with hand
and eye coordination.
Real-Life Situations
Using our arabee app, children can learn Arabic and use it in real-life situations like eating out, ordering a drink, expressing how
they feel, giving an opinion, or making new friends.
Research-Based
arabee is based on a structured educational framework, taking into consideration the language development of children at each
stage.
From Home to School
This unique multi-function platform is a fun way of learning Arabic and bringing the community together. Our interactive activities
are a great way for families to bond and learn Arabic.
arabee is used in schools and educational institutes in the UAE and around the world. The programme is designed for young
children to help them build a solid foundation in the Arabic language.
For schools arabee has online tracking and clearly defined outcomes, term plans, and teaching guidelines.
To see the Terms and Conditions, please visit: https://www.arabeelearning.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00171014:ios.name: Kakao T
bluejetty:00171014:ios.summary:
Kakao T innovates our lives to become more comfortable, fun, and valuable, without any concerns on mobility.
Use the mobility service of your needs, located on themed tabs.
• 'Home' tab: Main services and new services
• 'My Car' tab: Car
bluejetty:00171014:ios.description:
Kakao T innovates our lives to become more comfortable, fun, and valuable, without any concerns on mobility.
Use the mobility service of your needs, located on themed tabs.
• 'Home' tab: Main services and new services
• 'My Car' tab: Car driving/maintenance service for car owners
• 'Travel' tab: All services needed for long-distance travels
■ Fast and reliable mobility, Kakao T Taxi
• Request a taxi anytime anywhere in Korea
• A wide selection of Blue / Venti / Deluxe / Black
■ A fun way to explore around, Bike & Scooter
• Kakao T Bike, Get anywhere faster and easier with bikes & e-bikes for all
• Search and use scooters on the same map
• Return your bikes and scooters to any open spot
■ Data-based chauffeur service, Driver
• Just click to request a Driver on Kakao T App
• Call a Premium Driver who pays full attention to even the smallest detail
■ No more concerns! Effortless Parking
• Experience our streamlined operations from searching parking lots to processing payments
• Our availability prediction for parking lots will free you from concerns about parking
■ Bus, Train, Flight booking on Kakao T
• Just input your destination and enjoy our streamlined booking and payment flow
• Train schedules are available for all trains, booking service is only for KTX(Korail) trains
• Flight booking service is available for both domestic and international flights
■ Reliable Rent Car
• Reliable rent car options, with easy booking and payment flow 
• Car is delivered and returned at your preferred location (except for Jeju Island)
■ The easiest way for Quick(express)/Parcel Delivery
• Convenient registration at Kakao T app
• Delivery at your time of request, on affordable price range
■ Easier ride with pets, Kakao T Pet 
• Ride along with specially certified pet mates(drivers)
• Available at Seoul/Gyeonggi/Incheon
■ 'My Car' tab for car owners
• Driver, Parking
• Incredibly fast directions using real-time traffic information, Navi
• Request Car Wash and Car Maintenance service at your time/place of request 
• Smart Valet service without cash or waiting (via Kakao Navi)
• Check your car information and price for sale
■ 'Travel' tab for long-distance travels
• Bus, Train, Flight
• Organize and pay for a charter bus route of your own, Shuttle
• Easily request a taxi abroad (Available in Japan and Vietnam)
■ At work? Kakao T Business
• Taxi, Driver, and Commuter Shuttle for traveling on business 
• Easy and smart request for Quick(express) and Parcel Delivery
■ Easier payment, Kakao T Point
• Pay for all service charges with a single card registration
• Use and give away Kakao T Point for services on Kakao T App (limited services only)
• Variety of opportunities to get T points at Kakao T Point Town
※ Users may allow the following permissions to use the Kakao T service seamlessly. All permissions are divided into two categories – required and optional.
1. Required authority
1) Location is used for setting up pick-up point and destination
2. Selective authority
1) Notification is the necessary authority to receive various notifications provided by Kakao T.
2) Mic is used for setting up pick-up point and destination based on voice recognition.
3) Camera is used for recognizing QR codes and customer complaints.
4) Album is used for saving receipts that may be issued separately after a customer uses the service.
5) Bluetooth is used for connecting a mobile phone and a bike when a customer uses the bike service.
6) Contact will be used as the telephone information when you request a product.
※ Users may use the Kakao T services without granting optional permissions.
※ You can change the access level in mobile phone Settings > App > Kakao T.

bluejetty:00063471:ios.name: Colorful Gummy Blast – Match 3
bluejetty:00063471:ios.summary: Immerse yourself in a vibrant candy world and enjoy endless matching fun! Colorful Gummy Blast is a match-3 puzzle adventure that will satisfy your sweet tooth and relax your mind. Swap and match colorful gummies to crush them, create spark
bluejetty:00063471:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in a vibrant candy world and enjoy endless matching fun! Colorful Gummy Blast is a match-3 puzzle adventure that will satisfy your sweet tooth and relax your mind. Swap and match colorful gummies to crush them, create sparkling combos, and blast your way through thousands of levels filled with delicious challenges.
CLASSIC MATCH-3 GAMEPLAY – WITH A SWEET TWIST
Easy to Learn, Fun to Play: Simply match 3 or more gummies of the same color to clear them. Anyone can pick up and play!
Challenging to Master: Take on unique puzzle layouts and obstacles. Plan your moves to hit high scores and earn 3 stars on each level.
Tasty Combos: Match 4 or 5 candies in clever ways to create powerful boosters (like candy bombs and rainbow gummies) that explode the board in colorful blasts!
THOUSANDS OF LEVELS & COUNTING
Thousands of levels: Enjoy hours of gameplay with over 3,000 exciting levels, and new ones added regularly in updates.
There's always a new puzzle to solve!
Variety of Challenges: Each level offers a fun goal – drop cupcakes, collect gummy bears, break ice blocks, spread jelly, and more. No two puzzles are the same!
Progressive Difficulty: Levels start simple and become more challenging as you advance. Whether you’re a casual player or a puzzle pro, there’s a just-right difficulty for you.
FUN POWER-UPS & SWEET BOOSTERS
Unlock Boosters: Unleash powerful boosters like Candy Hammers, Bombs, and Color Swirls to crush even the toughest obstacles.
Combine for Mega Blast: Match two boosters together to create an ultimate candy blast – see amazing effects like gummy board explosions and big cascade clears!
Rewards & Bonuses: Earn daily rewards and in-game bonuses by completing challenges. Stuck on a tricky level? Use your boosters wisely to blast through and keep the fun going on!
RELAXING & ADDICTIVE GAMEPLAY
Play at Your Own Pace: No timer, no rush – take your time thinking through moves. It’s stress-free puzzle fun, perfect for relaxing breaks.
Bright & Cheerful Graphics: Enjoy eye-catching, colorful graphics and charming animations. The cheerful candy visuals will brighten your day.
Great for the Brain: Keep your mind sharp with engaging puzzles. Matching candies is a fun brain exercise that feels rewarding and satisfying.
PLAY ANYTIME, ANYWHERE – OFFLINE FRIENDLY
No Wi-Fi? No Problem! Colorful Gummy Blast works offline, so you can enjoy the game on the go or anywhere – even without an internet connection.
JOIN THE SWEET ADVENTURE
Embark on a fun saga with Colorful Gummy Blast! Join our candy-loving protagonist on her journey through sugary lands. Solve puzzles, overcome candy challenges, and discover new surprises as you advance. Whether you’re 15 or 75, you’ll love this addictive match-3 adventure that’s easy to play but hard to put down. Download Colorful Gummy Blast for FREE today and experience delicious puzzle fun at your fingertips! Get ready to match, blast, and savor countless levels of sweet puzzle excitement! Colorful Gummy Blast is free to play – no purchase is required to enjoy all the levels. (Optional in-app purchases are available for extra bonuses or to remove ads, but they’re entirely up to you.) Download now and start your sweet puzzle adventure!

Feature highlights*:
• AI Mode: Get AI-powered responses t
bluejetty:00124369:ios.description:
Download the Google app to find quick answers, explore your interests, and ask anything on your mind in any way. Try AI in Google Search with AI Mode, Lens, Search Live, and more.
Feature highlights*:
• AI Mode: Get AI-powered responses to your toughest questions with AI Mode–talk, type, or snap a photo to get started, and ask follow-up questions to dig deeper. You’ll continue to see a range of helpful links so you can keep exploring across the web.
• Google Lens: See something you like? Snap a photo and discover where to shop for it, find related images, and more. Refine your camera searches by adding words – whether you want those shoes but in ‘blue’, or want to learn how to ‘repair’ that broken bit on your bicycle.
• Search Live: Have a live, real-time conversation in Search by using your voice and camera to easily get answers and on-screen links to the web when you need them.
• AI Overviews: Get a snapshot of key information about a topic or question, like ’how to fix a broken zipper’, with links so you can easily explore more on the web.
• Hum to Search: Can't remember the name of that song? Hum the tune and Google will help find it for you—no lyrics, artist name or perfect pitch required. You can also search for a song playing near you.
• Discover: Stay up-to-date on topics that matter to you. Get personalized news, articles, and videos based on your interests.
• Google Search Widget: Search faster from your home screen or lock screen, with easy shortcuts to AI Mode, Lens, and more.
Google Search, totally reimagined with AI
• Explore a new intelligent Search box that expands with your curiosity, offers AI powered suggestions and lets you search with text, videos and more.
• Bring your toughest questions to Search. With a more seamless Search experience, you can go from an AI Overview on the search results page to asking follow-up questions in AI Mode, with links to the web.
• Get help with planning, researching, brainstorming new ideas, and more with the latest Gemini models delivering frontier performance for agents and coding.
• Bring your ideas to life by transforming your photos in Lens or creating images in AI Mode with Nano Banana. Available in select languages and locations.
Search what you see with Google Lens:
• Use your camera to identify what you’re looking at. Identify plants and animals, translate text in real-time, find similar products to buy, and even solve math problems with step-by-step guides.
• Translate over 100 languages on things like road signs when you travel, menus, and more by pointing your camera at text.
• Reverse image search: Find the source, similar photos, and related information for any image.
• Get step-by-step homework help on math, physics and word problems, and testing your knowledge with Questions and Answers are now fully supported within the Google app.
Search safely and securely:
• All searches in the Google app are protected by encrypting the connection between your device and Google.
• Privacy controls are easy to find and use. Tap your profile picture to access your menu and delete recent search history from your account with one click.
• Search proactively filters webspam to help ensure that you see safe, high-quality results.
Learn more about what the Google app can do for you: https://search.google/
Privacy policy: https://www.google.com/policies/privacy
Your feedback helps us create products you'll love. Join a user research study here:
https://goo.gl/kKQn99
*Features may not be available in all countries.

Why Changera?
bluejetty:00090060:ios.description:
Changera is an International money transfer app that lets millions of people send & receive money in Naira, Euros, Dollars, Pounds, Cedis, and Kenyan Shillings currency around the world in a very fast, easy, and secure way.
Why Changera?
Changera guarantees you a great customer experience and encourages you to take control of your money. With Changera you can send & receive money, and make online payments with our virtual cards with just a few easy swipes and taps on your smartphone. Buy airtime or data top-ups for your family and friends and use the app for bill payments in any currency, all hassle-free.
◆Send & Receive Money: 
Sending & receiving money from your friends, family, and business partners within African countries, the United States, and the European region has never been easier and more secure. Instant money transfer with competitive rates.
◆Virtual & Physical Cards: 
Changera Virtual Dollar Debit Cards are accepted on all Mastercard and VISA online checkouts pay points globally. Go cashless and access your money fast, anywhere in the world with our Virtual & physical cards.
◆Airline Tickets:
On Changera, you receive the best flight deals on the market, making it easy to discover new local and international destinations.
◆Events:
On Changera, you can manage your events seamlessly, from ticketing to attendance to revenue generation. The process is easy and simple.
◆Recharge Airtime & Data: 
Get Airtime and internet data for yourself, your family, and loved ones, or send it to your tribe, globally. 
◆Fast Withdrawals & Payouts: 
Skip the slow queues at banks and use Changera. This easy-to-use bank alternative saves you time as you will receive your money instantly.
◆Mobile Money Transfers: 
Enjoy quick & secure mobile money transfers anywhere at any time with Changera. Transfer money globally from your wallet without journeying from one Bureau de Change to another.
◆Pay Remote Workers:
Pay remote workers with Changera, anywhere, anytime. Our platform helps people and businesses accelerate payments to their workforce promptly and effectively.
◆Highly secured:
Your money is secure with us. Swift transaction alerts keep you up to date with every transaction made with your account. Changera has enforced multi-factor authentication to prevent unauthorised access to your online bank account.
◆Supported Countries:
Nig

bluejetty:00132097:ios.name: Sprite Creator
bluejetty:00132097:ios.summary: Sprite Creator is a very powerful and easy to use pixel art drawing app. Create and import sprite sheets, tile maps, or even animated gifs. This app has been designed to be a simple and powerful tool for creating pixel art for games or for
bluejetty:00132097:ios.description:
Sprite Creator is a very powerful and easy to use pixel art drawing app. Create and import sprite sheets, tile maps, or even animated gifs. This app has been designed to be a simple and powerful tool for creating pixel art for games or for fun.
Layer Editing Tools
- Alpha sliders
- Hide option to ignore layer
- Copy
- Merge down
Animation Frame Tools
- Onion skin
- Onion skin alpha sliders
- Live auto looping preview
- Copy
Exporting Features
- png, gif, or jpg
- Animated gifs
- Sprite sheets and tile maps with full control over number of rows, columns, margin, and spacing
- Single image series
- Set Background Color (allows you to pick a specific background color for exporting)
- Up scaling tool (increase the image size while keeping that pixel look)
Importing Features
- Import sprite sheets and tile maps and slice it into editable frames by setting width, height, margin and spacing.
- Import animated gifs
- Import png, gif, and jpg right from your camera roll
Selection Options
- Move
- Flip
- Rotate 90 degrees
- Copy (copies a selected area for the selected layer)
- Copy All (copies a selected area for all layers)
- Paste (pastes whatever you have copied on a layer or even a new project's layer)
Background options
- Checkered
- Color
- Image
Grid Options
- On/Off
Other Features
- Save/Load right in the app
- Create your own customized color palette with unlimited colors
- RGBA and HSBA color sliders to find the perfect color
- Create a new project at any size you want
- Edit project size after creating it
- Optional inspiration view (floating image from your camera roll for inspiration)
 - Tap and hold to load an image from your camera roll
 - Drag to move
 - Double tap to resize
- Preview window to see your pixel art at a small size
- Multiple brush sizes
- Line, Square and Circle drawing tool
- Hand Tool to make it easier to zoom and pan your canvas
For more updates and to see Sprite Creator in action check out our Facebook page.
https://www.facebook.com/spritecreator/

bluejetty:00147444:ios.name: Exempt
bluejetty:00147444:ios.summary: Exempt is an app that makes customs declaration simple by enabling all returning residents and visitors that travel to the Bahamas, to save time during the mandatory declaration process with Bahamas Customs, at all Bahamian Ports of Entry.
bluejetty:00147444:ios.description:
Exempt is an app that makes customs declaration simple by enabling all returning residents and visitors that travel to the Bahamas, to save time during the mandatory declaration process with Bahamas Customs, at all Bahamian Ports of Entry. Also, take advantage of its enhanced features, such as the Shopping List, Flight Tracker and City Guide.
WHY USE EXEMPT:
It simplifies the customs declaration process.
It is available for all travelers entering the Bahamas.
It can save time and money.
It is contactless and paperless.
Information submitted through the app is secure.
It calculates duties and applies exemptions accurately.
It automatically detects duty free items.
Duties can be prepaid before arrival via debit/credit card.
Spend less time on cashier lines and inspection lines.
Mobile scan feature that automatically adds items to C17 form.
Upload feature for purchase receipts.
Enhanced optional features such as:
Shopping List(s) (that can be stored and uploaded to C17 forms)
Flight Tracker (for tracking commercial flights, their departures/arrivals)
City Guide (directory and information assistance about travel destinations)
More efficient process overall.
HOW EXEMPT WORKS:
Download from IOS App Store
Create an account with secure login that stores your profile for future use
Scan passport information directly into the app
Add minor(s) to your account IF you do not wish to create separate accounts for them
Select C17 Form for Accompanied Baggage (complete a new C17 form each time you travel and have to declare)
Enter Travel Information (enter new flight information each time you travel)
Add any additional passengers traveling with you if you are declaring together, but NOTE: additional passengers must create an account and complete their profile before being added as an additional passenger on another account.
Upload receipts for all items being declared
Enter Baggage information, this includes:
Adding each item being declared onto your C17 form
(Save items to your shopping list for future declarations if you choose to)
Choose your Exemption Status (whether or not you are applying an Exemption)
Accept the Declaration Terms
Calculate duty once your C17 form is complete with all items added
Save the C17 form, which will generate a Mobile Passport QR Code to be scanned upon inspection
You will then have the option to:
1- Submit your C17 Declaration form to Customs now (from anywhere in the world before arrival) and pay the cashier upon arrival -OR-
2- Prepay any duties owed through the app via debit/credit card now (from anywhere in the world before arrival) or upon arrival
Review your receipt to ensure everything is correct
Collect your baggage, proceed to the Customs Inspection area and
present your Mobile Passport QR Code to the Customs Officer
Once Inspection is complete, exit Customs Inspection area
NOTE: MOBILE PASSPORT / IDENTIFICATION / RESIDENT VERIFICATION SUBMITTED TO THE EXEMPT APP PROFILE IS NOT A REPLACEMENT FOR YOUR PHYSICAL PASSPORT OR OTHER FORMS OF IDENTIFICATION. YOU MUST HAVE YOUR PHYSICAL PASSPORT / IDENTIFICATION / VERIFICATION DOCUMENTS PRESENT AS WELL.
LINKS:
FAQs: www.myexempt.com/faq
Terms of Use: www.myexempt.com/terms
Privacy Policy: www.myexempt.com/privacy

bluejetty:00119732:ios.description:
The leading video golf swing analysis app that helps golfers analyze and improve their swings with advanced tools like Ball Tracing and Skeletal Tracking, plus access to online coaching from real instructors. Improve anytime, anywhere with V1 GOLF.
Easily capture and review your golf swings, with sessions automatically saved to the cloud. Review, analyze, and compare your full swing, short game, and putting stroke using powerful playback and analysis tools. Access the largest model swing library available, which includes PGA, LIV, and LPGA professional model swings.
NEW: Coaching Memberships allow golfers to access ongoing online coaching from real coaches. Receive professional swing analysis, schedule live video coaching sessions, and chat directly with your coach inside the app. New golfers can try online coaching free with a FREE QuickFix and experience the value of online coaching first hand.
Or, connect with your existing instructor. V1 GOLF makes it easy to send your videos and receive a complete swing analysis or a full virtual lesson.
NEW: Want deeper insights into your swing? V1 GOLF now includes enhanced analysis tools including Ball Tracing and Skeletal Tracking. Ball Tracing allows you to visualize your golf ball flight path directly from video WITHOUT a radar. Skeletal Tracking helps identify subtle body movements and shifts that clothing can hide, giving you a more in-depth look at your mechanics. 
V1 GOLF also integrates with ground pressure sensors for total swing analysis that reveals how you apply pressure in your feet through every phase of your swing.
COACHES: Download the V1 COACH app to grow your business, connect with your students, and deliver online lessons. Whether you're building your brand, streamlining your workflow, or sharing your passion with golfers around the world, V1 COACH gives you the tools and platform to do more of what you love. 
Top rated in-app support teams are standing by to provide assistance or answer questions. 
ANALYZE YOUR GOLF SWING
• Trim, playback, accelerate to key positions, view frame-by-frame
• Drawing tools to measure and highlight key movement and positions
• Compare two golf swings side by side or Overlay two videos for closer comparison
• Use Skeletal Tracking to see key positions more clearly 
• Golf Ball Tracing can be applied to any down-the-line swing to see flight path of your ball 
RECEIVE LESSONS FROM A COACH
• Find a new coach or accept an invitation from your existing coach
• Send golf swings directly via the app to your coach
• Receive lessons with voiceover, telestration, and drills
• Chat or video call your coach for live feedback
PRO MODEL SWING & DRILL LIBRARY
• Model swings from current and past leading professional golfers and major winners
• Use the analyzer tools to play, measure and highlight model swings and key positions
• Use compare and overlay tools to compare your swing to your favorite pros
• Access golf swing drills and golf tips content from industry leading instructors
• Video content on swing movements, tempo, short game, lag putting & much more.
GROUND PRESSURE 
• Add ground pressure analysis to your video analysis when you integrate with Ground Pressure Sensors
• Train with feedback that professional golfers use every session, or share it with your coach

• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase

bluejetty:00165975:ios.name: Boxing Training: Bag Workouts
bluejetty:00165975:ios.summary: Heavy Bag Pro is an innovative app for punching bag and shadow boxing training, designed to cater to fighters at every level. We understand the challenge: training alone with a punching bag can be tough. Even the most seasoned fighters can
bluejetty:00165975:ios.description:
Heavy Bag Pro is an innovative app for punching bag and shadow boxing training, designed to cater to fighters at every level. We understand the challenge: training alone with a punching bag can be tough. Even the most seasoned fighters can run out of ideas and lose motivation. The hurdle for beginners starting to learn boxing techniques and combinations is even greater. Heavy Bag Pro is here to change that, offering a vital boost to your training routine.
Heavy Bag Pro: Your Virtual Coach
* For Home Warriors and Solo Fighters: Perfect for those days you're training solo at home or in the gym. No more dull, aimless sessions.
* The Problem Solved: Say goodbye to the lack of motivation and ideas. Heavy Bag Pro is like having a coach in your pocket, providing the inspiration, ideas, and direction you need.
* Professional Fighter Expertise: Each workout is meticulously crafted by professional fighters, ensuring logical, purposeful, and effective training sessions.
* Focus on Training: With Heavy Bag Pro, you don't have to think about what's next. Just start the app and immerse yourself in practical training.
* Learn and Grow: New to boxing or kickboxing? Heavy Bag Pro offers 1000+ combos and techniques to build your skills from the ground up.
* Boost Advanced Training: Seasoned fighters, boost your workouts with diverse, challenging routines that keep your skills sharp and your mind engaged.
* Diverse Training: There are workouts for learning combos, high-intensity training (HIIT), power punches, bodyweight-integrated sessions, and much more. Just choose what you like. 
* Extremely Efficient Boxing Workouts: Our goal is for you to sweat, enjoy, and learn simultaneously. Each Heavy Bag Pro workout is crafted to deliver these elements, ensuring a fulfilling and efficient training experience.
* For All Combat Sports: Workouts are categorized into boxing, kickboxing, and Muay Thai. But they are also suitable for practitioners of MMA, Jiu-Jitsu, Karate, Taekwondo, or any other type of martial arts.
Crafted by Experts, Trusted by Fighters
Every aspect of Heavy Bag Pro, from the app's design to each workout, has been carefully developed by professionals in boxing and martial arts. This isn't just an app; it's a culmination of expert knowledge and practical experience. Our team comprises seasoned fighters and trainers who understand what it takes to excel in combat sports. They've poured their insights into creating workouts that not only challenge and engage but also ensure that you're training the right way. With Heavy Bag Pro, you're not just following a set of exercises; you're embracing a training methodology that's been honed and validated by professionals. Whether it's refining your technique, building stamina, or learning new combos, you can trust that every element of your training has been crafted with precision and expertise.
Is the app free?
There are two versions: free and premium. The free version gives three full workouts (one in every discipline) and an interval round timer (without ads). If you want to unlock all the workouts and other features and exercises, you'll need to upgrade to premium. A monthly subscription costs less than a one-time visit to most gyms.
Do I Need a Punching Bag?
While a heavy bag is helpful, it's not absolutely necessary to be able to train hard with the app. You can use the app to do shadowboxing at home, then already know the combos you want to master on a boxing bag or during sparring when you hit the gym. Tip: For sweaty, challenging kickboxing training and great cardio, try shadowboxing with weights in your hands!
If you're serious about getting a leg up on your competition, you need this boxing app. Not only does it up your motivation with fun, guided punching bag home workouts, but it also helps you master the combos that will outsmart your competition. 
Terms and Conditions: https://heavybag.pro/app-terms/
Privacy Policy: https://heavybag.pro/app-privacy-policy/

Racing Games for Kids – Fun, Educational, and Thrilling Adventures Await!
Ready, set, race! Welcome to the exciting world of Racing games for kids, specially designed to ignite the imaginations of little drivers. Packed with action, fun, and friendly competition, this child-friendly racing game is perfect for toddlers, preschoolers, and kids of all ages!
Why Kids (and Parents!) Love Our Racing Game:
• 36 Cool & Cartoon Racing Cars! Kids can choose from supercars, jeeps, rocket cars, and more! Customizable and colorful, each car captures your child’s creativity.
• 72 Unique Tracks & 6 Amazing Worlds Race through vibrant cities, sunny seaside towns, thrilling deserts, snowy mountains, futuristic Tech City, and even outer space!
• Educational Racing Games for Fun Learning Encourage strategic thinking and fine motor skills as kids master 54 exciting racing abilities—like playful tornadoes and bouncing penguins!

Track orders in progress, resolve issues, access Support, keep track of your business performance, and get real-time notifications on DoorDash. 
TRACK LIVE ORDERS
Manage in-progress orders and see your Dasher's status, location, and arrival time. Mark an item out of stock or cancel an order if you’re having trouble fulfilling it. Call your customer or Dasher if there are any order issues, and chat with or call DoorDash Support anytime.

View daily, weekly, and monthly performance recaps and get insights into your top-performing menu items on DoorDash. 
USE WITH THE ORDER MANAGER TABLET APP or POS 
The Business Manager app complements your existing order protocol. If you’d like to receive, confirm, and manage orders please continue to use your Order Manager tablet app, point-of-sale (POS), email, or fax protocols.

bluejetty:00126365:ios.description:
- Welcome to Marine Weather – Your Ultimate Maritime Companion -
Marine Weather is the essential app for everyone heading out to the water. Whether you’re a sailor navigating the open sea, a fisherman seeking the perfect catch, a surfer chasing the best waves, or a kiteboarder looking for optimal wind conditions, this app provides the tools and information you need to stay informed and safe.
With accurate and real-time wind, wave, and weather predictions, Marine Weather ensures you are always prepared for your maritime adventures. Designed with a professional and intuitive user interface, the app offers a seamless experience, allowing you to access critical information quickly and efficiently.
- Key Features to Elevate Your Maritime Experience -
Accurate Wind, Wave, and Weather Predictions:
Stay informed with reliable and up-to-date forecasts for wind, waves, and weather conditions. Marine Weather ensures you have the data needed to make informed decisions, whether you’re planning a quick trip or a multi-day voyage.
Intuitive Wind, Wave, and Weather Charts:
Visualize the conditions in real-time with detailed and easy-to-read charts. These charts provide a clear and concise overview, making it simple to assess current conditions at a glance and plan accordingly.
Effortless Station Search with Custom Suggestions:
Find nearby buoy stations or search for specific locations with ease. Can’t find what you’re looking for? Suggest new stations directly within the app to expand its reach and usefulness.
Manage Your Favorite Stations for Quick Access:
Save your most-used stations to your favorites for faster access. This feature is perfect for regular users who need to check the same locations repeatedly without searching every time.
Comprehensive Map of Buoy Stations:
Access a detailed map displaying all available buoy stations. Whether you’re planning a coastal trip or exploring offshore, this feature provides a clear view of conditions across a wide area.
Customizable Subscription Plans:
Unlock additional features and functionality with flexible subscription options. Tailor the app to your needs with plans that enhance your experience and provide premium tools for advanced forecasting.
- Why Choose Marine Weather? -
Marine Weather isn’t just another weather app – it’s your go-to resource for maritime safety and planning. Whether you’re navigating, fishing, surfing, or just enjoying a day on the water, Marine Weather empowers you with real-time information and actionable insights.
Here’s what makes Marine Weather stand out:
Comprehensive and reliable data for wind, swell, and weather.
A user-friendly design that prioritizes simplicity and clarity.
Tools tailored to meet the needs of water sports enthusiasts, fishermen, and sailors alike.
Customizable features that let you optimize the app for your specific activities.
Regular updates to ensure accuracy and reliability.
- Perfect for All Water Enthusiasts -
Marine Weather is the ideal companion for:
Sailors: Navigate safely with real-time wind and wave updates.
Fishermen: Plan your trips with accurate weather data.
Surfers: Find the best swell conditions for your next ride.
Kiteboarders: Optimize your sessions with precise wind predictions.
Maritime Professionals: Stay prepared with detailed weather insights.
- Subscription Plans for Enhanced Features -
Marine Weather offers flexible subscription options designed to enhance your experience. Unlock premium features like advanced forecasting tools, additional data layers, and more to ensure you have everything you need for your time on the water.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/marineweatherios/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://zipoapps.com/marineweatherios/terms/

bluejetty:00021774:ios.summary:
Separate vocals, drums, bass and other instruments out of your music library with fast on-device deep learning model and play it as karaoke or backing track.
MuziUnmix not only splits music tracks but provides high quality audio effects in
bluejetty:00021774:ios.description:
Separate vocals, drums, bass and other instruments out of your music library with fast on-device deep learning model and play it as karaoke or backing track.
MuziUnmix not only splits music tracks but provides high quality audio effects including equalizer, slowdowner and pitch changer.
Feel excited to sing with music! MuziUnmix has in-app microphone recording with reverb effect as superstar. It also supports file exporting with pitch, playing rate and mixer settings. Just find recording and exporting result in specified MuziUnmix folder of "Files" app and easily to share to social platform or friends.
Want to sing or play with video for watching lyrics or instrument practice? No problem, MuziUnmix also keeps video frames from media and is able to display on different playing rate. It's amazing. 
Various of music sources that can be imported:
- iTunes Music Library: Your purchase or synced music with computer.
- "Files" app: Music or video files stored in other apps including cloud storage like Google Drive.
- Photo Library: Your camera capture or YouTube, Spotify screen recording is located here.
For pro iOS musician, MuziUnmix supports inter-app-audio(IAA) ecosystem to which tons of iOS music apps adopt. By using IAA, iOS musician can play MuziUnmix music along with your plugin instrument, guitar, bass, midi keyboard, or electronic drum and external microphone, directly streaming to pro music effects and DAW like GarageBand for recording, DJ mixing and jamming, really rock. In addition, MuziUnmix also integrates essential IAA host, Audiobus, to open unlimited creative worlds that only MuziUnmix can easily do.
Main features include:
- Separate vocals , drums, bass, and background tracks.
- 3-band equalizer
- 0.5X~2X speed rate change
- +/- 6 semitone pitch adjustment
- A/B loop setting
- Microphone volume monitoring and recording with reverb effect
- Export and save result with pitch, play rate and mixer settings
- Video play
- Maximum importing length of song is 20 mins
- IAA and Audiobus support

bluejetty:00033477:ios.description:
Tele Messenger: Fast, Reliable, and Synced Messaging Across Your Devices
Tele Messenger is an UNOFFICIAL messaging app built using the Telegram API, offering a fast, reliable, and seamlessly synced messaging experience across your devices.
Designed to make everyday messaging more convenient, Tele Messenger includes additional customization options, useful message management tools, and a Daily Hub with simple utilities and content to explore throughout the day.
Stay connected with friends, family, groups, and communities around the world, with a messaging experience designed to work smoothly even on slower mobile networks.
Messaging and communication are provided through Telegram’s API and infrastructure. Please see our Privacy Policy for details about Tele Messenger’s data and privacy practices.
Access your conversations across supported devices and keep your chats synchronized wherever you go.
Key Features:
* Chat Lock
 Protect your personal conversations with Chat Lock. Secure individual chats with a passcode to add an extra layer of privacy, even when someone else has access to your phone.
* Enhanced Customization
 Personalize your experience with themes, colors, backgrounds, and interface settings.
* Advanced Message Management
 Organize your chats, manage media, and keep your conversations easier to navigate.
* Daily Hub
 Take a break from messaging with a collection of everyday content, useful tools, and casual games. Explore daily wishes, interesting facts, random questions, zodiac signs, breathing exercises, mini games, and more.
* Multi-Device Sync
 Keep your conversations and chat history synchronized across your supported devices.
* Fast & Reliable Messaging
 Enjoy cloud-based messaging powered by Telegram’s API and infrastructure.
* Voice & Video Calls
 Stay connected with voice and video calls supported through Telegram’s communication services.
* Groups, Channels & Bots
 Access and participate in Telegram groups, public channels, and bots, and make conversations more expressive with stickers.
* Media & File Sharing
 Share photos, videos, documents, and other files directly in your conversations.
Advertising:
Tele Messenger may display ads provided by third-party ad networks. Learn more about our data practices in our Privacy Policy.
Disclaimer:
Tele Messenger is an independent, unofficial third-party client built on the Telegram API. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Telegram FZ-LLC.
Thank you for choosing Tele Messenger!

listings.name: CodeLife: Learn Python Coding
listings.description:
Code Life is the fun, beginner-friendly way to learn to code. Like Duolingo, but for code: short interactive exercises, no boring lectures, and real code you run right in the app.

No experience needed. Start from zero and go at your own pace, a few minutes a day.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
• Python (100 chapters): variables, conditions, loops, lists, dictionaries, functions, errors, classes and OOP.
• JavaScript (162 chapters): the language of the web, from your first variable to array methods, closures, JSON, classes and final challenges.
• SQL (86 chapters): query real databases with SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, subqueries, CTEs and window functions.
• HTML & CSS (30 chapters): build web pages with structure, selectors, the box model and Flexbox.

Over 3,500 exercises in total, and more on the way.

HOW IT WORKS
• Bite-size lessons that explain one idea at a time, with simple examples.
• Interactive exercises: multiple choice, fill in the code, match the pairs.
• Coding challenges where you write and run your own code.
• Hints that guide you without giving the answer away.

COLLECT CODÉMON
Every chapter you finish earns coins. Spend them on eggs, hatch them, and collect all 18 Codémon in your Codédex. Learning to code has never been this rewarding.

STAY MOTIVATED
• Earn XP and level up.
• Keep your daily streak going.
• Follow your progress in each language.

FREE, FOR REAL
• Every course and every chapter is free.
• No subscription and no limited lives.
• One optional purchase removes the ads.

Code Life is available in English and French.

Perfect for students, career changers, future developers, or anyone curious about how code works. Download Code Life and write your first line of code today!

bluejetty:00139144:ios.description:
Rosebud is your personal AI-powered self care companion. Rosebud is a therapist-recommended journaling and self-reflection tool designed to support your personal growth and emotional wellness. Rosebud is a diary that evolves with you, learning from your entries and providing personalized prompts, feedback, and insights tailored for your growth.
THE BEST DAILY JOURNALING APP
Navigating challenging emotions? Want to better manage stress, anxiety, or overthinking? Rosebud is designed to help you work through difficult emotions and thoughts through structured self-reflection. Whether you prefer to write or speak your thoughts, with just a few minutes of voice or text journaling, you'll reduce stress and gain clarity.
REVIEWS
Our users tell us:
"I absolutely love it. I never thought I would have done AI journaling. I love the prompts and the insights into my personality are amazing and literally help me succeed in life." ~ Cameron T.
"I love this app. It's helped me replace doom scrolling while integrating more self reflection and mindfulness throughout my day. The prompts are well thought out, and I've seen an improvement in my mood and self awareness. Highly recommend." ~ Vesna M.
"This is turbocharging my journaling habit. Self-reflection x collaborative brainstorming x empathetic feedback = GAME CHANGER!" ~ Chris G.
"It feels like daily 'brain hygiene' to use this app, dump out my thoughts and force myself to think through things in a way I might normally avoid." ~ Erica R.
"It's like having my own personal coach right in my left pocket. The long-term memory helps me see my thinking traps, patterns, and reframe negative emotions. " ~ Alicia L.
FEATURES FOR DAILY SELF IMPROVEMENT
Reflect & Process
• Interactive Daily Diary: Interactive self-reflection with real-time guidance for text and voice entries
• Expert-Crafted Experiences: Guided journals using evidence-based self-reflection frameworks (eg. CBT techniques, gratitude practice, etc.)
• Voice Journaling: Express yourself naturally in 20 languages using our advanced transcription or voice mode
Learn & Grow
• Intelligent Pattern Recognition: AI learns about you and recognizes patterns across entries
• Smart Mood Tracker: AI helps you understand emotional patterns and triggers
Track Progress
• Smart Goal Tracker: AI habit and goal suggestions and accountability
• Daily Quotes: Affirmations, haikus, proverbs tailored to you based on your entries
• Weekly Personal Growth Insights: Track themes, progress, wins, emotional landscape, and more with comprehensive weekly analysis provided by AI
PRIVACY FIRST
Your thoughts are personal. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest to keep your data completely secure. 
Plus, secure your journal with biometric locking using Face ID, Touch ID, or a personal PIN code for an extra layer of protection.
We're on a mission to build a future where everyone has the power to live happier, more fulfilled lives. Rosebud is constantly updated with the latest in psychology and AI technology to provide you with the best self-reflection and personal growth support. 
Rosebud is a personal growth and wellness tool designed to support self-reflection and goal achievement. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition, nor is it a substitute for professional mental health care, medical advice, or therapy.
If you're experiencing a mental health crisis, please contact emergency services or a crisis hotline immediately.
Join thousands of happy Rosebud users today! Your future self awaits.
Terms of Service: https://help.rosebud.app/about-us/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00128523:ios.name: Biking Distance Tracker
bluejetty:00128523:ios.summary: Vima is a GPS based tracking app for people who want to keep track of their biking fitness goals. It is an app aimed at simplicity that allows bikers to keep track of their runs easily without a lot of unnecessary stuff getting in the way.
bluejetty:00128523:ios.description:
Vima is a GPS based tracking app for people who want to keep track of their biking fitness goals. It is an app aimed at simplicity that allows bikers to keep track of their runs easily without a lot of unnecessary stuff getting in the way. 
APPLE WATCH
Easily start, pause, resume, and save a ride without ever getting your phone out of your pocket. Check your distance, speed, time, and altitude from your Apple Watch in realtime.
STATS AND MAPS 
Vima tracks speed, distance, altitude, and time. It also gives you a map showing where you have been while you are saving a ride. 
COLOR CODED 
When viewing saved rides your route shows up on the map color coded by speed. It shows where you went the fastest (green) and where you were slowest (red). 
VOICE SUMMARY 
Don't want to look at the screen every few minutes? You can have the app tell you updates on your progress in set distance and/or time intervals. 
SPLIT TIMES
Added splits to the history review page. Choose from 9 different distances and see how each section of your workout went.
CALORIES
See calories burned. Set your weight in settings and get your calories burned in real time and on the history page after your run. 
BIKE TRACKING
Track the distance on your bike so you know when it's time to do maintenance or replace it before problems happen.
PAUSE AND RESUME 
Pause the workout to catch your breath or chat with a friend and then resume when you get back to it. 
FACEBOOK & TWITTER 
Share your workout with your friends on Facebook or Twitter with our easy to use integration. 
UNITS 
The supports both standard and metric units. 
HEALTH KIT
Apple Health permissions allow us to enhance your data as well as saving your workout information to Apple Health. 
If you've read this far, you should definitely give Vima a shot. We think you'll love it, and if there is anything you'd like to see for the app in the future just let us know. We love hearing from our users.
Note: Continued use of the GPS will reduce battery life.
If you upgrade to a premium subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. The monthly subscription costs USD 4.99 per month, while the yearly subscription costs USD 29.99 per year. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. There is no increase in cost when renewing.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, the current period cannot be canceled.
Find the full terms and conditions and our privacy policy at http://www.30-south.com/privacy-policy/

**Nuts & Bolts: Screw Challenges – The Ultimate Brain Puzzle Experience**
Welcome to the world of mechanical puzzles where logic meets satisfaction.
**Nuts & Bolts: Screw Challenges** is a uniquely crafted 3D puzzle game that blends smart gameplay mechanics, realistic visuals, and deeply satisfying ASMR effects into one relaxing and addictive experience. Twist, unscrew, rotate, and solve as you master the art of unbolting logic-based challenges.
**Think, Twist, Solve!**
If you enjoy solving smart puzzles that test your logic and reward your patience, this game is made for you. With easy-to-understand mechanics and challenging layouts, every level brings something new. Unscrewing bolts might sound easy, but doing it in the right order? That’s where the real challenge begins!
Your mission is simple: remove all bolts by choosing the correct sequence. But as levels advance, the complexity increases, and you’ll need sharp thinking, spatial awareness, and a bit of trial-and-error to succeed.
---
