 **Innovative Screw Mechanics:**
Rotate, slide, and unscrew bolts to free metallic plates. One wrong move could leave you stuck!
 **Hundreds of Unique Levels:**
Enjoy a progressive challenge curve with increasingly smart and tricky puzzles designed to sharpen your brain.
 **Realistic 3D Graphics:**
Polished metallic textures, fluid movements, and minimalistic backgrounds make for a visually soothing experience.
 **Satisfying ASMR Sound Effects:**
Clicking, rotating, and dropping sounds provide a relaxing escape — perfect for fans of satisfying mechanics.
 **No Timer – Pure Logic:**
Think at your own pace. There’s no rush! This is the ideal game for stress relief and focused gameplay.
 **Offline Play Supported:**
No Wi-Fi? No problem. Play anytime, anywhere — perfect for commuting or winding down at night.
 **Simple Controls, Deep Logic:**
Tap, drag, and twist — it’s easy to pick up, but tough to master. Each puzzle is a mind game in disguise.

 **Great for All Ages** – Whether you're a teen or an adult, the gameplay is both mentally engaging and soothing.

bluejetty:00063127:ios.description:
Get into the Christmas spirit with Christmas Solitaire Tri-Peaks, the free and festive card game, based on our beloved Magic Towers Solitaire game played over 100 MILLION times by iPhone and iPad players.
Use your TriPeaks solitaire skills to fill a snowy landscape with an enchanted tower in this well-loved card game. The classic rules are simple and all you need to do is match cards that are one higher or lower than the shown card. Clear all 3 peaks and you complete the round. There are also wild cards hidden in the deck to help you win!
Of course, while you are relaxing you can enjoy the beautiful holiday imagery and a visit from Santa and his reindeer! If you’ve ever enjoyed puzzling over any card games like Freecell, Pyramid or Spider Solitaire, then you will love playing Christmas Solitaire!
FEATURES:
* Addictive game-play, inspired by classic solitaire games.
* Festive theme set in a snowy, winter landscape.
* Simple, intuitive and easy to understand controls.
* Local and global scoreboards.
* Atmospheric with the occasional jingle of bells!
* Family-friendly!
Get into the festive spirit with Christmas Solitaire Tri-Peaks in a beautiful winter wonderland.

bluejetty:00183851:ios.name: Money Monitor: Expense Tracker
bluejetty:00183851:ios.summary:
Get Money Monitor now, the most comprehensive personal finance management application!
You can track and organize all your transactions, accounts, budgets, bills, cash flow and payees in Money Monitor by easy operation but with powerful fu
bluejetty:00183851:ios.description:
Get Money Monitor now, the most comprehensive personal finance management application!
You can track and organize all your transactions, accounts, budgets, bills, cash flow and payees in Money Monitor by easy operation but with powerful functions. 
Money Monitor is your right choice if you want to track and control your expense and pay bills on time, it will keep all your finance at a glance, show you clearly that where the money comes from and goes. A must have app for personal budgets or business use.
Features:
Transactions
⁃ Quick add income, expense or transfer transactions with or without recurring.
⁃ Edit picture, account, budget, category and payee and note for each transaction.
⁃ Mark transaction as cleared or not. 
Accounts
⁃ Eight default types of account and your can custom your own.
⁃ Track transactions of each account.
⁃ Show expense, income and balance amount of all your accounts.
⁃ Show expense, income and balance amount of each account.
⁃ Transfer amount from one account to another.
Categories
⁃ Customize Category and subcategory.
⁃ 10+ icons for categories and 40+ icons for subcategories.
⁃ Show total expense and income of all categories.
⁃ Show total expense and income of each category.
Budgets
⁃ Create unlimited income or expense budgets with or without cycles.
⁃ Set budget name, amount, type, category, date range etc.
⁃ Rollover budget amount to next cycled budget.
⁃ Transfer available budget amount to another budget.
⁃ Track transactions of each budget.
⁃ Time marker to show the status of current date at each budget.
⁃ Show statistics info of total amount, already used and available amount of each budget.
Bills 
⁃ Track both income or expense bills both repeat and not.
⁃ Custom remind time, date and sound of each bill, and snooze bills reminder.
⁃ Calendar view of bills.
⁃ Add auto pay bills.
⁃ Mark payment to bills in full or in part.
⁃ Add note to each payment for the bills.
Other Features
⁃ Supports WiFi backup & restore.
⁃ Supports Dropbox backup & restore.
⁃ Search transactions.
⁃ Migrate data to full version.
⁃ World-wide currency.
⁃ Set your own week start day.
⁃ Powerful reports by pie chart to show visually all parts of your finance.
⁃ Custom unlimited reminders with any content.
⁃ Badge to show number of overdue unpaid bills and the bills which remind date are due.
⁃ Export data by email in form of CSV, HTML or PDF.
⁃ Supports AirPrint.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch version.
⁃ Supports 3D Touch function.
If you have any question or suggestion, please send email to userfeed@vip.tom.com.

Are you ready to be the crazy madness cooking chef in My Cooking? Get yourself in a real cooking craze. Cook like a mad chef with cooking fever in My Cooking, and prepare delicious dishes for your hungry customers! Let's start this super addictive time-management restaurant cooking game, and open the cooking journey diary NOW!
My Cooking, a NEW FREE restaurant cooking game! Easy to play & rich in dishes. Fast tap with only ONE finger and you can prepare, cook and serve all dishes! Manage time strategically and operate your own worldwide start-up restaurant chain empire! Dash from restaurant to restaurant on this magical cooking map. You will discover and unlock many cooking towns and cities, as you progress on your cooking adventure. Get the restaurants back to business and attract more and more customers. Let the crazy diner begin!
Cook Delicacies from All Over the World
•From steak burgers to seafood barbecue, from sushi sashimi to dessert cake, all kinds of cuisines could be found in our Magical Recipe Book!
•Each special themed restaurant has prepared fresh ingredients and rich dishes for Madness Chefs, waiting for you to show your excellent cooking skills!
Open Special Themed Restaurants
•Enjoy spring cherry blossoms in Ramen Canteen, taste Michelin meals in Western Restaurant, and experience the passionate Latin vibe in Mexican restaurant.
•Elegant Café, delicious Sushi Shop, alive Taco Truck, every dreamy and exquisite shop will bring you a whole new experience, not just the tasty food, but also the cultural atmosphere!
•Quickly improve your cooking skills, master the cooking recipes of each type of cuisine, unlock more themed restaurants, and become the real top chef in the cooking city!
Get proficient in Cooking Techniques & Strategies
•Learn cooking methods: Fry, Bake, Boil, Steam, Simmer & Grill, all ways could be found here.
•Create more combos: Get extra bonus & more achievements, see how many combos you can make once.
•Upgrade ingredients & kitchenware: Increase income & Reduce cooking time, making levels easier to pass.
•Use powerful boosts: Complete special cooking goals smoothly, feeling too challenging, try some boosts!
Join in All Kinds of Special Holiday Events
•New Food Challenge: Open restaurants randomly, to meet savory food unexpectedly
•Streak Challenge: Pass levels without any loss, to challenge the highest streak records
•Halloween Restaurant Event: Witch Soup, Pumpkin Pie, all spooky funny meals to be found here
•Christmas Cabin Event: Christmas Turkey, Gingerbread Man Cookies, enjoy Sweet Delicious Christmas Dinner 
And more events are here to be found!
More Features:
•Easy to play, one finger to get all completed
•More than 50 themed restaurants playable
•800+ ingredients to create over 200 dishes from all over the world
•Thousands of well-designed levels with 3 kinds of difficulties!
•Interesting and magical boosts help you pass levels smoothly
•Hundreds of kitchenware and ingredients waiting for upgrading
•More special holiday events for you to challenge
•NO internet needed! Offline supported! Play anytime anywhere
•Login system available. No worries about data loss, play across devices freely!
•More restaurants and delicacies coming soon!
How to Play:
•Don't worry! Super easy to play! All steps could be played with only one finger.
Check customers’ dish orders, tap ingredients to cook food in order, and click the finished dishes to serve customers!
•Too simple for you? Try playing pink levels, and streak challenge! 
What are you waiting for? Let's get My Cooking story start!
Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/My-Cooking-114689119908044/
Any question? Please contact us in the game!

bluejetty:00128062:ios.description:
Storyngton Hall is a match-3, home and garden design and renovation game designed for lovers of romance, exciting tales of lords and ladies, and addictive puzzles and challenges.
Follow the story of the Green family as they move to a Recency-era mansion in desperate need of renovation. Pass match-3 levels and help the family renovate, decorate, and design their dream house and gardens. Mrs. Green wishes to be the talk of the town, hosting the most beautiful balls in the land and helping her daughter, Jane, find true love. The beautiful Jane wishes to work on her romance novels and meet the man of her dreams. Mr. Green would just like to get a little rest. Help the family make their dreams come true by designing and landscaping a stunning family mansion and lavish gardens fit for a king. Be careful though, the wicked Lady Wroth attempts to wreak havoc on the Greens at every turn with her evil machinations.
• Hone your interior design skills: Build your dream home and surround it with stunning, lush gardens.
• Match and win: Solve exciting match-3 puzzles
• Build and discover: Unlock new areas in your home and gardens to practice your landscaping and interior decorating skills on
• Throw a lavish ball: Become the host with the most as you throw a marvelous ball for your neighbors. You may even help Jane find love
• A story like no other: Unravel the mysteries of Storyngton Hall and the colorful characters who pass through its walls and gardens
• Play with friends: Invite your friends from Facebook and tackle match-3 levels together
Storyngton Hall is a free to play match-3 game sure to tick all the boxes for lovers of romance, interior design, and exciting puzzles. Download Storyngton Hall today for a taste of Regency life in a stunning mansion that you can renovate and build yourself! Hours of match-3 gameplay fun to keep you coming back for more!
Enjoying Storyngton Hall? To never miss an update, follow the game on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/StoryngtonHall
If you’ve got any questions about the game, you can also talk to our tech support team sh_support@my.games.

bluejetty:00148741:ios.description:
Transform your car into a smart, connected hub with Cartube Plus! This innovative app seamlessly integrates with your car through OBD2 and Wi-Fi, offering a wide range of features designed to enhance your driving experience. Whether you're on the road or parked, Cartube Plus brings convenience and entertainment right to your fingertips.
Key Features:
• Smart Car Connectivity: Effortlessly connect to your car’s OBD2 system via Wi-Fi for real-time data synchronization, allowing you to monitor vehicle health, performance, and more.
• Remote Control: Take control of your car’s systems from a distance with the built-in remote functionality. Adjust settings and monitor diagnostics without leaving your seat.
• Trip Calculator: Plan your journey with ease! Utilize the MapKit-powered trip planner for accurate route information, estimated travel time, and more.
• Cost Calculator: Stay on top of your trip expenses with the trip cost calculator. By factoring in fuel efficiency, gas prices, and route details, you'll know exactly what to expect before hitting the road.
• User-Friendly Interface: The intuitive design makes it simple to navigate through the app and access all features without distractions.
Cartube Plus is the perfect companion for anyone who wants to enhance their driving experience, making every trip more enjoyable and efficient. Download today and connect your car like never before!
Cartube Plus includes an optional auto-renewable subscription to unlimited access all app features, service and ad-free (price may vary depending on location):
Weekly $1.99 ; Monthly $3.99 ; Lifetime $9.99
• Check in app for exact pricing in your region
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration/price selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
• You can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by going to your iTunes Account Settings, but refunds will not be given for any unused portion of the term.

bluejetty:00023281:ios.description:
House Building for Minecraft is perfect for building minecraft house on your map. It has tons of buildings for minecraft 1.20 and minecraft 1.21+ and famous structures addons. Easily import, export, and edit your minecraft building in one click.
House Building for Minecraft has a huge variety of structures minecraft 1.20 1.21+ doesn't need to pay, all structures will be built in 3 ways depending on your preferences for building in Minecraft world. In particular, you can add Chest & Mob Spawner Naturally into minecraft house. Besides, you can create pixel art for minecraft with any picture from your mobile phone. You can easily modify the position and preview 3D visual minecraft house building or pixel art.
Suggestions for minecraft house builder can be flexible in the 3 ways to build a house below:
- Option 1: Place Building Blocks Minecraft, then select a house in the menu building minecraft.
- Option 2: 1. Activate the auto-spawning feature; all structures will be automatically constructed in the biome mcpe of your choice.
- Option 3: Copy or remember "name function", and type this command: "/function name function".
***We have prepared a minecraft building guide in the settings.
Building minecraft houses has never been easier. Are you ready to start minecraft build ideas and putting unique structures in your MCPE world?
FEATURES
- Variety Structures & Addons: Automatically update minecraft buildings from small to large size according to categories: houses, modern houses, medieval, boats, castles, temples,...
- Intuitive Minecraft Building Tools: Structures, chest, mob spawner, and pixel art are visually previewed in 3D. Support menu selector builds minecraft house, auto spawning house by biome selected, and put chest/entities by coordinates.
- ADD CHEST: Add any entity to structures that minecraft builder using CHEST such as furniture, armor, weapons, or food.
- ADD SPAWNER: You can add Minecraft Mob Spawner with any mobs. Easily search for mobs by typing the name: Pig, Spider, Cave Spider, Silverfish, Magma Cube, Blaze, Skeleton, Zombie,...
- Flexible compatibility with some games: Directly import and export into Minecraft games. Moreover, you can import your minecraft building ideas into other games that allow third-party tools to edit behavior & resource packs: Crafting and Building, Eeskcraft, Craftsman, etc.
NAME, LENGTH AND PRICES OF OUR PUBLICATIONS/SERVICES:
Premium Monthly - first 3 days for free, then you will be charged for $2.99/Monthly.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
You can cancel your subscription via: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy policy: https://www.pamobile.co/privacy-policy.html
Term of use: https://www.pamobile.co/terms-conditions.html

— A better business account for going global —

• Connect to supported platforms like Amazon, Stripe, Xero, and more

bluejetty:00178382:ios.description:
The BTPM Listen App allows you to listen to BTPM radio channels, On Demand, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule all at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for programs, bookmark a program for later, and wake up to BTPM with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• Listen to live streams from BTPM even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for the different BTPM streams! 
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to BTPM in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access BTPM Listen programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The BTPM Listen App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Search
• The unique “Search Public Radio” feature finds stories or programs across hundreds of stations and web pages and makes it easy to play instantly.
Additional features
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The BTPM Listen App is brought to you by the people at BTPM and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support BTPM by becoming a member today!
https://www.btpm.org/

QR Code Reader and Barcode Scanner
Looking for an easy to use and practical tool to scan or generate QR codes and barcodes? Check out our feature-rich QR scanner app with a lightweight interface. Scan, save, create, or share QR codes and barcodes effortlessly. 
Get information from popular websites and online stores with our versatile digital scanner or create codes for URLs, business cards, product pages, and more.
Explore the key features of our QR code app:
► SCAN QR CODES
We use the built-in technology of iOS devices to let you scan QR codes of any type and format in seconds. Our QRcode reader supports Aztec, Data Matric, PDF417, and more. Simply scan QR code on iPhone through our QR reader and gain the required information immediately. 
► SCAN BARCODES
Dealing with standard barcode formats like EAN 13, Code 128, DataBar, or Codabar? No worries – our effective barcode reader got you covered! No ads, no hidden fees – only immediate scan results.
► CREATE QR CODES
Generate and manage QR codes for your personal or business needs. Our app is not just a QR scanner, but a comprehensive tool to create and share your own codes. Whether you need a QR code for event tickets, delivery tracking, or product packaging, our business scanner app is your go-to.
► ACCESS YOUR SCAN HISTORY
With our QR code scanner app, you can manage and export your scan history in a few simple clicks. Keep all the information about your QR and barcode scans in a single place. 
► ENJOY SMOOTH SCANNING

bluejetty:00174663:ios.summary: Without any warning, giant pieces of meteorolite pierced the tranquility and harmony of the night. In an instant, crash, screams, and wails cloaked the whole Continent in unending darkness. The long lasting peace and innocent lives were tor
bluejetty:00174663:ios.description:
Without any warning, giant pieces of meteorolite pierced the tranquility and harmony of the night. In an instant, crash, screams, and wails cloaked the whole Continent in unending darkness. The long lasting peace and innocent lives were torn up by the claws and teeth of the Fallen... Everything is on the verge of destruction...
At the life-and-death moment, the Vampire, the Werewolf and the Wizard reunited, searching for glimmers of hope amid the gloom. At long last, they reached the Ancestral Grounds, and the mighty Lord was awakened from the long sleep ahead of time... Now, he is giving commands to all races: Take back our lands and glory, and the moon shall rise once more!
--Game Features--
▶Rebuild Homes
Clear the ruins and obstacles! The way of rebuilding is always full of hardship. Behind the rubble and broken walls, there may be compatriots waiting to be rescued, while there may also be minions of the Fallen. Please take each step carefully, never give up on compatriots, and never show mercy to the Fallen. Arm yourself with strategies, and match the chess pieces to release the ancient power that can destroy the enemies!
▶Recruit Heroes
A lone wolf never becomes a real Lord! The elites of all races are eager to assist you! Never turn them down! On the contrary, you need to gather the strength, because you need your own strong right-hand man in the future.
▶Explore&Arena
Victory favors the prepared! Match-3 Battles and Hero Exploration make the perfect combination. During the severe dilemmas and narrow escapes, build up your clan, toughen your will, and achieve your glory! And all these abilities would be tested in the ultimate Arena!
▶War Overlord
4 Troop types and 5 Races, all of the relationships of restriction! Switching to the offense side is just about a blink of an eye! Wisely lining up and thinking ahead are of vital importance if you want to take the upper hand on the battlefield!
▶Create Alliances
Power speaks louder than oaths! Alliances of all races uphold the inner brotherly stability and the outer territory expansion, only with which they can make the Fallen tremble! Remember, a formidable Lord never fights alone!
▶Guard Continent
Inaction and shelters can only intensify the fierceness of the Fallen! Gather all forces to make initiative attacks! Wipe out all the threats on every inch of the Continent! Becoming the real Lord of Nights is the only way to regain calmness and harmony!
All Races are calling, are you in or not?
https://www.facebook.com/MythsOfMoonrise
Attention!
Myths of Moonrise is a free SLG game, but there are still in-game items that you can obtain and use by purchasing. Under the Terms of Use and User Privacy Policy, you need to reach the age of 7 to play. In addition, accessible networks and devices are required.

Dive into a Glistening Puzzle World!
Step into a vibrant realm where gems await your strategic touch! This puzzle game is tailored for players of all ages, blending logic, quick thinking, and relaxation. Whether you're a casual player or a puzzle pro, there's something here to captivate you.
Gameplay Essentials
Race to Connect Gems: Your mission is clear – link matching gems by drawing lines, but lines can't cross, and time is of the essence! Each level has a limited time frame, so think fast and act faster to connect gems and clear the board.
From straightforward grids to mind-bending puzzles, every level tests your planning and problem-solving skills. Can you outsmart the clock?
Strategize for Success: As you advance, puzzles get trickier. Plan your moves, anticipate crossings, and maximize your connections to earn high scores. It's a test of wits and reflexes!
Key Features
Stunning Visuals & Sound: Lose yourself in a world of vivid colors and smooth animations. The high-quality graphics and calming soundtrack create an immersive experience that's easy on the eyes and ears.
Play Offline, Anytime: No Wi-Fi? No worries! This game is fully playable offline, making it perfect for on-the-go entertainment or a quick break at home.
Fun for All Ages: With simple controls and adjustable difficulty, kids and adults alike can enjoy this game. It's a great way to sharpen your mind or unwind after a long day.
Ready to Shine?
Don't miss out on this gem-linking adventure! Download now and start connecting gems under pressure. Can you conquer the clock and become a Link&Shine champion?

Step into a vibrant realm where gems await your strategic touch! This puzzle game is tailored for players of all ages, blending logic, quick thinking, and relaxation. Whether you're a casual player or a puzzle pro, there's something here to captivate you.
Gameplay Essentials
Race to Connect Gems: Your mission is clear – link matching gems by drawing lines, but lines can't cross, and time is of the essence! Each level has a limited time frame, so think fast and act faster to connect gems and clear the board.
From straightforward grids to mind-bending puzzles, every level tests your planning and problem-solving skills. Can you outsmart the clock?
Strategize for Success: As you advance, puzzles get trickier. Plan your moves, anticipate crossings, and maximize your connections to earn high scores. It's a test of wits and reflexes!
Key Features
Stunning Visuals & Sound: Lose yourself in a world of vivid colors and smooth animations. The high-quality graphics and calming soundtrack create an immersive experience that's easy on the eyes and ears.
Play Offline, Anytime: No Wi-Fi? No worries! This game is fully playable offline, making it perfect for on-the-go entertainment or a quick break at home.
Fun for All Ages: With simple controls and adjustable difficulty, kids and adults alike can enjoy this game. It's a great way to sharpen your mind or unwind after a long day.
Ready to Shine?
Don't miss out on this gem-linking adventure! Download now and start connecting gems under pressure. Can you conquer the clock and become a Link&Shine champion?

bluejetty:00127088:ios.name: Density Altitude +
bluejetty:00127088:ios.summary: Instant and location accurate Density Altitude calculator/instrument app for iPhone and iPad that also finds relative air density (RAD), altimeter setting, relative humidity, specific humidity (grains/lb) and more. Super useful for pilots,
bluejetty:00127088:ios.description:
Instant and location accurate Density Altitude calculator/instrument app for iPhone and iPad that also finds relative air density (RAD), altimeter setting, relative humidity, specific humidity (grains/lb) and more. Super useful for pilots, especially in the backcountry. Many other uses for engine tuning, racing, sports, etc.
* Seamlessly integrates weather data, GPS and your phone's onboard barometer to quickly and accurately calculate your density altitude, altimeter setting, relative air density, and more.
* Takes humidity into account in all calculations, making it more accurate than the typical dry bulb approximation formula used by AWOS/ASOS, etc.
* Works anywhere. Great without cellular connection as well, which makes it all the more useful in the backcountry and far away from ASOS/AWOS stations.
* Location Search: Find atmospheric data (Density Altitude, etc.) at any point on Earth, from anywhere!
Data Sensed and Calculated (all calculated with humidity):
* Density Altitude 
* GPS Altitude
* Temperature
* Altimeter Setting
* Absolute Pressure
* Dew Point
* Relative Humidity
* Specific Humidity (grains/pound)
* Air Density
* Relative Air Density (RAD)
* Dyno Correction
The quickest way to get your Density Altitude! On the iPhone 6/6+ and newer iPads, it will use the built-in barometer and GPS. If you're in cell range, you don't need to supply any data. If you're out of cell range, all you need to supply is the outside air temperature. Designed not to need an internet connection, so it will work anytime and anywhere you need it.
Great tool for pilots, drag racers, engine tuners, golfers, or anyone who needs to conveniently find their Density Altitude, Altimeter Setting, Relative Aid Density (RAD), Specific Humidity or Absolute Pressure.
No ads or in-app purchases.
We love feedback! Email us at densityaltitude@rateofclimb.com
Disclaimer: 
Density Altitude+ uses available third party weather and elevation data to calculate atmospheric measurements, but Rate Of Climb does not guarantee that the original sources (including the National Weather Service, FAA and others) have provided data that is accurate, complete, timely, or properly formatted. Users should always contact official sources for the most accurate and timely updates.
The service is not intended for use in situations in which the failure of the service could lead to death, personal injury, or severe physical or environmental damage. Your use of this application is at your sole risk.

bluejetty:00165656:ios.description:
Join over 1,000,000 users achieving their keto and low-carb goals with the ultimate keto diet app!
This keto diet tracker is like having your own personal keto and low-carb nutritionist in the palm of your hand. Whether you are strictly following a keto diet or just cutting back on carbs, losing weight has never been so simple! Keto.app is designed to be the fastest, easiest-to-use macro tracker on the market, helping you hit your keto and fasting goals without the hassle.
Try our keto diet app for free to get your custom meal plan! Upgrading to PRO is only required if you want to log 5+ foods per day—and we offer both flexible subscriptions, including free trial, and a one-time lifetime purchase for those who hate monthly fees.
MEAL PLANS & PERSONALIZATION
• Curated Meal Plans: Take the guesswork out of your diet. Select and follow perfectly tailored meal plans designed for your specific calorie goals and net carb goals. While all options are fundamentally optimized for a keto diet, our extensive selection accommodates various lifestyles—including vegetarian, vegan, bodybuilding, low carb and no carb, among many others.
• AI Day Analysis: Get smart, personalized feedback on your daily logs! Send your day's data to our AI to find out exactly how you are doing (e.g., "You are right on track today, but most of your carbs came from dairy. Try to focus on adding more healthy fats tomorrow").
• Personalized Plan: Enter your body type, goals, and activity level to generate a custom daily macro plan that fits your exact diet style.
• Targeted Advice: View recommended foods to prioritize, and see which foods to avoid to stay on track.
EFFORTLESS TRACKING & RECIPES
• Voice Search: Log your meals instantly using just your voice!
• Massive Food Database: Search our global database for foods, beverages, restaurant items, and pre-packaged products.
• Barcode & Label Scanner: Simply scan a barcode, or use your camera to scan a nutrition label and automatically fill in the macro fields.
• Net Carbs & Fiber Tracking: We automatically subtract sugar alcohols and dietary fiber for your true net carb count. You can even view dedicated charts for your daily fiber consumption—a feature most other trackers miss!
• Keto & Low-Carb Recipes: Access a large library of delicious keto diet and low-carb recipes, featuring ideas for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks, as well as satisfying soups, salads, and desserts, or create and save your own.
• Smart Adjustments: Only ate half your meal? Easily adjust the portion size of logged recipes for accurate macro tracking.
• Fasting Tracker: Track your fasting windows, including popular 16:8 and 18:6 intermittent fasting schedules.

bluejetty:00013874:ios.description:
BlueMail is a world-class, secure, and free cross-platform email service that leverages cutting-edge technology to deliver a smart, beautifully designed, and elegant user experience. With BlueMail, you can effortlessly manage an unlimited number of email accounts from any provider.
BlueMail allows for smart push notifications and group emailing while also enabling you to adjust preferences individually for each of your email accounts. Since BlueMail is ad-free, it makes an ideal alternative to your default email app on any mobile, tablet, or desktop device. BlueMail offers a top-notch email service for all your email accounts with a user-friendly and intuitive design, complete with a powerful unified interface.
ALL your emails in ONE PLACE
· Multiple providers: Gmail, Outlook, Hotmail, Yahoo Mail, AOL, iCloud, Microsoft 365, and more
· Support for IMAP, POP3, and Exchange Smart Configuration (ActiveSync, EWS, Office 365)
· Sync multiple inboxes from all your providers in a Unified Interface
· Instant Push Mail
ENHANCED FEATURES
· BlueMail GEM AI leverages the power of OpenAI ChatGPT, enabling it to write high-quality emails quickly & efficiently. GEM AI suggests responses based on the context of the email, streamlining the communication process. GEM AI with GPT also provides condensed summaries best used for longer emails and conversations. By using BlueMail's artificial intelligence & machine learning capabilities, you save time and boost your productivity right within your inbox
· Integrated Calendar: Access your Calendar events within Blue Mail. View, create and edit events (supports CalDAV, Exchange)
· Group Mail: Define and Share Groups to quickly send and receive emails
· Share Email: Share emails publicly or privately through various social networks and messaging apps, receive emails from people who wish to engage with you instantly while keeping your email address private
· Email Clusters: Organize similar emails together to remove clutter from your inbox. It categorizes emails from known senders into smart clusters, and organizes your emails into a sub-folder structure automatically, without the hassle of managing it manually
· Spam Management: Advanced spam mechanisms, including the ability for users to directly Block Senders, Block Domains, or Block an entire suffix of domains.
· Dark Theme: With automatic switching between day and night modes
· Rich Text Signature: Easily configure styles & add your logo
· Dynamic Smart Conversations: Make email convenient and easy
· Configurable Menus: Customize your swipe menu and actions
· Getting Stuff Done: Mark emails for later and set reminders so you won’t miss them. When you finish handling an email, mark it Done to get it out of your way. Effortlessly maintain a zero inbox
· Visually Appealing: Services logos, senders' images, easily recognize popular services by their icons
· Days to Sync, Color-Coding, Scrollable and Unread Widgets, Intelligent Badge, Mobile Printing, and Much More!
· Add-ons: Support for Today Widget and iMessage Extension
· Smart Mobile Notifications, Unified Folders, People Toggle, Undo Send, Later Board, Intelligent Badge, Aliases, Customized Appearance, and much more!
PRIVATE & SECURE
· Industry-leading Encryption: Your data is always encrypted to protect your email communications and information. BlueMail uses leading industry protocols to secure and protect your data.
· Lock Screen: You can set a timed lock screen to protect your emails, as well as use Face ID.
· Block Tracking Images: Automatically attempt to block tracking pixels and other forms of email trackers. Preventing image trackers from displaying protects you from being tracked by email senders.
Privacy: https://bluemail.me/privacy/
Terms: https://bluemail.me/tos/
We love getting your feedback! Please email us: ios-support@bluemail.me
Our team greatly appreciates your 5-star rating, and we are grateful for your support. Thank you!

bluejetty:00017483:ios.summary: Do you love the original Solitaire Klondike but want a bigger challenge? You’ve found it with the classic Yukon Solitaire and Russian Solitaire card games! Play Yukon Solitaire and Russian Solitaire in one seamless app from the original and
bluejetty:00017483:ios.description:
Do you love the original Solitaire Klondike but want a bigger challenge? You’ve found it with the classic Yukon Solitaire and Russian Solitaire card games! Play Yukon Solitaire and Russian Solitaire in one seamless app from the original and most trusted creators of Solitaire on mobile - MobilityWare. MobilityWare is the #1 Solitaire and card game developer for your phone!
Master the game with helpful features!
- Unlimited hints let you see smart suggested moves - improve your game with hints galore
- Unlimited undos allow you to backtrack and change your mind - never get stuck with free undos
Marvel at fun in-game animations!
- Magical, snowy animations motivate as you complete your card stacks
- Classic and new winning animations bring your cards to dancing life
Play your way
- See your score, time played and number of moves at the top of your screen
- Adjust difficulty levels in Settings
How to Play Yukon Solitaire
- Your objective: Stack all cards in the top 4 goal piles from Ace to King!
- Match cards across 7 stacks below the goal piles in descending order (high to low), opposite colored suits
- For example, a Jack of Spades can be connected with a Queen of Hearts
- Play into 4 goal piles from low to high, of the same suit
- You should see A -> K for hearts, diamonds, spades and clubs to win!
How it differs from classic Solitaire 
- There is no draw pile
- You can move card stacks that are not in ordered sequence! - Just be sure the top card in your moving stack will be in sequence with the last card in your end stack
How to play Russian Solitaire, a variation of Yukon!
- Your objective: Stack all cards in the top 4 goal piles from Ace to King!
- Match cards across 7 stacks below the goal piles in descending order (high to low), but the same suit!
- For example, a Jack of Spades can be connected with a Queen of Spades
- Play into 4 goal piles from low to high, of the same suit
- You should see A -> K for hearts, diamonds, spades and clubs to win!

bluejetty:00137206:ios.description:
Welcome to Pin Detective - Mystery Mansion!
A rich woman mysteriously vanished in a lavish mansion that was covered by the rumors of ghosts and dangerous monsters. A talented detective is committed to uncovering the mystery.
By pulling the pin, you can collect clues that enlighten the truth. What happens to the billionaire? Why do the biological laboratory and so many alien animals exist in this mansion? Let’s use your brain to solve the puzzle to find it out.
Pin Detective: Mystery Mansion is filled with surprising things at every corner. You will face a ghost, a mad scientist, a werewolf, and even a cute dog. 
Let’s jump into the mansion and explore all the mysteries.
HOW TO PLAY:
● Pull the pin to explore the mansion and uncover the mystery.
● Just a mistake can put you in danger and lose your life.
● Use coins to renovate the mansion and buy clothes.
FEATURES:
● Suitable for all ages
● Attractive storyline with fantastic characters
●Various clothes: you wear whatever you choose
● A huge, mysterious mansion: learn all its secret
● Unlimited number of levels
● Completely free, play anywhere, anytime
Having a problem? Don't worry. Contact us via email: help@gameestudio.com
Visit our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/gameeglobal

bluejetty:00023451:ios.summary:
L’application Figaro Immo c’est :

bluejetty:00023451:ios.description:
L’application Figaro Immo c’est :
- Plus de 700 000 annonces immobilières d'achat et de location
- La possibilité de mémoriser un bien immobilier et classer ses annonces coups de cœur
- Des alertes pour être le premier à recevoir les nouvelles annonces directement sur son mobile
- Pouvoir contacter directement les agences immobilières pour obtenir plus d’informations
- Selon votre géolocalisation, repérer l'agence immobilière la plus proche
- Un assistant de visite : une check-list de questions à poser afin d'être prêt à 100% le jour de la visite
L’application Figaro Immo s’adresse à toutes les personnes qui ont un projet immobilier (vente maison, location appartement, recherche agence immobilière, louer) et qui souhaitent le concrétiser. Proposant plus de 700 000 annonces et bénéficiant d’une qualité de recherche éprouvée, l’application sera votre meilleur partenaire immobilier pour votre recherche de logement.
De nombreux types de biens
Profitez d’une vue globale du marché de l’immobilier avec de nombreux biens disponibles à : l’achat, la location ou en viager : appartement, maison, chambre, studio, loft, duplex, chalet, ferme, hôtel, parking, péniche, villa, propriété, terrain, … La recherche avancée vous permettra d’obtenir des annonces pertinentes classées par prix, mètres carrés, nombre de pièces ou encore par date.
Actualités
L’application Figaro Immo vous propose un large panel de conseils pour réussir l’achat ou la vente de votre maison, appartement, … des astuces pour bien négocier lorsqu’on est un particulier : votre emprunt logement avec la banque, les frais d’agences ou de notaire, besoin d’un bon coin où investir en 2014 (Paris, Toulouse, Bordeaux), ainsi que des vidéos sur le marché immobilier.
Investir dans l’immobilier
Pour un particulier investir dans l'immobilier reste un bon placement pour compléter ses revenus et se constituer un patrimoine pérenne. Les Français recherchent les placements de plus en plus sûrs et rentables ainsi, investir dans l’immobilier apparaît comme une solution parfaitement adaptée. 
Des biens immobiliers dans toute la France
Un large choix de maisons, appartements, studios, colocations en ville (Paris, Marseille, Lyon, Bordeaux, Lille, Strasbourg, Rennes, Nantes, Caen) et en région.
Rencontrer et échanger avec les équipes Figaro Immo
L’équipe Figaro Immo vous donne rendez-vous tout au long de l’année à de nombreuses manifestations : salon national de l'immobilier à Paris, salons immobiliers en province, … pour échanger et vous faire découvrir ses différents services.
Figaro Immo est édité par Figaro Classifieds.
Soyez exigeant, privilégiez la qualité et téléchargez sans plus tarder l’application Figaro Immo !

bluejetty:00161796:ios.description:
Quyết định phê duyệt nội dung kịch bản trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số: 155/QĐ-BTTTT do Bộ Thông tin và Truyền thông cấp ngày 29/04/2025
Khám phá thế giới kỳ ảo giữa tầng mây!
Tải ngay Vân Thành: Utopia – game nhập vai phiêu lưu kỳ ảo cực hấp dẫn!
Hóa thân thành Chiến Binh đến từ thành phố bay Edoras huyền bí. Đồng hành cùng Nữ Thần, vượt ải, chiến đấu Rồng và chinh phục bầu trời!
Thế giới mở rộng lớn đang bị đe dọa bởi thế lực hắc ám. Hãy liên minh cùng bạn bè, giành lại Utopia Mây và khắc tên bạn vào truyền thuyết!
====Tính năng nổi bật====
· Khám Phá Thế Giới Mây Trời: Du hành trong vũ trụ kỳ ảo, khám phá bí ẩn và tạo dựng tình bạn đáng nhớ.
· Phần Thưởng Cực Đã: Đăng nhập ngay để nhận tài nguyên và vật phẩm quý giá, thăng cấp nhanh chóng.
· Gameplay Đa Dạng: Không chỉ chiến đấu – câu cá, khiêu vũ, kết bạn và nhiều hoạt động thú vị khác!
· Tùy Chỉnh Phong Cách: Thể hiện cá tính với hàng trăm bộ trang phục, tỏa sáng theo cách riêng của bạn!

GdePosylka is a universal and convenient service for tracking mail. Enter the tracking number to easily find the package both in USA, Germany, Ukraine, China or any other country in the world.
GdePosylka is the official application of gde
bluejetty:00174427:ios.description:
GdePosylka is a universal and convenient service for tracking mail. Enter the tracking number to easily find the package both in USA, Germany, Ukraine, China or any other country in the world.
GdePosylka is the official application of gdeposylka.ru, so you can follow the same packages as on the site, receive notifications by e-mail and other messengers.
To log in to the app, use your e-mail and password from gdeposylka.ru. All information is automatically synced with the site.
All functions of the application are completely free! You can track an unlimited number of packages and receive notifications without any additional commissions. We check parcels on the official websites of delivery services every 3-5 hours, so you will definitely not miss new information about the parcel.
We support many postal services, including: Aliexpress Standard Shipping (Cainiao), USPS, UPS, DHL, FedEx, Pony Express Deutsche Post, Yanwen, PostNL, China EMS ePacket, Buffalo, Israel Post, China Post, HongKong Post, 4PX Express, SF Express, Royal Mail, Bpost, YunTrack, La Poste, Hermes, Meest Express, PakTrac eTotal, WnDirect, Asendia and many others!
Do you have feedback? Write to support@gdeposylka.ru
Attention! Our application has nothing to do with the postal services we track. We can't solve issues related to package delivery in any way.

bluejetty:00073889:ios.description:
App Store's highest-rated app to measure your Pupil Distance quickly and accurately. Measure your PD in seconds and order your next pair of glasses online for less.
PD, short for Pupillary Distance, is the distance between the center of your pupils in millimetres. This measurement is vital for the manufacturing of your prescription eyeglasses. This measurement is also useful for VR (Virtual Reality) Headsets.
App provides:
• Distance PD - For making regular glasses for everyday use.
• Reading PD - For making reading-only glasses, useful for phone/tablet use.
• Computer PD - Useful for desktop, laptop and notebook computers.
• VR PD - For use in Virtual Reality headsets.
Our app uses advanced algorithms to calculate your PD. Check out our positive reviews by thousands of satisfied customers.
------------
• For iPhone X and later models, use fully automated PD measurement in less than 3 seconds OR choose manual measurement method.
• Over 300 readings are taken and our advanced algorithm provides the most accurate results.
------------
• For models before iPhone X, Measure your PD in 3 quick steps.
• User-friendly interface and detailed help step-by-step.
• Advance algorithm fine-tuned over five years, calculates and gives precise results.
• Pupils are automatically detected.

Charades - The Ultimate Party Game for Friends & Family! - Get ready for endless laughter and unforgettable moments with Charades, the ultimate party game designed to bring people together! Perfect for parties, game nights, or casual hangouts, this interactive app takes your classic Charades experience to the next level.
Get ready for the ultimate party fun with Charades! Perfect for group games, family game nights, or adult parties with Dirty Charades decks. Act, guess, and laugh through categories like Movies, Celebrities, TV Shows, and more. Ideal for kids, couples, and friends! Use it like headbands for classic fun or spice it up with adult-themed decks. Charades is the ultimate guessing game for parties—download now for endless laughs!
Features You’ll Love in Charades Game
Play Anywhere: No more physical cards or headbands! Just download and play anytime, anywhere.
Categories Galore: Choose from dozens of categories like Movies, Celebrities, Dirty Charades (for adults!), Animals, Sports, TV Shows, and more!
Adult & Family-Friendly Options: Keep it clean for family gatherings or spice it up with hilarious adult-themed decks for 18+ fun.
Custom Decks: Create your own categories to personalize the game for any group or occasion.
Timer & Scoring: Built-in timer and scoring system to keep the excitement going!
How to Play:
- Pick a category or deck.
- Hold the phone to your forehead (or use it like headbands).
- Your friends act out or give clues for you to guess the word.
- Tilt the phone down for correct answers and up to skip!
- Why Charades is the Best Party Game:
Easy to learn, perfect for players of all ages.
- Brings everyone together—ideal for group games and team bonding.
- Includes Dirty Charades decks for adults looking for a risqué twist!
- Encourages creativity, quick thinking, and loads of laughter.
Perfect for Every Occasion:
Family Game Night: Clean and fun for kids, parents, and grandparents!
Adult Parties: Bring out the Dirty Charades decks for cheeky laughs with friends.
Team Building Events: Build camaraderie with engaging group games.
Couples’ Date Night: Test your communication skills with your partner.
Vacations & Road Trips: A fun way to pass the time with your favorite people.
Why You Need Charades Party Game?
Charades has been a classic party game for generations, but now it’s more accessible, versatile, and exciting than ever. With this app, you’ll always have the best party games in your pocket. Whether it’s a kids’ birthday party, adult gathering, or a casual night in with friends, Charades delivers fun for everyone.

bluejetty:00115437:ios.summary: As the most relaxing and interesting color ball sorting game, the color ball puzzle is designed to entertain and sharpen your mind at the same time. While sorting the colored balls to fill each tube with the same color, the relaxation it br
bluejetty:00115437:ios.description:
As the most relaxing and interesting color ball sorting game, the color ball puzzle is designed to entertain and sharpen your mind at the same time. While sorting the colored balls to fill each tube with the same color, the relaxation it brings will relieve stress and distract you from your daily worries. 
This classic color sorting game is pretty easy to learn, but hard to master. Just tap to take a colored ball from one tube and stack it into another tube, until all balls of the same color are in the same tube. However, there are ten thousands of puzzles of varying difficulty. The more challenging the puzzles you play, the more careful you need to be with each move. Each move cannot be taken lightly, or you may get stuck! This Ball Sort game is definitely the best puzzle game for you to exercise your brain and train your logical thinking.
How to play
You can only place balls of the same color on top of each other. Try to find empty tubes first, and then move balls there. The best solution to solve the puzzle doesn't exist. Every single way that leads to a win is perfect, so you can apply your own style of sorting balls.
Tips
1. If you go wrong, use “Undo” to go back to previous steps
2. Click the tube,This is the super-helpful feature for sorting! Use an extra tube and make ball sort levels easier. Add an extra tube if you get stuck.
3. You can restart the current level at any time.
Are you ready for the colorful gaming experience with the color ball sorting game? Download now and play with your family and friends! Who will be the master of Color Ball Sorting?

bluejetty:00128326:ios.description:
How many national parks have you explored? With Parks Seeker, track your progress as you visit the national parks of the United States and Canada. View detailed information about each park, check in with your GPS location when you arrive, and share your progress, badges, and photos with friends. Parks Seeker records each park you've been to, and lets you create a wish list of the ones you'd like to travel to next! You can expand with many other types of parks, too, including the United States of America's National Battlefields, Forests, Grasslands, Historic Sites, Historical Parks, Lakeshores and Seashores, Memorials, Monuments, Preserves & Reserves, Recreation Areas, and Scenic Areas, plus Canada's National Parks and Landmarks!
With Parks Seeker, you can:
 • Easily track your progress of parks visited and those still waiting to be explored
 • View detailed information about all 63 national parks
 • View an interactive map displaying parks and your check-ins
 • Check in to parks based on your current location, or create check-ins for past visits
 • Earn badges for different types and times of park visits
 • Add a photo to each check-in and view a gallery of all of your photos
 • Sync check-ins between multiple devices with Dropbox.
 • Share your visits and badges through social media, e-mail and text
 • Create a wish list of the parks you’d like to visit next
 • Locate the park closest to you based on your current GPS location
Parks Seeker includes all 63 of the United States' active National Parks:
Acadia · American Samoa · Arches · Badlands · Big Bend · Biscayne · Black Canyon of The Gunnison · Bryce Canyon · Canyonlands · Capitol Reef · Carlsbad Caverns · Channel Islands · Congaree · Crater Lake · Cuyahoga Valley · Death Valley · Denali · Dry Tortugas · Everglades · Gates of the Arctic · Gateway Arch · Glacier · Glacier Bay · Grand Canyon · Grand Teton · Great Basin · Great Sand Dunes · Great Smoky Mountains · Guadalupe Mountains · Haleakalā · Hawai'i Volcanoes · Hot Springs · Indiana Dunes · Isle Royale · Joshua Tree · Katmai · Kenai Fjords · Kings Canyon · Kobuk Valley · Lake Clark · Lassen Volcanic · Mammoth Cave · Mesa Verde · Mount Rainier · New River Gorge · North Cascades · Olympic · Petrified Forest · Pinnacles · Redwood · Rocky Mountain · Saguaro · Sequoia · Shenandoah · Theodore Roosevelt · Virgin Islands · Voyageurs · White Sands · Wind Cave · Wrangell–St. Elias · Yellowstone · Yosemite · Zion
If you like Parks Seeker, you may also enjoy Summit Seeker—the app that tracks your progress conquering the highest point in all 50 states!
Parks Seeker can use your GPS location to find the closest park to you, but the app does not require data or cellular service to use most features!
Learn more at www.parksseeker.com

How many national parks have you explored? With Parks Seeker, track your progress as you visit the national parks of the United States and Canada. View detailed information about each park, check in with your GPS location when you arrive, and share your progress, badges, and photos with friends. Parks Seeker records each park you've been to, and lets you create a wish list of the ones you'd like to travel to next! You can expand with many other types of parks, too, including the United States of America's National Battlefields, Forests, Grasslands, Historic Sites, Historical Parks, Lakeshores and Seashores, Memorials, Monuments, Preserves & Reserves, Recreation Areas, and Scenic Areas, plus Canada's National Parks and Landmarks!

With Parks Seeker, you can:
  • Easily track your progress of parks visited and those still waiting to be explored
  • View detailed information about all 63 national parks
  • View an interactive map displaying parks and your check-ins
  • Check in to parks based on your current location, or create check-ins for past visits
  • Earn badges for different types and times of park visits
  • Add a photo to each check-in and view a gallery of all of your photos
  • Sync check-ins between multiple devices with Dropbox.
  • Share your visits and badges through social media, e-mail and text
  • Create a wish list of the parks you’d like to visit next
  • Locate the park closest to you based on your current GPS location

Parks Seeker includes all 63 of the United States' active National Parks:
Acadia · American Samoa · Arches · Badlands · Big Bend · Biscayne · Black Canyon of The Gunnison · Bryce Canyon · Canyonlands · Capitol Reef · Carlsbad Caverns · Channel Islands · Congaree · Crater Lake · Cuyahoga Valley · Death Valley · Denali · Dry Tortugas · Everglades · Gates of the Arctic · Gateway Arch · Glacier · Glacier Bay · Grand Canyon · Grand Teton · Great Basin · Great Sand Dunes · Great Smoky Mountains · Guadalupe Mountains · Haleakalā · Hawai'i Volcanoes · Hot Springs · Indiana Dunes · Isle Royale · Joshua Tree · Katmai · Kenai Fjords · Kings Canyon · Kobuk Valley · Lake Clark · Lassen Volcanic · Mammoth Cave · Mesa Verde · Mount Rainier · New River Gorge · North Cascades · Olympic · Petrified Forest · Pinnacles · Redwood · Rocky Mountain · Saguaro · Sequoia · Shenandoah · Theodore Roosevelt · Virgin Islands · Voyageurs · White Sands · Wind Cave · Wrangell–St. Elias · Yellowstone · Yosemite · Zion

If you like Parks Seeker, you may also enjoy Summit Seeker—the app that tracks your progress conquering the highest point in all 50 states!

Parks Seeker can use your GPS location to find the closest park to you, but the app does not require data or cellular service to use most features!

Learn more at www.parksseeker.com

listings.name: Police Dog Duty: World Patrol
listings.description:
The Black Kite cartel is smuggling drugs, gold and contraband through the world's busiest airports, and only one team can stop it: you and your police dog.

Lead an international K9 unit on a World Tour. Train at the K9 Academy, then follow the cartel from Dubai to London, New York, Tokyo and Singapore. Every city has its own look, its own weather, new mission twists and one of the cartel's lieutenants to take down. The Kingpin waits at the end.

SNIFF, TRACK AND TAKE DOWN
Use your dog's powerful nose to find hidden stashes, pick the guilty bag off the baggage belt, follow a fading scent trail and spot the disguised smuggler in the crowd. When a suspect runs, sprint after them and take them down before they escape.

11 MISSION TYPES
- Chase and takedown
- Stash search and cargo container sweeps
- Baggage belt inspections
- Find the disguised suspect in the crowd
- Scent tracking across the airport
- Stop a getaway car, bus or truck
- Explosive detection against the clock
- Find a lost child from the scent of their toy
- Tail a suspect without being seen
- Multi-stage boss showdowns

FIVE WORLD AIRPORTS
- Dubai: golden sunsets, sandstorms and gold smugglers
- London: rain and fog that weaken the scent trail
- New York: night missions and vehicle chases
- Tokyo: huge crowds and cherry blossom, then a typhoon
- Singapore: an indoor jungle on several levels, and the final fight with the Kingpin

BUILD YOUR K9 UNIT
- 8 dogs to collect, including German Shepherd, Beagle, Labrador, Dobermann, Springer Spaniel and Belgian Malinois
- Upgrade Nose, Speed, Stamina and Bite
- Create your own handler and unlock new outfits
- Rise through 20 ranks, from Rookie to K9 Legend

ALWAYS SOMETHING TO DO
- Free Patrol: explore any airport you've cleared with no clock and take calls as they come in
- Daily rewards and daily challenges
- Hidden souvenirs to collect in your Passport
- Achievements, stars and gold stamps for every airport
- Treat trails, combos and things to knock over along the way
- No energy system: play as much as you like

Pick up the leash, Officer. The cartel won't stop itself.

PRIVACY POLICY
We don't collect any personal information. Any non-personal information collected by our partners, such as Google, is used for analytics and to improve the game.
Details: https://therationalstudio.com/privacy

SUPPORT
Rational Studios
Web: https://therationalstudio.com

bluejetty:00156300:ios.description:
Quyết định phê duyệt nội dung kịch bản trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số 298 /QĐ-PTTH&TTĐT ban hành ngày 27/06/2025. https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/75213.
Thức Thần Ký – Siêu phẩm game nhập vai chibi đậm chất Nhật Bản!
Bước vào thế giới huyền bí trong Thức Thần Ký, nơi hội tụ những thức thần cổ xưa, đầy quyền năng đang chờ bạn triệu hồi. Được lấy cảm hứng từ văn hóa tâm linh Nhật Bản, trò chơi mang đến trải nghiệm nhập vai mới lạ với đồ họa chibi cực kỳ dễ thương nhưng không kém phần kịch tính.
- Bạn sẽ hóa thân thành một người mang sứ mệnh triệu hồi và đồng hành cùng các thức thần để trừ tà, diệt quỷ, giữ gìn bình yên cho tam giới. Mỗi thức thần là một cá thể riêng biệt với tạo hình độc đáo và kỹ năng chiến đấu đẹp mắt.
- Điểm nổi bật của Thức Thần Ký:
Đồ họa chibi Nhật Bản sống động, nhân vật được thiết kế tỉ mỉ đến từng chi tiết.
Hệ thống thức thần đa dạng chia thành nhiều phẩm chất và thuộc tính khác nhau.
Gameplay nhập vai chiến thuật đỉnh cao, kết hợp PvE, PvP, bang hội, đấu trường xếp hạng, săn boss liên server...
Tùy biến thời trang, nâng cấp kỹ năng, xây dựng đội hình theo phong cách riêng của bạn.
- Thức Thần Ký không chỉ là một game, mà là cả một thế giới linh dị hấp dẫn đầy mê hoặc, nơi bạn là người viết nên truyền thuyết.
Tải ngay để bắt đầu hành trình triệu hồi thức thần!

bluejetty:00036692:ios.summary:
Master real-world conversations with fun AI avatars! Learn French, Spanish and 30+ languages. 
Experience a powerful mix of gamified role-play, interactive chat sessions, and authentic scenarios while naturally learning words and sound pat
bluejetty:00036692:ios.description:
Master real-world conversations with fun AI avatars! Learn French, Spanish and 30+ languages. 
Experience a powerful mix of gamified role-play, interactive chat sessions, and authentic scenarios while naturally learning words and sound patterns you need to become fluent. 
Discover a virtual 3D world populated by characters with diverse personalities and stories. Turn them into friends, building relationships while speaking about any topic. With LingoLooper, you're not just learning a language, you're living it!
YOUR LANGUAGE GOALS, ACHIEVED
Whether you're aiming for a career boost, planning to relocate, or simply want to break the language barrier and more, LingoLooper is your key to overcoming common language learning obstacles. Beat speaking anxiety and achieve native-level fluency, all in a judgment-free space to practice, be comfortable, and build stronger language skills at your own pace with continuous support.
IDEAL LANGUAGE LEARNING EXPERIENCE
• Travel in immersive 3D worlds: Journey through interactive environments. Order breakfast at a café in New York or speak about your favorite activities at the park in Barcelona. Meet new charming people in the center of Paris, and then some!
• Advanced feedback that fuels your progress: Get personalized AI-powered feedback on your use of vocabulary, grammar, style, and receive suggestions on what to say next. Your personal tutor monitors your advancement while building authentic speaking skills.
• Conversations that feel real: Meet over 1,000 AI avatars, each with unique personality, interests, and flair. Each session simulates real conversations, fostering deeper cultural understanding and helps you engage in communication that matches your needs.
• Library of knowledge: Save new words and phrases and track your progression to mastery.
• Flexible learning on your schedule: Our bite-sized sessions make it easy to stay on track with your learning goals. These targeted exercises adapt from foundation to advanced levels, expanding your vocabulary and grammar in real-life contexts.
TESTED AND LOVED BY 1.3 MILLION PIONEERING LANGUAGE LEARNERS
• "Talking to the characters is exactly what I wanted. They seem so life-like and personable. And they actually move, not just a static picture. Recommended for anyone who needs to practice speaking and listening and having fun at the same time." – Jamie O
• "Very cool! It is very rich in all parts of speech, synonyms and antonyms... Try it, it's so worth it – Lindelwa
• "It's a very interesting concept for language learning. It feels like a real game!" – Aljoscha
FEATURES
• 1000+ AI avatars with varied personalities and interests.
• Playful 3D world with different places to explore like a café, gym, office, park, neighborhood, hospital, downtown.
• Automatic conversation transcript.
• Personal knowledge hub of saved phrases and words.
• On-screen suggestions to support and keep conversations going.
• Personalized feedback on vocabulary, grammar, and context.
• Adapts difficulty to your skills.
• Compete in the LingoLeague with language learners and friends world-wide.
• Learn English, Spanish, Swedish, French, German, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Mandarin, Korean, Turkish, Norwegian, Danish, Portuguese, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Polish, Czech, Croatian, Hungarian, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Swahili, Arabic and Hebrew.
TRY IT FOR FREE
Embark on your language learning journey with LingoLooper. LingoLooper is currently still in early access, so you might experience a few bugs. We are also working on exciting premium features. To learn more about what's coming, check out the roadmap on our website!
Discover how LingoLooper can change the way you learn languages. Visit us at http://www.lingolooper.com/
Privacy Policy: http://www.lingolooper.com/privacy
Terms of Use: http://www.lingolooper.com/terms

bluejetty:00023744:ios.name: DALL E 3 AI Art Generator
bluejetty:00023744:ios.summary: DALL E 3 AI Art Generator turns a few words into art, tattoo designs, photo edits and short videos, right on your iPhone. Images are created by OpenAI's newest image model, the successor to DALL·E 3, so every result is sharp, detailed and r
bluejetty:00023744:ios.description:
DALL E 3 AI Art Generator turns a few words into art, tattoo designs, photo edits and short videos, right on your iPhone. Images are created by OpenAI's newest image model, the successor to DALL·E 3, so every result is sharp, detailed and ready to share.
TATTOO DESIGNER
• 12 tattoo styles: Fine Line, Traditional, Neo-Traditional, Tribal, Japanese, Blackwork, Realism, Watercolor, Minimalist, Geometric, Dotwork and Script
• Try it on: see your design on a photo of your arm, chest, back or leg before you commit
• Stencil export: turn any design into a clean black outline to bring to your artist
• Every design is created fresh from your idea, never a template
AI ART GENERATOR
• Describe anything and get an image in seconds
• 20+ art styles from anime to oil painting to cinematic
• Tap a suggestion or write your own prompt
• Square, portrait or landscape output
EDIT PHOTOS WITH WORDS
• Choose a photo, type what should change ("make it a cartoon", "add sunglasses", "turn day into night") and it's done
• Works on your own photos and on anything you create in the app
BRING IT TO LIFE
• Turn any image into a 5-second video with real motion and optional sound
• Describe the camera move or let the AI decide
• Save to Photos or share anywhere
SHARPEN IN HD
• Upscale to 2x or 4x with crisp, faithful detail
• Enhance mode adds painted detail for a dramatic before-and-after
• Compare the result against the original with a slider
SHARE AND DISCOVER
• Publish to the community feed and browse what others are creating
• Save everything to My Creations in full resolution
PRO MEMBERSHIP
• 300 creations every month included
• All tattoo and art styles unlocked
• Credits for extra creations, videos and upscales
HOW IT WORKS
1) Pick Art, Tattoo or Edit
2) Describe what you want, or tap a suggestion
3) Generate, then try it on, animate it, sharpen it or share it
ABOUT DALL·E 3 AI Art Generator
This app launched as one of the first iPhone apps built on the DALL·E 2 and DALL·E 3 API. OpenAI has since retired DALL·E 3, and the app now creates images with OpenAI's newest image model, its successor. DALL E 3 AI Art Generator is independently created by EllisApps Inc. and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by OpenAI.
Terms of use: https://ellisapps.com/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://ellisapps.com/privacy.html
DALL E 3 AI Art Generator offers a paid subscription for Pro features and one-time credit packs.

bluejetty:00174176:ios.description:
6-time Champion of the World AI Go Competition, AI Go Application
StarGo is used by Go fans and professional players at home and abroad.
Your ideal training partner and teacher.
The StarGo APP serves Go enthusiasts of all skill levels. If you are a beginner, you can find Go introductory courses for absolute newcomers to easily learn Go. If you are a Go player, the full-range AI players act as your exclusive training partners. In addition, live Go tournaments, StarGo Reports and a variety of fun Go features are your top choice to enjoy the fun of Go. If you are a Go student, professional Go teachers provide Go courses for you, StarGo Reports help you review your games, and AI lets you play Go matches. Besides, functions including Analysis, Special Training and Life & Death Problems are essential for your Go training. If you are a competitive player, high-level StarGo is undoubtedly your powerful tool to improve your Go strength. More Go game modes are coming to the StarGo APP, and various Go tutorials will be released. Stay tuned.
Play
- Play for free against 31 AI players with evenly distributed skill levels
- Full level coverage, from Go newcomers to top masters
- AI playing styles closely resemble human players
- Play matches with others, meet fellow players without leaving home
- Items can assist matches and also be used for review & analysis
- One-click score counting at game end; seki positions can be judged easily
Analysis
- 2 komi rules available for selection
- 6 configurations for flexible switching
- Supports analysis on small boards
- Win rate and statistics displayed clearly and intuitively
- Your own game records can be imported during analysis
- Turn on camera anytime, capture physical board photos for analysis
- Users may set the number of suggested moves and variation length as needed
Live
- Watch popular tournaments early for free
- Supported by abundant backend resources
- Stark comparison between actual moves and AI recommended moves
- Charts to track win rate trend, performance level, blunders and brilliant moves throughout the game
- Past live broadcasts can be reviewed anytime in public reports
Game Records & Reports
- Full access to your personal match history
- Brilliant moves, blunders, Go Strength Evaluation, performance level
- Review past live streams anytime with high-computing data retained
- Save favorite game records to collection
Record Game
- Record game records anytime and anywhere
- After recording, you may save, analyze or generate reports, etc.
- User-friendly correction mode
Special Training
- 4 difficulty modes, each with 4 skill tiers for progressive learning
- 8 challenge scenarios targeting common weaknesses
- Stage matches with low pressure
- Star-based level passing, replay challenges unlimited times
Life & Death Problems
- Light practice per problem with intelligently adjusted difficulty
- Clearly categorized themed units
- Ladder tests combining learning and gameplay
- AI solving technology
Challenge
- Massive question bank with over 50,000 problems
- Join the global ranking among all StarGo players
Photo Recognition
- Photo recognition for finished boards supports final score counting
- Unfinished boards can be analyzed
Game Record Restoration
- Import game record images with move numbers to automatically restore the game
- Intelligent guess of the order of captured stones
- Restored game records can be saved, analyzed or generate reports, etc.
Courses
- Premium themed courses by professional Go players
- Beginner courses with practice while learning
---

5 configurations and 3 durations of Star Card for you to choose freely
Extra discounts for annual subscription
---
Contact Us
If you encounter any issues during use, please contact us:
Customer Service WeChat ID: golaxy_xingzhen (After adding the customer service account, leave your message directly. Customer service is online intermittently.)

bluejetty:00174445:ios.description:
Morpho is a new take on conversions, focused on speed. Open, type a number, and instantly see all your favorite conversions. No fiddling.
Add all of your most-used conversions to the home screen so that you see what you want–and only what you want.
• Choose from 311 units and 174 currencies in 24 categories.
• Countries: view and add common units of measure from 256 countries and regions. Quickly view electrical information, calling codes, driving side, languages, and time zones to help plan your trip.
• Custom Units: Define specialized units for your profession or hobby, or add an uncommon unit that is not yet officially supported.
• Speak results: Select from 38 languages in Settings. Long-press a conversion and choose a language to have the result spoken to you.
• It's universal: iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. We have you covered no matter where you need a conversion.
• Long press for more: copy result, copy the full text of the conversion, or quickly add a reverse conversion.
• Conversions widget: new, interactive widget lets you convert your favorites instantly.
• Currency widget: use the currency widget to stay on top of changes throughout the day from your Home Screen or Lock Screen.
• Complications: launch Morpho from a complication, or use a currency complication to always have the latest exchange rate.
• Weather: instant temperature, wind speed, and precipitation amount conversions with Weather integration.
• Siri: get the full list of conversions using your voice.
• Shortcuts: work currency conversions into your custom shortcuts.
• Quick Notes: add values or countries to your Quick Notes.
• Keyboard support: make full use of your hardware keyboard.
• Hand Off, URL schemes, and multiple windows: enjoy.
• Support for dynamic type sizes and VoiceOver.
If you choose to purchase a Morpho Pro subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.
Terms of use: https://thinktapwork.com/tos.html

bluejetty:00127137:ios.description:
The Bible Verse and Prayer app brings the Holy Bible directly to you to celebrate God’s Word. Study, pray and read the Word of God which includes many different versions of the bible from the Old Testament to the New Testament - from Genesis to the Revelations. Choose different translations so you can easily understand the Word of God and the Gospel.
Find a plan to pray and study the Lord’s scriptures that focus on: 
 - Love 
 - Finding peace 
 - Dealing with anxiety 
 - Strengthening marriage 
 - Building patience 
 - Surviving grief 
 - Or customize your own plan! 
Receive your verse of the day, take notes, bookmark verses, and share with your friends and family! The Bible Verse and Prayer app keeps the Bible and the Gospel within reach every day to study, pray and read scripture. Customize your app with quick access to your favorite bible verses, bible reading plans, and daily devotionals to aid you in prayer, bible study, and keeping your mind bountiful with the Lord’s Word and scripture. 
READ DAILY 
 - Verse of the day to inspire you 
 - Easy access to the Holy Bible for daily reading of the Word of God 
 - Reading guides to help track your progress and find new insights 
 - Adjust text size to your preference to make it easy to read and study 
 - Bookmark, highlight, and share verses and God’s scripture that inspire you! 
BIBLE STUDY 
 - Offline reading of popular Bible versions 
 - Study different Bible versions: King James Version (KJV), American Standard Version (ASV), World English Bible (WEB), Webster’s Bible, Young’s Literal Translation, Bible in Basic English and more in multiple languages including: german, spanish, portuguese, french, italian, romanian! 
 - Side by Side reading of Bible Versions 
 - Take notes, bookmark, and highlight and share verses and scriptures 
 - Search the Bible for a specific verse or keywords 
SPREAD THE WORD 
 - Customize and share the verse of the day 
 - Find and share any verse from the Bible with a custom background and font 
 - Share with social media, email, messenger, text, or any way you like 
Explore The Bible Verse and Prayer app and enjoy a reading experience made to help you study and share God’s verses and prayers. 
----------------------------- 
The Bible Verse and Prayer App Premium Subscription 
----------------------------- 
Join "The Bible Verse and Prayer App Premium Features Club” to get: 
 - Access to all daily reading plans 
 - Limitless bookmarks and favorite verses 
 - No ads 
The Bible Verse and Prayer app has different subscription plans.
Subscription payments are charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period or trial. Subscriptions starting with a trial automatically renew for the indicated price after the trial period ends. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the trial period. 
Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase ("Settings" -> "iTunes & App Store" -> "Apple ID" and select "Subscriptions")

bluejetty:00069665:ios.description:
Rampage through a destroyed world and create the ultimate team of beasts!
World Beast War is an idle RPG where your monsters are created, merged, evolved and sent to battle in a war to reclaim the Earth. Merge monsters to build the ultimate rampaging team!
Beasts rage and battle across the screen, including classic monsters like King Gorilla, Lizard God and more! bluejetty:00029887:android.description:
Battles are what really ignite your love for professional baseball!
Enjoy Versus now!
◆◇◆What is Pro Baseball Versus? ◆◇◆
Play a real-time competitive baseball game with players from all over the country!
Enjoy the thrilling, authentic baseball action with simple controls for batting and pitching!
Free to download, no complicated registration required!
■Aim for the strongest team in the "National League"!■
Engage in heated online battles with players from all over the country, anytime, anywhere!
Beat countless rivals and become the best in Japan!!
■Choose from two play styles: "Player Mode" and "Manager Mode"■
Choose from "Player Mode" where you control the game manually,
or "Manager Mode" where you can issue simple instructions and manage the game!
Even if you're short on time or not good at controls, you can still play with peace of mind!
■Play games and earn "card packs"!■
In the National League, you'll always receive a card pack after each game!
Use scout points, which change depending on the game, to open card packs!
Get rare players!
■Organize your team freely with "Orders"■
In addition to changing the batting order, you can also change defensive placements, starters/relievers, pinch hitters, and pinch runners. Organizing your team's order is the key to victory!
Create your ideal lineup with the players you've collected!
■Develop your players with "Career High"■
In Career High, your level is determined by manual games where you respond to the manager's instructions and slot games where your performance determines your level!
Improve your players with luck and skill!
■Play "Pre-Games" with Friends with Ease■
Enter your room number to play a game with your close friends anytime!
■Enjoy the Game with "Full Live Commentary"■
Get the excitement going with full live commentary based on the game's progress!
Just like watching a live TV broadcast!
■Packed with Data Features!■
Baseball fans will love the ability to view their data!
Check your performance with each order!
-Provided by COLOPL, Inc.-
