bluejetty:00070834:ios.description:
The classic Spider Solitaire Cards Game that so many have played on windows is now here for you to enjoy and have fun with. Play the game in multiple modes to test your skill and thinking.
Spider Solitaire is similar to other types of solitaire. The goal of the game is to use 8 decks of cards and arrange them in order of king-through-ace. 
Spider Solitaire comes in 3 types of card games: 
- 1-Suit Spider Solitaire is played with only one suit (Spades).
- 2-Suit Spider Solitaire is played with two suits (Spades and Hearts).
- 4-Suit Spider Solitaire is played with four suits (Spades, Hearts, Clubs and Diamonds).
All Suit Games follow classic Spider Solitaire rules.
=- Spider Solitaire Features -=
- Game can be played in 1 Suit, 2 Suit or 4 Suit modes.
- Resume last played game.
- Game has multiple themes that users can choose from.
- Users can also set up there own custom themes by choosing cards, wallpapers or backgrounds from the list.
- Amazing Graphics and easy to use interface.
- Card Highlighting every time you pick it up.
- Unlimited Hints.
- Unlimited Undo Options.
- Game can be played in both Portrait or Landscape view.
- Intriguing puzzles to keep you interested throughout the game play.

bluejetty:00032588:ios.description:
حمل الآن تطبيق ريفي البراند الأول المتخصص في صناعة وتطوير الأرواب والمناشف في الشرق الأوسط
وتمتّع بعروض وأكواد الخصم على كافة المنتجات.
تطبيق ريفي هو التطبيق الأول من نوعه المتخصص في أرواب ومناشف
الاستحمام.
صُمم خصيصًا للتمتع بتجربة تسوق ممتعة بواجهات سهلة الاستخدام من قِبل جميع الفئات.
يتسم بالمرونة في التجول بين المنتجات والعروض، وسهولة الطلب والدفع بأكثر من وسيلة )فيزا، مدى،
أبل باي( لتختار الأنسب لك. هذا بالإضافة لنظام التقسيط على ) 3( دفعات من خلال وسيلة الدفع
"تمارا".
يضم التطبيق منتجات مُختارة ومصممة بعناية فائقة لتناسب مختلف أفراد الأسرة تحت شعار منتجات
ريفي " لكِ وله وللأطفال".
ستصبحي في حيرة من تنوع الألوان وأناقة الموديلات وتنوعها و بأسعار تنافسية.
من منتجات متجر ريفي:
أرواب الحمام.
أطقم مناشف.
كابا للأطفال والكبار.
مناشف الرأس.
منتجات ريفي ليس لها بديل بالأسواق؛ لأنها مصنوعة من خامة الكورال فليس المُطوّرة والمصنّعة
بتقنية المايكروفايبر، لتحصل على منتج مميز، سحري في امتصاص الماء، ناعم على بشرتك الحساسة،
وخفيف الوزن ويمكنك حمله في الحقيبة خارج المنزل دون أن يأخذ مساحة كبيرة.
يوفر لك تطبيق ريفي مختلف المقاسات التي تبحث عنها، وذلك من خلال خاصية محاكاة وجدولة
المقاسات بالتطبيق.
حيث يتيح لك التطبيق إمكانية تحديد مقاس الروب المناسب لك بدقة متناهية عن طريق قياسات الجسم
بالسنتيمترات، لتشعر وكأنك ترتدي الروب فعليًا وتتأكد من مقاسك قبل الطلب.
يوفر تطبيق ريفي خيارات الشحن والتوصيل لجميع أنحاء السعودية بضمان سرعة التوصيل وجودة
الاستلام.
جميع منتجات ريفي تصل مُغلقة بصندوق فخم، مُعطر ومجهّز يمكنك إرساله كهدية قيمة.
قم بتنزيل التطبيق الأن واستعد لاستبدال منشفتك القديمة وروب استحمامك المستهلك بمنتجات ومناشف
ريفي #الأكثر_جمالاً_ بالمملكة.
استخدم التطبيق وكن على اطلاع دائم بأحدث عروضنا وخصوماتنا المتاحة فقط لمستخدمي التطبيق.

حمل الآن تطبيق ريفي البراند الأول المتخصص في صناعة وتطوير الأرواب والمناشف في الشرق الأوسط
وتمتّع بعروض وأكواد الخصم على كافة المنتجات.
تطبيق ريفي هو التطبيق الأول من نوعه المتخصص في أرواب ومناشف
الاستحمام.
صُمم خصيصًا للتمتع بتجربة تسوق ممتعة بواجهات سهلة الاستخدام من قِبل جميع الفئات.
يتسم بالمرونة في التجول بين المنتجات والعروض، وسهولة الطلب والدفع بأكثر من وسيلة )فيزا، مدى،
أبل باي( لتختار الأنسب لك. هذا بالإضافة لنظام التقسيط على ) 3( دفعات من خلال وسيلة الدفع
"تمارا".
يضم التطبيق منتجات مُختارة ومصممة بعناية فائقة لتناسب مختلف أفراد الأسرة تحت شعار منتجات
ريفي " لكِ وله وللأطفال".
ستصبحي في حيرة من تنوع الألوان وأناقة الموديلات وتنوعها و بأسعار تنافسية.
من منتجات متجر ريفي:
أرواب الحمام.
أطقم مناشف.
كابا للأطفال والكبار.
مناشف الرأس.
منتجات ريفي ليس لها بديل بالأسواق؛ لأنها مصنوعة من خامة الكورال فليس المُطوّرة والمصنّعة
بتقنية المايكروفايبر، لتحصل على منتج مميز، سحري في امتصاص الماء، ناعم على بشرتك الحساسة،
وخفيف الوزن ويمكنك حمله في الحقيبة خارج المنزل دون أن يأخذ مساحة كبيرة.
يوفر لك تطبيق ريفي مختلف المقاسات التي تبحث عنها، وذلك من خلال خاصية محاكاة وجدولة
المقاسات بالتطبيق.
حيث يتيح لك التطبيق إمكانية تحديد مقاس الروب المناسب لك بدقة متناهية عن طريق قياسات الجسم
بالسنتيمترات، لتشعر وكأنك ترتدي الروب فعليًا وتتأكد من مقاسك قبل الطلب.
يوفر تطبيق ريفي خيارات الشحن والتوصيل لجميع أنحاء السعودية بضمان سرعة التوصيل وجودة
الاستلام.
جميع منتجات ريفي تصل مُغلقة بصندوق فخم، مُعطر ومجهّز يمكنك إرساله كهدية قيمة.
قم بتنزيل التطبيق الأن واستعد لاستبدال منشفتك القديمة وروب استحمامك المستهلك بمنتجات ومناشف
ريفي #الأكثر_جمالاً_ بالمملكة.
استخدم التطبيق وكن على اطلاع دائم بأحدث عروضنا وخصوماتنا المتاحة فقط لمستخدمي التطبيق.

bluejetty:00034938:ios.description:
JOYCAR is where new connections, friendships, and real conversations begin. Whether you’re behind the wheel or walking through the city, JOYCAR helps you discover people around you.
Imagine the everyday rush: traffic, city streets, a quick glance, a smile, a moment you wish could last longer. With JOYCAR, you don’t have to miss that chance. Connect through license plates, explore the city map, or join the public feed - and start a conversation that could make your day.
CONNECTIONS FOR EVERYONE
Make new friends, meet someone interesting, or simply enjoy a chat. Connect, message, and share moments both online and in real life.
DRIVERS AND PEDESTRIANS
Add your car or motorcycle plate number to your profile, like other users, join discussions, and connect on the road. No vehicle? No problem - JOYCAR is open to everyone.
PEOPLE NEARBY
See who’s around you, discover like-minded people, and plan meetups. Use the map to find interesting connections nearby.
BORDERLESS COMMUNICATION
Traveling or curious about someone from another country? JOYCAR translates messages into your language, making conversations smooth and easy.
A PROFILE THAT TELLS YOUR STORY
Upload great photos, share your interests, and let others get to know you. Post in the public feed to share your thoughts, experiences, or stories.
ROAD ASSISTANCE
Flat tire, out of gas, or need urgent assistance? Send a request with one tap - it will appear on the map so nearby JOYCAR users can see it and offer help.
SAFETY AND TRUST
Profiles go through verification, and suspicious accounts are blocked. We care about your comfort and safety.
PREMIUM FEATURES
Take your JOYCAR experience to the next level with JOYCAR Premium - our exclusive membership designed to make every connection even better:
• QUICK DATING - Send messages without waiting for a match
• SMART MATCH - See who liked you instantly
• SEE YOUR GUESTS - Find out who viewed your profile
• GLOBAL DATING - Meet people in any country
• PEOPLE ON THE MAP - Chat with drivers around you
• SECOND CHANCE - Rewind your last swipe
• SOCIAL LINKS - Get access to users’ social links
• ALL ADS OFF - Enjoy JOYCAR without ads
PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP
• We offer 1 day, 7 days, 1 month, and 3 months membership options
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• The 1 day option doesn’t require a subscription and doesn’t renew automatically
• Subscription can be managed by the user, and auto-renewal can be turned off in the user’s Account Settings after purchase
TERMS OF USE
• Fake accounts will be removed
• Inappropriate content and explicit photos are strictly prohibited
• You must be at least 18 years old to sign up for JOYCAR
• Promoting or seeking sugar dating or any other type of paid dating is not allowed
CONTACT US
• 24/7 Support - We’re always here to help in your language
• Feedback - Have ideas or suggestions? We’d love to hear from you
Terms of Use: https://www.madmad.app/joycar-terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.madmad.app/joycar-privacy-policy
Help center: https://www.madmad.app/joycar-faq

bluejetty:00183119:ios.description:
Battle Arena: Heroes Adventure is an incredible mix of RPG and MOBA with action elements. Show off your talent and tactical thinking, build an invincible team of heroes, defeat other players in real-time PvP battles, and destroy hordes of enemies in exciting missions.
Download the game for free and get ready for adventure!
Real-time PvP battles
Challenge players from all over the world. Crush your enemies in the Arena and become the best of the best.
Control your heroes in PvP battles. It isn't enough to have powerful heroes - you also need to make the right decisions at the right moments.
Build your own team!
Choose from over 50 heroes: a merciless undead leader, a furious gnome berserk, the keeper of an elven forest, a menacing robot shooter from the future, and many more.
Combine heroes and build a balanced team. Find your own unique combination.
Excellent graphics!
Over 60 amazing locations. Your journey will take you through virgin elven forests, scorching orcish lands, the mysterious city of Atlantis, and the cold cliffs of the gnomes.
Lots of heroes with gorgeously rendered abilities from a wide variety of universes. Heroes have all sorts of attacks. There's something for everyone: snowstorms, fireballs, poisoned arrows or missiles, blasters, and flashbangs!
Play with your friends!
Invite other players to join your alliance. Trade heroes and equipment with your friends.
Chat, share tactics, and fight friendly skirmishes.
Terms of Use: https://redbrixwall.com/en/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://redbrixwall.com/en/privacy
Follow us on:
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/BattleArenaHeroesAdventure/
Telegram https://t.me/baha_en

bluejetty:00150625:ios.description:
The Turtle Method: Your All-in-One Coach for Health. 
The Turtle Method offers a holistic approach to weight loss and long-term health. With expert-led help and community support, our philosophy is to take things one day at a time. Join 1000s of women who are escaping diet culture, food prison, and guilt eating for life.
Our all-in-one wellness app includes a calorie tracker, mental health diary, menstrual cycle tracker, workouts, and more.
Key Features:
Calorie Tracker & Counter: Our food tracker features a barcode scanner and a database of over 1.5 million verified foods. It's one of the best on the market, making calorie and macro tracking easy and accurate.
Personalized Health & Calorie Coach: Everyone has a unique daily calorie and macro requirement. Based on your data, we generate personalized targets and make tracking and adjusting them simple.
Weight Loss Coach: We understand that perfect tracking isn't always possible. If you're eating out and don't know the exact calories, simply use our "guess tracked" feature.
Holistic Wellness Coach: Track not just your food, but also your menstrual cycle, stress, emotions, sleep, training, steps, weight, and measurements. Turtle Method focuses on total health, not just weight loss.
Weekly Review for Accountability: Unlike other food tracking apps, we offer accountability. Complete a weekly review where the app analyzes your data and adjusts your targets if needed.
Community Support: Connect with 1000s of members through the app, FB groups, WhatsApp, and at our in-person events. Join our annual “Turtle Games”, post challenge events, retreats, local meetups, and more.
Live Workouts & Seminars: Access at least 3 live workouts per week, a weekly book club on Zoom, monthly mindset seminars, Q&As with our PhD in nutrition, daily podcasts, and more.
1-1 Support: Get 1-1 email support with our nutritionist. For more personalized help, weekly check-ins are available at a fraction of the cost of online coaches.
14-Day Nutrition Masterclass: Try the Turtle Way with our 14-day nutrition masterclass. Receive daily micro tasks, podcasts, and focus on our one day at a time approach. Rated 5* by all participants.
Seamless Integrations: Sync with Apple HealthKit, and Fitbit to track your steps and weight effortlessly.
Subscriptions:
We offer the following subscription plans:
Monthly
6 monthly
Yearly
The subscription will auto-renew. You can always turn this off by going to "subscriptions" under the App Store.

bluejetty:00046550:ios.description:
Do you feel unexplained headaches throughout the day, notice your face tense and achy when you pay attention to it, or catch yourself clenching your teeth without meaning to while you work, study, or use your phone? These, along with other symptoms, may be signs of a problem you didn't even know you had.
What is Daytime Bruxism?
Daytime bruxism is the habit of clenching and/or grinding your teeth while awake — often without realizing it, whether concentrating on work, studying, using your phone, or during moments of tension and worry. Frequently triggered by anxiety and stress, this seemingly harmless habit can have serious consequences. Tooth wear, dental fractures and restorations, headaches, facial pain, temporomandibular joint (TMJ) problems, a sensation of a tired or tense face, and even difficulty opening your mouth are just some of the symptoms you may be experiencing.
Discover how the Tolpie app can transform your routine:
Tolpie is an app created to help people like you deal with Daytime Bruxism — and with the anxiety and stress that often cause it — in a complete and welcoming way. Our mission is to provide a calmer and pain-free life.
Tolpie App Features:
∙ Customizable Alarms: Set reminders that adapt to your routine, with a fixed interval or with intelligent AI that adjusts the times based on your clenching situation throughout the day.
∙ Complete Statistics: Monitor clenching, pain level and behavior, facial map of critical points, related stress factors, and your relaxation progress, all in one place, with PDF export for professional follow-up.
∙ Guided Relaxation: Guided meditations and breathing techniques (such as 4-7-8, Square Breathing, and Heart Rate Coherence) to calm your mind and reduce stress levels.
∙ Facial Massage: Guided self-massage exercises through tutorials, designed to relieve tension accumulated in your face due to bruxism.
∙ Streak and Consistency: Track how many consecutive days you maintain the habit of unclenching your teeth. Seeing your progress is a powerful tool for building healthy habits.
∙ Pre-made and Personalized Challenges: In addition to bruxism-related challenges, create personal goals like walking, meditating, or staying hydrated, all of this helps with anxiety and stress management.
∙ Levels, XP, and Achievements: Level up with each completed challenge, unlock achievements, and track your journey in a motivating way.
∙ Ranking and Community: Compare your progress with other users on a weekly ranking, compete for Top 3, and be part of a community that shares the same goal.
∙ Tulpe AI — Your Virtual Friend: Vent without judgment whenever you need to. Tulpe AI is available to listen and chat about what's weighing on your day, helping you release the anxiety and stress that fuel bruxism.
Tolpie is not just an app; it's a companion on your journey to a pain-free and lighter life, caring for your body and mind. Download it now and start transforming your routine, taking care of your smile and your well-being.
Note: This app serves as a complementary treatment; for better rehabilitation, you should consult your dentist and other responsible health professionals to ensure complete treatment for your situation.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00081792:ios.description:
Grab a shovel, it’s dinosaur game time! The ultimate adventure game that takes you back in time to the age of the dinosaurs!
Dig out fossils, complete skeletons to discover new dino species, and hunt for prehistoric animal discoveries to attract many visitors to your Jurassic World exhibit. You can dig different sites to find a wide range of species, set up expeditions in America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania! Embark on this adventure and find exciting dinosaur species.
Complete the dinosaur puzzles and increase the collection of prehistoric animals in your Jurassic World Museum, attracting many visitors and earning money for upgrades! Make sure that all your visitors have an amazing experience and get to know the main species in this dinosaur games. 
As you progress through the game, you'll encounter different types of dinosaurs, each with their unique characteristics and behaviors. You'll learn so much about dinosaurs that you'll be able to call yourself a paleontologist!

When you complete the fossil puzzles, earn dinosaur sculptures and add them to your museum collection. Explore your 3D gallery, manage the artifacts you discover, and become a worldwide dinosaur tycoon. 
EXPLORE THE JURASSIC WORLD
Discover dinosaur species in America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania! Embark on this adventure, dig and find fossils in various locations. Become the best dinosaur hunter and become a worldwide zoological museum tycoon. Complete the daily exploration missions, attract more visitors and upgrade your museum of prehistoric animals.
So what are you waiting for? Grab your tools and start digging today!
This is a free offline idle clicker game. However, the game has additional features and extra packs that can be purchased in the store.

bluejetty:00015083:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00015083:ios.description:
Ace your CDL permit (CLP), HazMat, and all other endorsement tests in 2026. CDL Genie gives you exam-level practice questions for every endorsement.
What makes CDL Genie unique:
- 99.06% verified pass rate*
- Questions seen on the official exam
- Over 9,000,000 drivers prepared
- All CDL classes and endorsements 
- 73% more effective than the driver's manual alone, based on a nationwide survey.
- Authentic CDL Exam Simulator
- Personalized Challenge Bank™: a test that's automatically made up of your missed questions
- Detailed explanations and hints for every question
- Passing Probability
Exam coming up in a few days? Does the idea of getting your CDL make your palms sweaty? It should - because it’s one of the most important steps you’ll ever take.
Your entire career may be on the line. You know you can't sit around and do nothing. You deserve a better job. You deserve one that can support you and your family. You deserve more money. You deserve to live your dream.
We know that you just want to pass so you can get a better-paying job, but it's hard to get time off of work. That’s why we created CDL Genie: it's designed to help you learn everything you need to know to pass your exam faster. It's easy to use and has over 1,500 state-specific questions written by curriculum experts. You'll walk out of the DMV, feeling like you just took a first-grade spelling test. Our users swear that these questions are nearly identical to the real exam.
When you're getting your first CDL for a new job, you need all the help you can get. CDL Genie will teach you everything you need to know – from the parts of the truck, to how to avoid a truck accident, to how to properly display reflective tape. You don't need to know anything about commercial driving to start. Perfect for first-time applicants.
Pick and choose your CDL endorsements:
We have every current CDL endorsement covered. Use them to pass the official CLP or CDL exam for Class A, B, and C commercial license exams:
- General Knowledge
- Air Brakes
- HazMat
- Passenger Vehicles
- Combination Vehicles
- School Bus
- Doubles/Triples
- Tankers
- Pre-Trip Inspection
Learn at your own pace, whenever and wherever you want:
It's your career. You don't have to put it at risk by relying on a boring CDL manual. Instead, prepare whenever and wherever you want. Do it at work, on the bus, or while waiting for the kids. You can study whenever your schedule allows, so every minute counts. The program is broken down into short modules, allowing you to take it one step at a time when you have a few minutes to study. No more carrying around a heavy study guide.
Learn from the people who know the most about trucking:
Every single Premium question is written by a team of professional curriculum experts. They know exactly what you need to know, and what you don't need to know, to pass your CDL knowledge exam. They know the kind of questions that will appear on the official exam, and they'll help you learn it all. They even know which questions are most likely to appear on the test.
*See our Success Rate Research Report: https://driving-tests.org/premium/pdf/Driving-Tests-org-Success-Rate-Report-30-Nov-2023-compressed.pdf

bluejetty:00026079:ios.summary:
WaterStamp lets you add watermarks to videos, illustrations, photos, and other images.
You can add copyright text, credit text, and brand logos to clearly show ownership of your content.
Completely free with no registration or login require
bluejetty:00026079:ios.description:
WaterStamp lets you add watermarks to videos, illustrations, photos, and other images.
You can add copyright text, credit text, and brand logos to clearly show ownership of your content.
Completely free with no registration or login required.
— Features —
• Single text watermark
• Wallpaper style watermark
• Adjust text color, size, spacing, and transparency
• Outline text effect for natural blending
• Over 500 fonts
• Freely customizable colors
• Add your own logos and images as watermarks
• Image format conversion (JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP)
• Image compression
• Automatic removal of Exif metadata
• Batch processing for multiple photos
• Animated watermarks for videos
— New Features —
■ Video Pre-Trimming (v5.8.0)
Trim unwanted sections from the beginning and end of a video and change its aspect ratio.
As with images, you can set a size limit based on the video’s longest side to easily lower the resolution, resize the video, and reduce its file size.
■ Custom Fonts (v5.6.0)
Add custom fonts from .ttf, .otf, or .zip files.
Fonts are saved in the app, so you can delete the original files after importing.
■ Pre-Cropping (v5.5.0)
Set an image’s aspect ratio before editing.
Quickly prepare images for social media, marketplace listings, and other size-specific uses.
■ Watermark Studio (v4.0.0)
Create original watermark images in the app.
Ideal for multi-line messages like "Do Not Repost" and "No AI Training."
■ Free Positioning Mode
Press and hold in Single Style mode to freely resize and reposition your watermark.
■ Special Fonts for AI Watermark Removal Resistance
Dot patterns and random rainbow colors help make AI detection more difficult.
— About Image Handling —
All processing is done entirely on your device.
Your content is never uploaded or shared.

bluejetty:00182966:ios.name: Dominoes: Classic Dominos Game
bluejetty:00182966:ios.summary: Play the classic Dominos game, you can play in individual or duo mode. Whoever finishes with the pieces of your own hand first, wins! In each round, the player must place a piece on the board in order to match the numbers on one of the edge
bluejetty:00182966:ios.description:
Play the classic Dominos game, you can play in individual or duo mode. Whoever finishes with the pieces of your own hand first, wins! In each round, the player must place a piece on the board in order to match the numbers on one of the edges.
Over the years several versions have been created: All Fives, Draw Dominoes and Block Dominoes. This board game is also called muggins, domino, dominos game. The tiles or pieces are sometimes referred to as bones.
The rules here are a bit different, the game consists of 4 players, each starting with 7 pieces, which means that there are no remaining. All tiles will be present on the table, creating a new range of strategy.
When a player finishes with his pieces, he wins the round and the values of all the tiles in his opponents hands are added to his score.
In individual mode, the first player to get 100 points or more, wins. And in duo Mode, the first duo to get 150 points or more, wins.
Features
• Dominos Game does not require internet connection, ou can play anywhere you want!
• This app is optimized so that the pieces are comfortable in size for viewing, but if you need to, you can zoom in and move the board in any direction.
• Customize your game with various themes of tables and dominoes.

bluejetty:00151664:ios.description:
Sid Meier's Civilization® VII is now available on Apple Arcade, empowering you to build the greatest empire the world has ever known! This is the authentic Civilization VII base game experience, bringing the latest entry in the award-winning strategy franchise to your Apple devices including Mac, iPhone, and iPad.
In Civilization VII, your strategic decisions shape the unique cultural lineage of your evolving empire. Rule as one of many legendary leaders from throughout history and steer the course of your story by choosing a new civilization to represent your empire in each Age of human advancement.
• Construct cities and architectural wonders to expand your territory, improve your civilization with technological breakthroughs, and conquer or cooperate with rival civilizations as you explore the far reaches of the unknown world. 
• Expand your territory and command your armies using intuitive touch controls on handheld devices, or take advantage of mouse and controller support for both MacOS and iOS. 
• Pursue prosperity in an immersive solo experience or test your strategic mettle in online multiplayer with up to seven other Apple Arcade players.*
Whether you choose to follow a path rooted in history or reimagine possibilities to chart your own way forward, build something you believe in and create a legacy that echoes through the Ages in Civilization VII.
Civilization VII: Arcade Edition is an exclusive version and will vary from other commercially available versions. Check out the FAQs at civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/faq/ for more information about Civilization VII Arcade Edition.
*Online multiplayer requires an Internet connection, an Apple Account, and an Apple Arcade subscription. Online multiplayer with other Apple Arcade players only; cross-play with Civilization VII on other platforms is not supported. Up to eight players supported on Standard maps.
Do Not Sell My Personal Information: https://www.take2games.com/ccpa

bluejetty:00064787:ios.description:
Gerencie sua vida financeira com o app Banco Daycoval, a solução prática e segura para abrir, acompanhar e movimentar sua conta, administrar cartões e investir com autonomia. Com uma experiência intuitiva e moderna, você tem controle total das suas finanças em poucos toques.
Abra sua conta de forma simples e segura
Tenha acesso instantâneo a todos os serviços do banco direto no app: acompanhe o saldo, extratos, últimos lançamentos, posição consolidada, faça transferências via Pix, DOC ou TED e pague contas com o leitor de código de barras.
Invista de maneira eficiente e diversificada
O botão “Investir” coloca um universo de oportunidades ao seu alcance. É a plataforma ideal para quem busca investir em renda fixa, com opções como CDB, LCI, LCA e Crédito Privado. Para quem investe em renda variável, oferecemos acesso a ações e fundos imobiliários (FIIs). Explore também nossa prateleira completa de fundos de investimento, incluindo opções de fundos de renda fixa, fundos de ações, fundos multimercado e fundos cambiais. bluejetty:00019420:ios.description:
Step up to the crease and experience the most authentic mobile cricket simulator ever created! Smashing Cricket brings you unmatched realism, powered by the industry's most advanced bat-and-ball collision detection system. 
If you are looking for a true-to-life cricket simulation that tests your actual timing, footwork, and shot selection against lethal pace bowling, this is your arena. 
REALISTIC PHYSICS AND GAMEPLAY
No scripted animations here. Every single shot you play is calculated in real-time by our proprietary algorithm. Feel the satisfying crunch of a perfectly timed cover drive, or struggle against a sharp, rising bouncer. Our ultra-precise bat-ball collision matrix factors in edge angles, swing velocity, and ball trajectory to deliver flawless realism.
EXTREME SUPER REPLAYS
We are so confident in our collision detection technology that you can watch your shots in extreme super slow motion, more than 1000 times slower than real time! Choose from multiple camera angles and see close-ups of the ball hitting the exact middle of the bat. 
ACCURATE UMPIRE DRS
The most precise Decision Review System on mobile. Review wrong LBW decisions and get them overturned. Track the ball trajectory in super slow motion to verify the pitch, batsman impact, and stumps alignment.
INFINITE BATTING CHALLENGE
Enter the Infinite Batting Mode and face an endless, escalating barrage of world-class bowling. Build your strategy, protect your wicket, smash massive sixes, and set unbeatable high scores on the global, country, and weekly leaderboards.
CORE FEATURES
* Battery Life Optimization: Advanced performance improvements keep your device cooler and save battery life.
* True-to-Life Ball Dynamics: Experience realistic swing, seam movement, and variable pitch bounce.
* Dynamic Bowling AI: Face realistic fast bowlers, swing specialists, lethal yorkers, and deceptive slower deliveries.
* Play Offline: Enjoy the entire gameplay experience without needing an active internet connection.
* Play with Friends: Challenge friends across different platforms, share stats, and run private leaderboards.
* Progress Backup: Connect via secure login to ensure your stats are never lost.
Download Smashing Cricket today, grab your willow, and prove your skills on the pitch!

bluejetty:00060867:ios.description:

5. Credit cards settlement, Control your Cards & inquire their balances.
6. Pay to Friend, which is a service to transfer small payments for beneficiaries through their mobile phone numbers registered at the bank (without prior definition).

3. تحويل المبالغ بين حساباتك، الى حسابات أخرى بنفس البنك، الى حسابات اخرى خارج البنك و تحويل دولي من خلال تعرف الحسابات بشكل مسبق

6. تحويل للأصدقاء من خلال رقم الهاتف (الموبايل) و بدون تعريف مسبق لرقم حساب

bluejetty:00069219:ios.description:
See where rain and snow are heading. Watch precipitation move on the map, estimate when it may reach your location, and explore cyclone paths.
Open Rain Radar before you head out. Move through the animated radar timeline to see showers change around you. A location-based card helps you check whether rain or snow is nearby, happening now, or expected later.
Switch to Cyclones to follow available storm positions and tracks. Select a cyclone to see its path and details, including intensity and wind speed when provided.
Switch easily between Rain and Cyclones, use updated radar playback, and explore the refreshed map experience on iPhone and iPad.
Rain timing needs location permission and usable radar data. It is an estimate, not a guarantee; the app may show that data is unavailable or that no precipitation is expected within its current forecast window. The radar timeline includes recent frames and forecast frames where available.
Cyclone information comes from the Global Disaster Awareness and Coordination System (GDACS), subject to its data availability. Tracks are for awareness only and are not official warnings. Follow local weather authorities and emergency services for safety decisions.
Rain Radar is free to download and includes advertising. An optional Premium subscription removes ads. Monthly and yearly options, prices and any trial eligibility are shown in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

bluejetty:00142890:ios.description:
MExpecting a baby or already a parent? May is here for you before and after birth, with trusted advice, personalized guidance, and practical tools to make everyday family life easier.
Follow your baby's development week by week, explore content tailored to your needs, and find support at every stage of your parenting journey.
**FOLLOW YOUR BABY'S DEVELOPMENT, WEEK BY WEEK**
Before birth, discover how your baby grows each week with 3D illustrations, size and weight estimates, and key developmental milestones. Learn more about the changes in your body and get helpful tips as you prepare to welcome your baby.
**OVER 3,000 PERSONALIZED RESOURCES**
Explore thousands of articles, practical guides, and audio resources created with experts in maternal and child health. From preparing for your baby's arrival to postpartum recovery, sleep, feeding, breastfeeding, and development, find clear, reliable answers before and after birth.
**PERSONALIZED TIPS, EVERY DAY**
Get daily guidance tailored to your stage of parenthood or your child's age. Follow important milestones, learn what to expect before birth, and discover useful advice for the everyday challenges of life with a baby.
**TRACK SLEEP, FEEDINGS, AND MORE**
Log your baby's naps, nighttime sleep, bottles, breastfeeding sessions, and diaper changes in just a few taps. Spot patterns, keep track of daily routines, and find everything you need in one simple, intuitive place.
**HELP FOR YOUR BABY'S SLEEP**
Track nights and naps with dedicated tools, easy-to-read charts, and detailed sleep insights. Explore advice to better understand your baby's sleep patterns, create calming bedtime routines, and support healthy sleep habits over time.
**ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS, 24/7**
Wondering about sleep, feeding, daily routines, or your baby's development? Chat with Mya, May's AI assistant, for helpful information and personalized guidance whenever you need it. May's content is developed with healthcare and child development experts.
**A SHARED SPACE FOR BOTH PARENTS**
Share your baby's routines and milestones with your partner through a secure account. From getting ready for your baby's arrival to tracking sleep and feeds, stay on the same page and make family life a little easier together.
**AN APP THAT GROWS WITH YOUR FAMILY**
From the months before birth through your child's early years, May grows with you. Create profiles for multiple children, save your favorite resources, and discover tools designed for every new chapter.
**FREE FEATURES AND FLEXIBLE SUBSCRIPTIONS**
Enjoy free features and unlock additional tools and services with an optional subscription. Explore available plans in the app.
**IMPORTANT NOTE**
May provides educational information and guidance, not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Contact a qualified healthcare professional if you have health concerns or need urgent care.
Privacy Policy: https://www.may.app/politique-de-confidentialite-site-web-communications-marketing/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00170623:ios.name: Bump - real life is happening
bluejetty:00170623:ios.summary:
From the Zenly team, the original location sharing app loved by 100s of millions of people around the world!
On Bump, create a personal map of your favorite people and places with precise, real-time, and battery friendly location sharing.
bluejetty:00170623:ios.description:
From the Zenly team, the original location sharing app loved by 100s of millions of people around the world!
On Bump, create a personal map of your favorite people and places with precise, real-time, and battery friendly location sharing.
[Friends]
• See who your friends are with, their battery level, speed, and how long they’ve been somewhere
• Hear what they’re listening to right now
• Save their songs to your own Apple Music or Spotify library without leaving the app
• Shake phones to BUMP! and notify friends that you’re hanging out
[Places]
• Automatically detects the places you go so you can build your personal map
• Search for any place, see if your friends have already been, get directions there, or just save it for later
• See which bar your friends are at right now or if they’re at home, work, or school
• Join your school to see of a directory of everyone there and claim your frat or sorority
[Chat]
• Drop text, stickers, images, videos, and GIFs in a brand new chat
• Start 1:1 convos or group chats directly from the map 
• See (and even feel!) when friends are in the chat at the same time as you
• Don’t just chat — make art — and export your creations
[Scratch Map]
• Automatically build your own scratch map of everywhere you've been with your phone in your pocket
• Compete with friends to uncover 100% of your local area
• Keep track of where you’ve spent the night and who was with you
[Navigation]
• Get the route to join your people or places with Apple Maps or call an Uber straight there
• Share your live ETA to your friends’ lockscreen
• Buzz your friends when nearby to get their attention
[All the extra stuff]
• Turn your photos & videos into stickers to send whatever you want
• Get notified when friends travel to other states or countries
• Join your school to see what music is trending
• Use ghost mode to take time off the map
• Add location widgets to your home screen to quickly see what friends are up to
• Also works for friends who don't have iPhones!
• Siri & Shortcuts integration
• Free app
• Lots more coming soon!
Bump has been featured by Apple, TechCrunch, Business Insider, Highsnobiety, Wired and many more. They love Bump and you will too.
For questions, feature requests and exclusive merch, drop us a DM on Instagram: @bumpbyamo.

bluejetty:00023976:ios.description:
Pass your U.S. Citizenship Test with confidence. Updated for the 2025 Civics Test, with all 128 official civics questions, 20 practice tests, flashcards, an audiobook and everything you need for your naturalization interview — in one app.
Becoming a U.S. citizen is a life-changing milestone. US Citizenship Test helps you prepare step by step with accurate, up-to-date content based on official USCIS study materials. Practice every day, see your progress and walk into your interview ready.
• FEATURES
- Practice Tests
Take 20 full civics tests that work like the real interview. See instant answers with clear explanations, and detailed results after every test.
- All Official Civics Questions
Study all 128 questions of the 2025 Civics Test (and the 100 questions of the 2008 test), with answers and explanations.
- Topic Tests
Practice one topic at a time — American government, history, rights and responsibilities, symbols and holidays — and track your score for each topic.
- Flashcards
Learn faster with smart flashcards. Swipe to mark what you know and review what you're still learning.
- Audiobook
Listen to every question and answer, hands-free — on your commute, at the gym or at home.
- Learn From Your Mistakes
Review every test with your answer next to the correct one. Wrong answers are saved so you can practice them again.
- Answers for Your State
Look up your current senators, representative, governor and state capital, and the names of current officials such as the President and the Speaker of the House.
- Progress & Study Plan
Track your readiness, accuracy and study streak. Set your interview date and get a daily study goal.
- 65/20 Special Consideration
Applicants 65 and older with 20+ years as a permanent resident can study just their special set of questions.
- More Study Tools
Favorites, reading and writing vocabulary for the English test, USCIS case status tracker, PDF resources and dark mode.
- English & Español

- Updated for the 2025 Civics Test
- All-in-one: tests, flashcards, audiobook, English practice and case tracking

bluejetty:00180944:ios.description:
Revive the deserted local malls throughout the whole Japan.
Create your very own mall now!
Over 90 unique shops appear!
*Story
With the rise of massive corporate shopping malls,
the local malls you once grew up in were shutting down one by one.
Now that most of the shops are gone, the place feels so deserted.
Your family's tofu shop is going to meet the same fate soon...
"No! We cannot end like this!"
With this strong will in mind,
you decided to make the local mall thrive again!
And so you start to work on this great revival plan.
*How to Play
Build new shops and collect fund!
Upgrade your shops and purchase new equipments to increase profit!
With more funding, you can build more shops!
Beware! Bad characters may find their way into your mall too!
Take care of them swiftly, or build special facilities to keep them away!
You can also set up a variety of cityscape items and decorations!
From floor tiles to vegetations and decorative objects!
It's up to you to create a lively environment!
Gain reputation and you'll be able to move on to new areas!
*Play Tips
-Remember to upgrade the shops!
-Set up police box to keep the suspicious guys away!
-Check out the requests from townsfolks and response right away!
-Create a special mall with your creativity!
*Recommand to players who:
-Love the environment of good'o local malls
-Love to travel throughout the whole Japan
-Want to create malls by their own taste
-Enjoy shopping mall simulation games
-Admire miniature models
Auto-renewable subscription
- 100 JPY per week
- Subscription will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (during the period selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Cancellation of the current subscription is not allowed during the active subscription period, but you can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renew by going to your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase.
- Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: https://suk9.com/app/outline_en.php

With the power to manage your money anywhere, BigPay has one purpose, - to empower you with essential financial services to level up your lives, one transaction at a time. With the flexibility of a mobile app and physical card, we give you the flexibility to improve your spending habits in one place.
Benefits include:
1. SIMPLE and EASY EXPENSE TRACKING right in the app
2. SAVE EVERY TIME YOU SPEND with Stashes
3. Pay with PHYSICAL AND VIRTUAL VISA CARD or even make DUITNOW QR PAYMENTS in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia
4. FAST, SECURE, AND AFFORDABLE international remittance
5. SEAMLESS bill payments and prepaid mobile top ups in just a few clicks
6. INSTANT money transfers to friends on BigPay, or other local banks via DuitNow
5 Minute Sign Up
Download the app, verify your identity, add money to your account and voila your account is set up!
So many ways to pay anywhere you go
With instant transfers via DuitNow QR, international transfers give you the ability to spend in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. With our physical and virtual Visa cards, the options are limitless – spend and save with BigPay across the globe.
You spend it, we track it
BigPay automatically categorizes your spending across all your transactions so you always know where your money is going. Track your spending on a monthly and yearly basis and keep tabs of your budget.
Send money overseas faster, cheaper and safer
Transfer money to friends and family across the globe for little fees and competitive exchange rates. Fast, hassle-free and no hidden fees
Everything you need for your everyday payments
Use BigPay for all your money needs in one app. Pay your home utility bills such as electricity, water, internet, and more; plus mobile top ups and even lifestyle insurances to give you peace of mind in your daily life.
Save when you spend with Stashes!
Save a little (or a lot) whenever you spend with Stashes. Create multiple Stashes for all your financial goals
Earn points and travel deals
Score points for every transaction you make and turn them into travel deals with airasia rewards!
Empowering YOU and your money
It's our mission to make sure that you have everything you need to be in control of your finances. We give you the power to spend, track, and even start saving. Watch out as we continue building products and services that make managing your money as easy can be.

bluejetty:00137193:ios.summary:

Upload files, photos, videos, and more, then instantly get a download link you can share anywhere. Whether you want to use your own
bluejetty:00137193:ios.description:
Dropshare makes it easy to upload and share files from your iPhone or iPad using storage you already trust.
Upload files, photos, videos, and more, then instantly get a download link you can share anywhere. Whether you want to use your own server, S3-compatible storage, or popular cloud services, Dropshare gives you a faster and more flexible file sharing workflow on iOS.
Why Dropshare:
• Share files quickly via download URL
• Upload from Photos, Files, or the Share Extension
• Upload one file, multiple files, or ZIP archives
• Sync upload history across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud
• Use custom domains and supported URL shorteners
• Create custom download pages matching your personal or professional identity
• Supports Shortcuts for faster automation
Supported storage providers include cloud, file, image, and protocol-based services such as:
Cloud Storage:
• Amazon S3
• S3 API-compatible services (including OpenStack Swift, DreamObjects, and more)
• Backblaze B2
• Rackspace Cloud Files
• Filebase
• Scaleway Object Storage
• Linode Object Storage
• Microsoft Azure Blob Storage
• IDrive e2
• MinIO
• Alibaba Object Storage
• Bunny Storage
• Contabo Object Storage
• DigitalOcean Spaces
• Google Cloud Storage
• Hetzner Object Storage
• MEGA Object Storage
File Storage:
• Google Drive
• Box
• Dropbox
• OneDrive
• pCloud
• Nextcloud
• Horizon
• Zoho WorkDrive
• Koofr
• kDrive
• Fastmail Files
Image Storage:
• Flickr
• ImgBB
• Imgur
• vgy.me
• Lensdump
Protocol Services:
• SCP over SSH
• FTP / FTPS
• SFTP
• WebDAV
Dropshare also supports URL shorteners including Rebrandly, Bitly, short.io, and more. dsh.re is the built-in shortener and also supports custom domains.
Technical notes:
• SCP, FTP / FTPS, SFTP, and WebDAV require a working server account. Password or SSH key authentication may be required.
• S3 API-compatible services such as OpenStack Swift and DreamObjects are supported. See the User Guide for setup details.
• Google Drive, Box, Dropbox, OneDrive, pCloud, Nextcloud, Koofr, Horizon, Fastmail Files, and kDrive require an account with the respective provider.
• Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Rackspace Cloud Files, Scaleway Object Storage, Linode Object Storage, Microsoft Azure Blob Storage, Alibaba Object Storage, Bunny Storage, Contabo Object Storage, DigitalOcean Spaces, Google Cloud Storage, Hetzner Object Storage, MEGA Object Storage, and MinIO may require a paid plan depending on the provider.
End User License Agreement:
https://dropshare.app/eula/

bluejetty:00186686:ios.description:
Mastering English verbs can be a joyful and rewarding experience. Whether you're brushing up your skills or starting from the beginning, every moment spent learning brings you closer to confidence in English. Explore the world of grammar, vocabulary, and verb usage in a way that feels natural, intuitive, and enjoyable.
This app is designed to guide learners through the most essential part of English—its verbs. With a clear and structured approach, it supports understanding of tenses, irregular verbs, and verb conjugation. Perfect for those who want to make progress in English fluency and build strong grammar foundations.
The grammar section offers detailed explanations of English verbs. From simple past to future perfect, regular to irregular, every topic is covered with precision. After each lesson, 15+ types of exercises allow users to practice and reinforce their knowledge right away. Verb forms and conjugations become easier with repetition and interactive learning.
Real-world texts make the journey more meaningful. You can read curated excerpts from well-known newspapers and magazines with highlighted verbs that show how grammar works in practice. Classic literature provides a timeless way to see verbs in action, while exercises help identify the right forms in everyday sentences. Understanding verb usage in real contexts becomes second nature.
Interactive practice keeps learning engaging. Sentences appear on screen with missing verbs to complete, and multiple-choice questions offer immediate feedback. The format encourages active thinking and sharpens your grammar instincts. It's both challenging and fun, keeping learners motivated with every session.

bluejetty:00155617:ios.description:
◇すべての女性に寄り添う、医師監修のフェムケアサポートアプリ◇
妊娠しやすい時期、妊娠しづらい時期がひとめでわかり、これまで予測が難しかった生理不順にも対応。
一人一人の周期と妊娠希望に合わせて、入力データを元に専門医のアドバイスがもらえます。
生理、妊活、婦人科系の病気…人には相談しづらい女性のカラダの悩みをGrace Careが解決します！
◇こんな方へオススメです◇
・生理不順で次回の生理日が分からず予定が立てられない
・妊活を始めたいけれど何からやれば良いの？
・不妊治療を続けているけれど、なかなか授かれず悩んでいる
・生理、排卵、卵管、子宮など、婦人科系の悩みがある
・冷え症やPMS、基礎体温のばらつきなど、自分の体質に不安がある
・専門家のアドバイスがほしい
◇あなたをサポートする5つの特徴◇
--------業界初！アプリで卵巣年齢（AMH値）診断--------
日々の生理・排卵・基礎体温記録をもとに、あなたの卵巣年齢＆卵子保有数を予測します。卵子の数は、妊活や女性の身体において、とても重要なキーワードです。あなたの今の卵子＆卵巣の状態をチェックして、将来に向けて自分に合った計画を立ててみましょう。
※生理周期が安定している場合、実測値に近い数字の予想が可能ですが、より正確な値を把握するために、提携クリニックでの採血による検査をお勧めします。
--------より正確な排卵・生理予測--------
杉山産婦人科理事長の杉山力一先生の、25年にわたる不妊治療の研究実績をもとに生まれた独自ロジックで、生理＆排卵日を予測します。
これまで、生理不順で先々の予定が立てられずに悩んでいた方や、排卵日がわからず妊活のタイミングがつかめなかった方、それぞれの希望にフィットした予測を実現しました。
--------先生にお悩み相談--------
監修医である杉山先生へのQ&Aを公開中
生理のコト、妊活のコト、体調のコト…
あなたの抱えているお悩みのヒントも発見できるかも！
--------医師監修コラム・妊活情報--------
妊活・生理から美容や健康の情報まで、あなたの生活にきっと役立つ情報が満載です。
--------全国の厳選生殖医療クリニックと提携--------
生殖医療の分野で確かな実績を誇る全国の提携クリニックにおいて、婦人科や生殖医療の診療を受けることができます。アプリ内から各クリニックの予約画面にダイレクトに遷移でき、病院選びのお悩みを解決します。
◇利用規約・プライバシーポリシー◇
https://www.eggslab.jp/#sec13
◇お問い合わせ◇
皆さまからの貴重なご意見・ご感想としてレビューを拝見しておりますが、すべてのレビューにお答えすることができない場合がございます。
恐れ入りますが、ご不明な点や不具合などがございましたら、下記アドレスまでお問い合わせいただきますようお願いいたします。
support@gracebank.jp

bluejetty:00117951:ios.description:
Highly rated by teachers, parents and kids of all ages!
This is the school version of the popular Big Math Flash Cards app with all the features unlocked.
Flip the card just like a real flash card! Simple, clean and easy to use interface. The front side of the card shows the question and the back side of the card shows the possible answers. Just tap to flip the card. Once you answer the question correctly, flick the card off the screen by swiping up.
Included Features
* Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division
* Score percentage and elapsed time displayed
* Configurable number of questions
* Configurable number of answers for multiple choice
* Supports landscape or portrait card display modes
* Selectable flash card color themes
* Turn all sounds on or off
* Review Incorrect - review the questions that were answered incorrectly
* Score Cards - view and review past scores and questions
* Specific Numbers - customize the first and second card number ranges
* Mixed Operations - ability to have cards with mixed operators
* Flash Card Mode - displays the answer instead of multiple choice (swipe up to mark the card correct, swipe down to mark the card incorrect)
* Manual Entry Mode - type your answer instead of selecting from a choice of possible answers
* Custom Cards - make your own custom card set questions
* Time Per Card - allows you to set a time limit for each card

bluejetty:00088670:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00088670:ios.description:
Cue – The Hands-Free AI Meeting Note Taker
Stay fully engaged in every conversation without the hassle of taking notes. Cue uses cutting-edge AI to capture discussions— in person or online—and instantly produce accurate summaries, action items, and key information. Whether you’re in a business meeting, attending a class, catching up with friends, or brainstorming on an afternoon walk, Cue ensures you never miss a crucial detail. No distractions—only the information you care about. 
Why Cue?
Advanced AI Accuracy
Cue uses state-of-the-art speech recognition and natural language processing to handle multiple speakers and even the most technical jargon —so you always have reliable, high-quality notes.
Automatic Summaries & Action Points
No more wading through endless transcripts. Cue condenses lengthy discussions into concise, easy-to-digest summaries, complete with actionable to-do lists and clear next steps.
Privacy & Security First
Your data remains yours alone. Cue never sells or grants third parties access to your recordings or transcripts. Export, share, or delete your files any time, with total peace of mind.
Hands-Free & Distraction-Free
Focus on the conversation and let Cue do the work. Once you tap to record, it quietly transcribes in the background, ensuring you stay present and engaged.
Search & Ask Questions
Quickly retrieve vital moments or details by searching for keywords in your transcripts. Go deeper with AI-driven queries like, “Which deadlines were decided in Monday’s meeting?” to pinpoint answers without leafing through reams of text.
Flexible Use Cases
Meetings & Conferences: Transform real-time audio into polished meeting notes, complete with speaker labels.
Lectures & Study Sessions: Let Cue be your personal study companion, transcribing and summarising lessons for faster revision.
Creative Brainstorms: Capture every idea and seamlessly compile them into shareable insights.
Professional Interviews & Research: Keep track of critical data when interviewing clients, stakeholders, or subjects for qualitative studies.
Personal Productivity: Record daily thoughts, reminders, or journaling, and let Cue organise it all for you.
Multilingual Support
Need Spanish transcripts with English summaries? Cue supports multiple languages for transcription and summarisation, so you can collaborate across diverse teams or practise your language skills with ease.
Calendar Integration
Never miss a moment with Cue's smart calendar sync. Connect your Google, iCloud, or Microsoft calendars to receive timely reminders before each event—ensuring you’re always ready to capture key insights. Whether it’s a meeting, class, or personal check-in, Cue helps you stay on top of your schedule and start recording right on time.
—
How It Works
1. Open Cue
Launch the app just before your meeting, class, or brainstorming session begins.
2. Start Recording
Cue listens discreetly in the background, automatically transcribing every word without interrupting the conversation.
3. Receive Summaries & Action Items
When you’re done, Cue compiles all key points, tasks, and next steps into a concise summary, ready for immediate review.
4. Review & Share
Edit if needed, then export your transcripts or summaries as PDFs, emails, or URLs. Perfect for collaborating with teams or classmates.
Have a question for us? Email us at: cue-support@44pixels.ai
Privacy Policy: https://44pixels.ai/privacy
Terms of Use: https://44pixels.ai/cue-terms

bluejetty:00035809:ios.description:
Level up your training with Metric, the most advanced workout tracking app that combines traditional logging with revolutionary velocity-based training - no expensive hardware required.
TRUSTED BY LIFTERS WORLDWIDE
1.5 million sets tracked | 100,000 downloads | Lifters and coaches in over 140 countries
WHAT USERS ARE SAYING
"Super simple to download and just start using. Great for getting clients and athletes to engage with their training in new ways. Can't believe this hasn't been done sooner!" - rugoody
"Amazing to not have to pay thousands for a unit or even attach anything to a bar. Just click record on your camera and I can track my athletes Bar Velocity so easily." - Giannire
"For not needing to buy any equipment this is a great tool. The vbt trackers go from 400 and up so for this to do what it does with nothing is amazing." - NoelpereziPhone6P
"The app is brilliant. Superb for checking/tracking form and progression at the same time. I took an annual sub out after 5 days" - far.landscape
Whether you're a powerlifter preparing for a meet, training to improve your athleticism on the field, or simply looking to get stronger and build muscle in the gym, Metric transforms how you train and coach. 
Gain insights that were previously only available to professional athletes, maximize your strength gains, and prevent injuries through proper technique and load management. Train with complete confidence as Metric's data shows your fatigue levels, recovery rates, and progression trends in real-time- helping you make smarter decisions about when to push harder and when tor regulate and recover. While traditional velocity tracking requires expensive and cumbersome external devices, strings or wearables, Metric delivers the same precise, validated measurements using just the camera on your iPhone or iPad, making actionable lifting insights accessible to everyone.
CORE FEATURES
SMART VELOCITY TRACKING
- Track bar speed on 60+ exercises with validated accuracy
- Receive audio cues when you hit specific velocity targets
- Monitor fatigue through velocity loss during sets
- Calculate estimated 1RM based on scientific velocity profiles
- No additional hardware needed - just your phone
- Record a quick set or incorporate velocity tracking into your workout flow
ADVANCED VIDEO ANALYSIS
- Record or import HD lifting videos
- Generate detailed bar path traces for every rep
- Review technique frame-by-frame
- Share videos and analysis with coaches
- Export videos to your camera roll
COMPREHENSIVE WORKOUT LOGGING
- Build, save and log your entire workout
- Build and share templates to plan in advance
- Access 150+ pre-loaded exercises
- Create custom exercises
- Track sets, reps, weight, and RPE
- Automated rest timer
PERFORMANCE INSIGHTS
- Monitor strength progression
- Track power output trends
- Analyze ROM consistency
- View velocity trends over time
- Track estimated 1RM
- load-velocity and load-power profiling
- Real-time RPE charts and RPE-1RM estimations
PERFECT FOR
- Powerlifters, Strongman, and Olympic lifters
- CrossFit and functional training
- Bodybuilders and hypertrophy training
- Strength and conditioning coaches
- Performance-focused athletes
- Personal trainers and online coaches
- Any lifter wanting data-driven results
GETTING STARTED IS SIMPLE & FREE
1. Select your exercise
2. Position your phone to capture your lift from the side
3. Record your set
4. Get instant velocity and technique analysis
5. Track single sets or complete entire workouts
FREE, PRO, & COACH OPTIONS
Record sets and workouts for free. Upgrade to Pro for advanced analytics, template builder, real-time feedback, and in-app video storage. Pro Coach plans also available for logging athlete workouts
Join thousands of lifters using Metric to train smarter and maximize their gains.

bluejetty:00165132:ios.description:
Summary AI makes meetings more productive by automatically recording, transcribing, and summarizing conversations. Whether it’s a business meeting, interview, classroom lecture, or podcast, Summary AI captures everything clearly so you can stay present and focus.
With one tap, the app records audio, generates accurate transcripts with speaker labels, and creates easy-to-read summaries. You can even ask questions like, “What were the key action items from the marketing strategy session?” and get instant answers, thanks to built-in AI.
Why Use Summary AI?
Take and share professional meeting notes effortlessly
Record and transcribe interviews, lectures, webinars, and podcasts
Generate captions for people with hearing impairments or quiet audio environments
Who Uses Summary AI?
Professionals: Capture meeting notes, action items, and client discussions
Students: Record and review lectures, study groups, and seminars
Journalists & Researchers: Transcribe interviews with precision
Everyone: From voice memos to webinars, it handles it all
Key Features
One-Tap Recording
Start recording instantly and stay focused. Summary AI takes care of the rest.
Unlimited Recording Time
Record as much as you need, no time limits, no interruptions.
Records in the Background or with Screen Locked
Keep recording while your phone is locked or you're using other apps. Perfect for discreet, uninterrupted sessions.
Accurate Transcription with Speaker Labels
Transcripts that make sense, clearly labeled, searchable, and easy to review.
AI-Powered Summaries & Key Points
Don’t just get a transcript, get the big picture with bullet-pointed summaries.
Smart Search & Timestamp Jumping
Type a keyword, jump straight to that moment in the recording.
Ask Questions About the Conversation
Get instant answers from the AI like “Who was assigned the budget review?”
Automatic Punctuation, Capitalization & Line Breaks
Clean, easy-to-read transcripts without any manual formatting.
Boost Your Productivity
Save time reviewing meetings, just skim the summary
Stay present in conversations, not distracted by note-taking
Export notes to PDF, share with teams, or save for personal reference
Never lose a detail, everything is searchable
Your recordings and notes are private, always. Summary AI prioritizes security, and your data is never shared with third parties.
Privacy Policy: https://summary.ai/privacy
Terms of Use: https://summary.ai/terms

bluejetty:00167984:ios.description:
Welcome to Mart Sort Master: Triple Match, the ultimate sorting game that blends fun with strategy! Dive into a vibrant world where your mission is to move and match identical items to clear the shelves and progress through thrilling levels.
Game Features:
Engaging Triple Match Gameplay: Dive into the addictive world of sorting games. Experience the thrill of clearing shelves by matching three or more identical items. Perfect for fans of triple match and sorting games!
Strategic Sorting Challenges: Test your thinking and strategy skills as you sort and match a variety of goods. Plan your moves carefully to improve your score and complete levels faster.
Beautiful 3D Graphics: Enjoy visually stunning 3D environments and smooth animations. The realistic shopping experience enhances the gameplay.
Special Items and Power-ups: Unlock unique items and power-ups to boost your performance and overcome challenging obstacles. Master their usage to become a true Triple Match pro.
Play Anywhere, Anytime: Enjoy Mart Sort Master: Triple Match online or offline. No WiFi required! Perfect for on-the-go gaming.
Varied Difficulty Levels: Challenge your brain with a range of difficulty levels. Progress from easy to complex challenges that showcase your gaming skills.
Suitable for All Players: Whether you're a casual gamer seeking entertainment or a puzzle enthusiast looking for a new challenge, this game caters to all players.
How to Play:
- Tap on three identical items to match and clear them from the shelves.
- Complete the goal set at the beginning of each level to advance.
- Use boosters to help you sort through items and pass tricky levels.
- Each level has a timer, so think fast and act quickly!
Join the fun world of Mart Sort Master: Triple Match today! Download now and embark on a thrilling adventure of sorting, matching, and endless entertainment. Prove yourself as the ultimate master of goods sorting!

bluejetty:00027352:ios.name: Tradera – buy & sell
bluejetty:00027352:ios.summary:
Warm welcome to Tradera, the largest marketplace in the Nordics. 
At Tradera, both buyers and sellers are verified, making Tradera a safe and secure marketplace. Payments are made through integrated payment methods. Items can easily be sh
bluejetty:00027352:ios.description:
Warm welcome to Tradera, the largest marketplace in the Nordics. 
At Tradera, both buyers and sellers are verified, making Tradera a safe and secure marketplace. Payments are made through integrated payment methods. Items can easily be shipped directly to your home.
We have three million items for sale, and whether you're looking for a PlayStation, a retro scooter, a pasta machine, plants, or a winter jacket, we dare to promise that there's something for you.
If you want to sell items you no longer use, Tradera is the right place to turn those unused items into money in a simple and secure way. As a seller, you decide how you want to sell, whether through exciting auctions or quick purchases via our "Buy Now" format. As soon as the item is sold, you can easily book shipping directly in the app and receive a QR code on your mobile.
At Tradera, we are passionate about making circular shopping as easy and safe as buying new, and we are proud and happy that you are here, driving the change with us!
More advantages of Tradera:
For sellers:
- It's easy to sell. No haggling or similar from buyers, making the experience very smooth, and the selling process "takes care of itself."
- No meetings with strangers unless you choose to. 
- Shipping at Tradera is simple and smooth. You can choose whether you want to offer pickup, which is also possible.
- Simple integrated shipping directly in the app.
- You can see immediately in the app when the buyer has paid, and you can book shipping and send the package using the shipping method you have chosen.
For buyers:
- Just as easy to shop on Tradera as buying new. You can easily participate in bidding through autobids if you want.
- Add unique items to your watchlist to not miss out when the bidding ends.
- If you want to shop directly and don't want to wait for a bid to end, it's possible to "Buy Now" on items with that format. You can also filter for it directly in your search results if you only want to see these items.
- If an auction has ended but the item hasn't been sold, you can now also send a buyer inquiry even after the auction has ended.
- After winning an auction or purchasing an item, you can easily pay via various payment methods directly in the app.
Welcome to Tradera!

bluejetty:00092226:ios.description:
Hiro and Nori have not forgotten the reason why they came to the United States: to serve authentic ramen with excellent service and bring joy to their customers.
The HiroNori team brings together over 15 years of passion and culinary experience.
They hope that this can lead to a more peaceful world: good relationships between employees will lead to a more positive atmosphere, a happier atmosphere will lead to happier customers, and happy people will have a positive impact on the community. In this light, HiroNori believes that the world can become a better place — one bowl of ramen at a time.
Since opening our first location in 2017, we have been pushing to create unmatched ramen while staying true to our mission. In 2019, we were honored to be recognized by the Michelin Guide.

ATTENTION! Trough this application you can’t learn how to play violin, but you will have great fun.
 Violin is one of the most romantic instruments in the world. Whenever we hear violin sounds we remember of some romantic moments. But now you can enjoy in violin music every time you wish. With our Violin Music Simulator your virtual violin will always be with you and you will always be ready to play music. We prepared for you real violin effects, so when someone hear you play the best music they will be delighted. And you will be laughing at him because he don’t know that you are not really play music, your violin simulator do that for you.
This music app is ideal for every occasion. For example, if you are in the company of some friends and you are bored just play violin music on your android phone and atmosphere will be so much better. works on all screen resolutions: phones and tablets
looks and sounds like real violin

bluejetty:00126274:ios.description:
Tenha um aplicativo completo feito para todo cristão.
Com Bíblia Almeida para você acessar de onde quiser sem precisar ter acesso à internet. Escolha facilmente os livros da Bíblia e compartilhe os versículos bíblicos que você mais gosta.
Você vai encontrar as melhores ferramentas para o cristão realizar o devocional diário.
Além da Bíblia sagrada Almeida, você tem um espaço com devocional do dia para você ler uma mensagem para meditar na palavra de Deus.
Espaço de orações para você compartilhar com irmãos em Cristo seus pedidos. Você também pode orar a Deus e ajudar pessoas no nosso chat cristão para aconselhar de acordo com a palavra do Senhor.
Receba um versículo do dia e compartilha a mensagem do Senhor em forma de imagem. Todos os dias lindas mensagens da Bíblia para você.
Um Quiz para você testar os conhecimentos Bíblicos e aprender mais sobre a Bíblia. Compartilhe sua pontuação com os amigos da igreja. Desafie e mostre quem é melhor de Bíblia. Um classificação para você comparar os melhores jogadores da semana e do mês.
Com rádio evangélica Cristã para você ouvir todos os dias e louvar ao Senhor. Escute as melhores músicas cristãs no seu celular.

bluejetty:00039822:ios.description:

Vi fokuserer selvfølgelig på det danske vejr, men med telefonens GPS får du altid den nærmeste vejrudsigt ud af DMI’s godt 300.000 mulige lokationer. I Danmark har app’en al den vejrinformation, du kan ønske dig. Du kan se på radaren, om vasketøjet skal ind, du kan se på satellitbilleder, om vejrsystemer nærmer sig, og du kan se meteorologernes skrevne udsigter, når du skal have overblikket. 
Du får naturligvis også en advarsel, når der er farligt vejr på vej.

bluejetty:00024898:ios.description:
Smart Dice Merge-Block Puzzle, a classic addictive match-3 and block puzzle game that combines strategy, skill, and fun! Merge dice, clear levels, and challenge your brain with this simple yet exciting merge board game. Play dice games anytime, anywhere.
Easy To Play
- Rotate dice blocks before dragging them onto the puzzle board.
- Place dice onto the 5*5 blocks board.
- Match three or more dice with same dot or same number, to merge them horizontally, vertically, or both into a higher value.
- Merge dice from 1 (one dot) to 6 step by step.
- The dice game will be over once there is no space for more dice.

- Boosters like Hammer, Undo, Magnet, and Refresh to help you score higher.
- Brain-Boosting Gameplay - Exercise your mind while having fun.
- Daily Dice Merge Challenges and Score Goals to keep you engaged.
- Relaxing Yet Challenging dice puzzle gameplay, no time limits.
- Spin the Fortune Wheel and test your luck for extra rewards
- Play Anytime, Anywhere - A perfect classic dice merge game to unwind or challenge your skills.
Ready To Become a Dice Master?
Put your strategy and logic to the test! Merge dice, clear levels, and track your progress in this highly addictive merge game. Whether you're relaxing or aiming for a challenge, Smart Dice Merge-Block Puzzle delivers endless fun.

* Enter Dimensions: Input the size of your material sheet.
* Specify Cuts: Indicate the desired dimensions of your cuts.
* View Layouts: DyCut will generate four optimized layout options.

bluejetty:00036174:ios.description:
Give a funk? Give a funkypigeon.com! Because you know what’s better than a last-minute message on their birthday, anniversary or special occasion? A personalised card and gift that shows how well you know them!
From birthdays to engagements, new homes, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Valentine’s Day and every celebration along the way, we’ve got you sorted - because life’s better when you give a funk!
Why not give it a try? Here’s how…
1. Easily find the perfect card or gift to make them smile and shop ideas for every occasion by theme, recipient and more.
2. Make it special and add a personal touch with their name, photo or a custom message. Perfect for showing you give a funk!
3. Send to their door to surprise them on their big day, or have it sent back to your address so you can deliver in person.
Make Their Day Special, No Matter Where They Are 
Be present even when you can’t be there, with worldwide delivery on all cards and most gifts, perfect for sending love from across the miles! We’ll even post your card the same day you order if you get it in before our cut-off times, so put your feet up and let us take care of it all for you!
Never Miss a Birthday or Anniversary Again 
We’ve all been guilty of forgetting a birthday, so we’ve built in reminders for those important milestones so you’ll be reminded with enough time to get their card sorted. Add dates to your calendar to receive reminders and make sure your flock never feel left out!
Cards With Heart and Soul 
When it comes to celebrating the people closest to you, a last-minute generic greeting card just won’t cut the mustard – your flock deserves better! So, why not add some pizzazz to your card with a personalised design showing off your favourite memories together? Explore funny, cheeky and thoughtful cards that show how well you know them.
Gifts From The Heart 
Quickly and easily create personalised art, mugs, alcohol, home gifts, clothing and loads more with funky and fun ideas for all ages, hobbies and personalities! Upload your snaps together to a huge selection of customisable presents to show off your adventures for a gift that goes above and beyond.
From putting their face on a pair of socks to creating stunning art pieces personalised to your family, sending them a bottle of their favourite tipple customised with their name and loads more funky and fresh ideas, you’ll find something for everyone!
Say It With Flowers
Send gorgeous flower bouquets and plants to their door and surprise them with a flurry of colour to brighten their day! Whether you’re celebrating an anniversary, wishing them good luck or saying congratulations or thank you, what better way than with fresh flowers or plants delivered right to their door! 
Easily Track Orders and Manage Your Account
The power is at your fingertips with all the tools you need to track your orders, add prepay, update addresses and revisit past orders in one handy account section. We’ll even top up your prepay with a little bit extra to say thank you! Not part of the funky crew yet? Don’t worry, create your account online, on the app or during checkout to get started!
We love hearing from you! If you’ve got feedback, let us know through the app or website, and if you’re loving the app, please let us know with a review!

bluejetty:00133978:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00133978:ios.description:
Meet Aiko, your friendly AI anime companion.
Aiko is a chat app for anime fans. Choose a character, start a conversation, and build a story together. Your character remembers your name, your interests, and what you talked about yesterday.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
Chat with an anime character
Talk about school, games, music, food, or how your day went. The AI answers in character, so the conversation feels natural and warm.
Many characters to choose from
Every character has a different look and a different personality. Shy, bold, calm, or cheerful — pick the one you like.
Grow the relationship
You start as a stranger. The more you chat, the closer you get: friend, then best friend, and closer still if you want it. Every level stays warm and respectful. Aiko never takes a conversation in a sexual direction, at any level.
Send gifts
Give a rose, a coffee, a teddy bear, or a trophy. Your character reacts to every gift in their own way.
Collect anime art
Ask for a picture and keep it in your gallery. Build your own collection of anime portraits.
Daily rewards
Open the app every day and collect free coins.
SAFE FOR EVERY ANIME FAN
Aiko is made for a general anime audience. The characters stay friendly and respectful at all times. Aiko keeps every chat and every picture suitable for that audience, and politely refuses any request that goes outside it.
AIKO PLUS
Aiko Plus gives you unlimited messages and every photo in your gallery. It is an auto-renewing subscription: USD 4.99 per week, or USD 49.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
Terms Of Use: https://apptechn.com/waifu/terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy: https://apptechn.com/waifu/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00045845:ios.name: M Health Fairview
bluejetty:00045845:ios.summary:
The new M Health Fairview app is designed to give our patients the tools they need to take control of their healthcare however, whenever and wherever they choose. 
Simple, direct, and personalized features of the M Health Fairview app will
bluejetty:00045845:ios.description:
The new M Health Fairview app is designed to give our patients the tools they need to take control of their healthcare however, whenever and wherever they choose. 
Simple, direct, and personalized features of the M Health Fairview app will give you the power to:
- Securely access your health records
- Access the records of someone you serve as proxy for
- Find a provider near you 
- Easily schedule and manage office appointments
- Conduct an online assessment (eVisit)
- Schedule and participate in virtual appointments
- Learn more about your own wellness
- Review your COVID vaccination status and test results
- Communicate with your care team
- Check Urgent Care wait times 
- View your test results
- Pay your healthcare bills 
- And more
To access your health record information, you must have an 
M Health Fairview account. If you already have an M Health Fairview MyChart account, you’re good to go.
Please note: You can use your existing username and password for this app. If you don’t have an account yet, you can create one in the app with the “Sign Up Now” link using an activation code from your provider, or by providing and confirming some personal information. You don’t need an account to utilize the “Find Care” features.
This includes HealthKit integration, which allows you to enable the M Health Fairview app to access health data on your iPhone through the Health app. This provides you with the option to share data—such as blood pressure, blood glucose, and weight—with your provider to keep them up to date.

It's time to wake up! Take baby to the feeding chair in the Kitchen
bluejetty:00015500:ios.description:
My Baby Care lets you take care of the Cutest Baby Ever! Babysit this adorable Baby, and have fun spending the day with this Adorably cute & Hilariously Entertaining Baby!
It's time to wake up! Take baby to the feeding chair in the Kitchen and feed baby some delicious baby food including colorful cereal, egg, milk and more!
Give baby a bubbly bath before we start the busy day ahead! Make bubbles, shampoo baby's head, and rinse off before it's time to start the day!
Take baby on a Shopping trip at the Supermarket! Baby will squeal and giggle with delight when selecting items from the shelf!
It's game time! Play some fun games with baby including a Xylophone, Bouncy ball, Bobble Penguin, and a Special surprise gift! The look on baby's face when playing these games is priceless!!
Tap the tablet to play some fun minigames with Baby including bird flight, cupcake decorator, and blocks stacker!
It's been quite a long day, and it's time to get baby ready for bed! Turn on the lullaby music, pull up the blanket, and watch baby doze off to sleep!
Wake up with baby again to start the day over with more fun activities!
This game includes fun animations, and realistic expressions from baby that will make you laugh and entertain for hours on end!
My Baby Care is an adorable game for kids who love babysitter games, and baby games!
