bluejetty:00024435:ios.summary: Hot Air is a complete balloon flight companion, built by balloon pilots for balloon pilots. From preflight planning to postflight review, it delivers live tracking, flight recording, waypoint navigation, wind profiling, and more — all desig
bluejetty:00024435:ios.description:
Hot Air is a complete balloon flight companion, built by balloon pilots for balloon pilots. From preflight planning to postflight review, it delivers live tracking, flight recording, waypoint navigation, wind profiling, and more — all designed specifically for the unique needs of hot air ballooning.
Whether you’re a student pilot, a commercial operator, or flying for fun, Hot Air helps you stay organized, informed, and connected.
Features include:
 • Live tracking on street or satellite maps
 • Wind profiling by altitude during climb and descent
 • Waypoint navigation with bearing, distance, and estimated time
 • Automatic flight recording with 3D export support
 • Custom map overlays (KML/KMZ)
 • Offline-capable with map caching
 • Real-time flight sharing with crew or friends
 • Detailed flight logs for crew, passengers, propane, and temperature
 • Flight summaries and totals for logs or checkrides
 • Interactive map history of takeoffs and landings
 • Export to HTML, KML, or GPX
 • Payload calculator for accurate weight and balance
 • Integrated weather data and forecasts
 • Improved UTM 4x4 waypoint format support
Additional features:
 • Real-time heading projection
 • Built-in data backup and restore
 • Localized in English, French, Czech, and Slovak
 • Fully optimized for iPhone and iPad (portrait and landscape)
Note: Continued use of GPS can reduce battery life. Use an external battery for longer flights.

bluejetty:00016365:ios.name: EZ Voice
bluejetty:00016365:ios.summary:
Now you can sing along with all of your favorite songs! EZ Voice is a companion app for iRig Voice and iRig MIC that lets you practice, perform and record vocals using the music in your mobile device’s music library. 
With EZ Voice, you’ll
bluejetty:00016365:ios.description:
Now you can sing along with all of your favorite songs! EZ Voice is a companion app for iRig Voice and iRig MIC that lets you practice, perform and record vocals using the music in your mobile device’s music library. 
With EZ Voice, you’ll always stand out and deliver a winning performance. Just pick a song from your library and let EZ Voice do the rest — its intuitive controls make it easy to remove original vocals, tune your voice and add fun vocal effects. Share your favorite performances with your friends and fans. It’s the easy way to sound great and sing along with your favorite music anytime, anywhere.
YOUR FAVORITE SONGS, YOUR WAY
Sing your heart out and record your performance with the REC interface. Import a song, hit "No Voice" to remove the original vocals and then tap the record button — now it’s your turn in the spotlight. Afterwards, check the preview and head to the FX menu.
QUALITY VOCAL EFFECTS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
You'll always deliver a pitch-perfect performance thanks to the FX menu. Browse the built-in effects presets to let EZ Voice polish your voice for you, or unlock individual effects to unleash your creativity.
EZ Voice lets you have fun while you perfect your tone. You can select up to 3 simultaneous audio effects of its 9 included high-quality effects: Use Tune to keep your voice in key like the pros; add Morph to try a different gender; apply Choir to add extra voices and harmonies; or try more traditional effects like Reverb, Delay, Chorus, EQ, Filter, and Level — all derived from IK Multimedia's award-winning professional audio software. One tap adds an effect, two taps lets you edit. Save your favorite combinations and settings to the preset library.
SHARE WITH YOUR FRIENDS
Quickly manage your saved performances with the SONG menu. EZ Voice does all the organizing for you, letting you compare, evaluate and modify your previously recorded takes with ease — you can even duplicate songs to take full-advantage of EZ Voice's many vocal effects. Save your work, and when you're satisfied, share your performances with your friends and fans via email or SoundCloud.
EZ Voice Features:
• Sing along with any song on your mobile device’s music library or through iTunes File Sharing
• Sing with or without a backing track
• Quick and easy-to-use interface lets you sing anywhere, anytime
• No Voice button removes original vocals from imported songs letting you take the lead
• Polish your voice with 9 high-quality audio effects: Tune, Morph, Choir, EQ, Filter, Level, Chorus, Delay and Reverb (Reverb is free by registering — the other effects are available via in-app purchase)
• Comes with factory effects presets for all singing styles
• Preview, adjust and save effects combinations with ease
• Lets you share your performances with your friends via SoundCloud and email
• Sing using your mobile device’s built-in mic or your earbuds’ mic
• For best performance, use the IK range of microphones like iRig Voice
To learn more about EZ Voice and compatible accessories, please visit: 
www.ikmultimedia.com/ezvoice
www.irigvoice.com
Also check out the greatest selection of music apps and mobile music creation accessories here: 
www.ikmultimedia.com

apple-macos:6799585595.name: Tiho Mail
apple-macos:6799585595.summary: Download Tiho Mail by Alan Matviienko on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like Tiho Mail.
apple-macos:6799585595.description:
Tiho is a mail app for people with their own domain — a mailbox at a company, at a provider, or on your own server. It connects to what you already have. There is nothing to migrate.
RESPECTS YOUR ATTENTION
The only badge is the number of unread messages, and it switches off. No marketing inside the app, no feed. A list of messages, in the order they arrived, and nothing trying to keep you in it.
BLOCKS TRACKING, AND SAYS WHERE IT COSTS YOU
Remote images are off by default: a tracking pixel tells the sender you opened the message, and no rule of thumb reliably tells one from a logo. Sender logos come from the sender’s own domain — its DNS record, or the icon of its site. The same picture for every recipient, so showing one gives nothing away.
NOTIFICATIONS EXPLAIN THEMSELVES BEFORE THEY ASK
To tell you the moment mail arrives, our server holds a connection to your mailbox, and for that it stores access to it, encrypted. From a message it reads the sender and the subject, and the first lines if you allowed them — a notification has to show something — and encrypts all of it with a key that belongs to your device: nobody can read it on the way, not even Apple. What you did not allow is never sent to you and never stored; the first lines it does not even ask your mailbox for. Nothing from your letters is kept. All of this is on its own screen, before the system asks anything, and disconnecting the mailbox wipes it.
CONVERSATIONS, NOT LISTS OF LINKS
Replies read as one continuous conversation. Your own answer appears in it the moment you send it, not after the server agrees.
MEETING INVITATIONS LOOK LIKE MEETINGS
Not “invite.ics, 4 KB” — the title, the time, the place, the participants, and buttons to answer. Accepted meetings can be added to your calendar.
NEWSLETTERS KNOW THEIR PLACE
They are recognised by the standard header senders are required to add, kept in their own view, and unsubscribed in one tap where the sender supports it.
BULK MAIL DONE PROPERLY
Campaigns go out through a sending service with your own key, never from your mailbox: a personal mailbox hits its provider’s limit within the first hundred messages, and the domain lands in spam afterwards. Lists live on your device, an unsubscribe link is added automatically, and sending without one is not allowed.
LETTERS THAT WAIT FOR YOU
Snooze one and it leaves the inbox and comes back when you asked. Write now, send later. Drafts save themselves, and a letter you write often can be kept as a template.
SORTED BEFORE YOU OPEN THE APP
Rules our server applies as mail arrives: move it, mark it read, star it, or let it in quietly. An away message that answers while you are gone — once per sender, never to a mailing list. Labels, so a letter can be in two places at once.
WHO IT REALLY CAME FROM
Any message can show its details: the true sender address and whether the signature checks out. Attachments open inside the app.
SEVERAL MAILBOXES, ONE LIST
Work and home in one place, or each on its own — your choice, and it changes with one tap. Search reads what is on the device, so it answers instantly and works on a plane; it understands the twelve languages the app speaks, accents and cases included. The same mailbox also opens in a browser, where you would rather not install anything.
WORKS WITH
Any mailbox that speaks IMAP and SMTP — your own domain, a company mailbox, Fastmail, Zoho, iCloud, cPanel hosting. Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com sign in through Microsoft itself, because Microsoft turned off password sign-in for mail.
Gmail is not supported and will not be. Google requires an annual security audit of anyone whose server touches Gmail data, and the price of that audit would end up on your bill.

fdroid:com.synsound.app.name: SynSound
fdroid:com.synsound.app.summary: Android WebView client for SynSound's hosted acoustic-analysis service
fdroid:com.synsound.app.description:
SynSound for Android is an open-source Android application that provides a secure WebView client for the hosted SynSound acoustic-analysis service.
 Android application features
 Native Android application shell and WebView integration.
 Microphone permission mediation for the hosted web application.
 Navigation, session persistence, file selection and downloads, and network/error recovery.
 On supported Android System WebView versions, a native acoustic-event detector can analyze bounded mono PCM frames tapped from the hosted application's already-active Web Audio microphone stream while monitoring is active.
 The native audio tap uses an origin-restricted bridge and does not open a second Android microphone capture.
 If the required WebView messaging capability is unavailable, the native audio tap remains inactive rather than falling back to an unrestricted JavaScript bridge.
 Important limitations
 The Android APK is a WebView client for the hosted SynSound service. It does not implement every DSP, mastering, transcription, visualization, or forensic workflow as a native Android feature. The hosted web service is proprietary, network-dependent, and uses a fixed service endpoint.
 The native event status and candidate labels are heuristic signals, not definitive acoustic or forensic identifications.
 Privacy and network behavior
 The Android APK includes no advertising or analytics SDKs. The native bridge processes the PCM frames it receives in memory and does not itself write those frames to disk or send them to a cloud endpoint. However, microphone audio is supplied to the hosted web application when microphone access is granted. This listing makes no claim that audio remains on-device; the hosted service's own audio and network behavior has not been independently audited.
 Open-source components
 The Android application and Kotlin integration code in this repository are available under the MIT license. The hosted SynSound web service is separate and is not represented as open-source by this Android repository.
 Permissions
 RECORD_AUDIO - Allows microphone access when requested by the hosted SynSound web application.
 INTERNET - Connects to the hosted SynSound service.
 ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE - Supports connectivity handling.
 MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS - Supports Android audio-routing integration.
 WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE - Legacy external-storage access, limited by the manifest to Android 9 and earlier (API 28 and below).
 Technical details
 Package: com.synsound.app 
 Minimum Android version: Android 8.0 (API 26)
 Target Android version: Android 15 (API 35)
 Release: 1.0.6 (versionCode 6)
